const Ajv = require('ajv');
const addFormats = require('ajv-formats');
const { ObjectId } = require('mongodb');
const ConsentTemplateModel = require('../models/ConsentTemplate');
const ConsentPolicyModel = require('../models/ConsentPolicy');
const PatientConsentModel = require('../models/PatientConsent');
const { validatePatientID } = require('../utils/patientAnonymization');
const logger = require('../utils/logger');

const ajv = new Ajv({ allErrors: true, strict: false, removeAdditional: 'all' });
addFormats(ajv);

const consentTemplateSchema = {
  type: 'object',
  required: ['title', 'content', 'version'],
  properties: {
    title: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    content: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    htmlContent: { type: 'string' },
    version: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    active: { type: 'boolean' },
    permissions: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        required: ['key', 'label'],
        properties: {
          key: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          label: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          required: { type: 'boolean' }
        },
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  },
  additionalProperties: true
};

const consentPolicySchema = {
  type: 'object',
  required: ['title', 'htmlContent', 'version', 'validFrom', 'granularPermissions'],
  properties: {
    title: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    htmlContent: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    version: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    validFrom: { type: 'string', format: 'date-time' },
    active: { type: 'boolean' },
    granularPermissions: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        required: ['key', 'label'],
        properties: {
          key: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          label: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          required: { type: 'boolean' }
        },
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  },
  additionalProperties: true
};

const patientConsentSchema = {
  type: 'object',
  required: ['patientId', 'templateId', 'responses'],
  properties: {
    patientId: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    templateId: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
    responses: {
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: { type: 'boolean' }
    },
    ipAddress: { type: 'string' },
    userAgent: { type: 'string' },
    status: { type: 'string', enum: ['ACTIVE', 'REVOKED'] }
  },
  additionalProperties: true
};

const validateTemplateSchema = ajv.compile(consentTemplateSchema);
const validatePolicySchema = ajv.compile(consentPolicySchema);
const validatePatientConsentSchema = ajv.compile(patientConsentSchema);

class ConsentService {
  validateTemplatePayload(payload) {
    const valid = validateTemplateSchema(payload);
    if (!valid) {
      const errors = (validateTemplateSchema.errors || []).map(err => `${err.instancePath || 'template'} ${err.message}`);
      throw new Error(errors.join(', '));
    }
  }

  validatePolicyPayload(payload) {
    const valid = validatePolicySchema(payload);
    if (!valid) {
      const errors = (validatePolicySchema.errors || []).map(err => `${err.instancePath || 'policy'} ${err.message}`);
      throw new Error(errors.join(', '));
    }
  }

  validatePatientConsentPayload(payload) {
    const valid = validatePatientConsentSchema(payload);
    if (!valid) {
      const errors = (validatePatientConsentSchema.errors || []).map(err => `${err.instancePath || 'consent'} ${err.message}`);
      throw new Error(errors.join(', '));
    }
  }

  ensureUniquePermissionKeys(permissions) {
    const keys = new Set();
    for (const permission of permissions) {
      const key = permission.key.trim();
      if (keys.has(key)) {
        throw new Error(`Chave de permissão duplicada: ${key}`);
      }
      keys.add(key);
    }
  }

  validateResponsesAgainstTemplate(template, responses) {
    const permissions = Array.isArray(template.permissions) ? template.permissions : [];
    const keys = new Set(permissions.map(permission => permission.key));

    const missing = permissions.filter(permission => typeof responses[permission.key] !== 'boolean');
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Respostas inválidas: ${missing.map(p => p.key).join(', ')} devem ser booleano`);
    }

    const missingRequired = permissions.filter(permission => permission.required && responses[permission.key] !== true);
    if (missingRequired.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Permissões obrigatórias não aceitas: ${missingRequired.map(p => p.key).join(', ')}`);
    }

    const extraKeys = Object.keys(responses).filter(key => !keys.has(key));
    if (extraKeys.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`Respostas contêm chaves inválidas: ${extraKeys.join(', ')}`);
    }
  }

  async createTemplate(db, payload) {
    try {
      this.validateTemplatePayload(payload);

      const validation = ConsentTemplateModel.validate(payload);
      if (!validation.isValid) {
        throw new Error(validation.errors.join(', '));
      }

      const permissions = Array.isArray(payload.permissions)
        ? payload.permissions.map(permission => ({
            key: permission.key.trim(),
            label: permission.label.trim(),
            required: Boolean(permission.required)
          }))
        : [];
      this.ensureUniquePermissionKeys(permissions);

      const templatesCollection = db.collection('consent_templates');

      if (payload.active === undefined || payload.active === true) {
        await templatesCollection.updateMany({ active: true }, { $set: { active: false, updatedAt: new Date() } });
      }

      const template = ConsentTemplateModel.create({
        ...payload,
        permissions
      });

      const result = await templatesCollection.insertOne(template);
      return {
        _id: result.insertedId,
        ...template
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao criar template de consentimento:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async createPolicy(db, payload) {
    try {
      const normalizedPayload = {
        ...payload,
        htmlContent: payload.htmlContent || payload.content,
        validFrom: payload.validFrom || new Date().toISOString(),
        granularPermissions: payload.granularPermissions || payload.permissions || []
      };

      this.validatePolicyPayload(normalizedPayload);

      const validation = ConsentPolicyModel.validate(normalizedPayload);
      if (!validation.isValid) {
        throw new Error(validation.errors.join(', '));
      }

      const permissions = Array.isArray(normalizedPayload.granularPermissions)
        ? normalizedPayload.granularPermissions.map(permission => ({
            key: permission.key.trim(),
            label: permission.label.trim(),
            required: Boolean(permission.required)
          }))
        : [];
      this.ensureUniquePermissionKeys(permissions);

      const templatesCollection = db.collection('consent_templates');

      if (normalizedPayload.active === undefined || normalizedPayload.active === true) {
        await templatesCollection.updateMany({ active: true }, { $set: { active: false, updatedAt: new Date() } });
      }

      const policy = ConsentPolicyModel.create({
        ...normalizedPayload,
        granularPermissions: permissions
      });

      const document = {
        ...policy,
        content: policy.htmlContent,
        permissions: permissions,
        htmlContent: policy.htmlContent,
        granularPermissions: permissions
      };

      const result = await templatesCollection.insertOne(document);
      return {
        _id: result.insertedId,
        ...document
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao criar política de consentimento:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async getActiveTemplate(db) {
    const templatesCollection = db.collection('consent_templates');
    const template = await templatesCollection
      .find({ active: true })
      .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
      .limit(1)
      .toArray();

    return template[0] || null;
  }

  async getActivePolicy(db) {
    const templatesCollection = db.collection('consent_templates');
    const template = await templatesCollection
      .find({ active: true })
      .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
      .limit(1)
      .toArray();

    return template[0] || null;
  }

  async getAllPolicies(db) {
    const templatesCollection = db.collection('consent_templates');
    return templatesCollection
      .find({})
      .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
      .toArray();
  }

  async createPatientConsent(db, payload) {
    try {
      this.validatePatientConsentPayload(payload);

      const validation = PatientConsentModel.validate(payload);
      if (!validation.isValid) {
        throw new Error(validation.errors.join(', '));
      }

      const patientId = payload.patientId;
      const patientExists = await validatePatientID(db, patientId, 'pacientes');
      if (!patientExists) {
        throw new Error(`Paciente ${patientId} não encontrado`);
      }

      let templateId;
      try {
        templateId = new ObjectId(payload.templateId);
      } catch (error) {
        throw new Error('templateId inválido');
      }

      const templatesCollection = db.collection('consent_templates');
      const template = await templatesCollection.findOne({ _id: templateId });
      if (!template) {
        throw new Error('Template de consentimento não encontrado');
      }

      if (!template.active) {
        throw new Error('Template de consentimento não está ativo');
      }

      this.validateResponsesAgainstTemplate(template, payload.responses || {});

      const consentsCollection = db.collection('patient_consents');
      await consentsCollection.updateMany(
        { patientId, status: 'ACTIVE' },
        { $set: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() } }
      );

      const consent = PatientConsentModel.create({
        ...payload,
        templateId: templateId.toString(),
        status: 'ACTIVE'
      });

      const insertResult = await consentsCollection.insertOne(consent);
      return {
        _id: insertResult.insertedId,
        ...consent
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao criar consentimento do paciente:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async revokeConsent(db, consentId) {
    const consentsCollection = db.collection('patient_consents');

    let objectId;
    try {
      objectId = new ObjectId(consentId);
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error('ID de consentimento inválido');
    }

    const consent = await consentsCollection.findOne({ _id: objectId });
    if (!consent) {
      return null;
    }

    if (consent.status === 'REVOKED') {
      return consent;
    }

    await consentsCollection.updateOne(
      { _id: objectId },
      { $set: { status: 'REVOKED', revokedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() } }
    );

    return {
      ...consent,
      status: 'REVOKED',
      revokedAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date()
    };
  }

  async getPatientConsent(db, patientId) {
    const consentsCollection = db.collection('patient_consents');
    const consent = await consentsCollection
      .find({ patientId })
      .sort({ signedAt: -1, createdAt: -1 })
      .limit(1)
      .toArray();

    return consent[0] || null;
  }
}

module.exports = new ConsentService();

const { ObjectId } = require('mongodb');
const logger = require('../utils/logger');

class ConsentValidator {
  constructor() {
    this.db = null;
  }

  init(db) {
    this.db = db;
  }

  async validateAccess(sampleId, requiredScope) {
    if (!this.db) {
      throw new Error('Banco de dados não inicializado para validação de consentimento');
    }

    if (!sampleId) {
      throw new Error('sampleId é obrigatório para validar consentimento');
    }

    const samplesCollection = this.db.collection('amostras');
    let sample = null;

    try {
      sample = await samplesCollection.findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(sampleId) });
    } catch (error) {
      const parsedSampleId = Number(sampleId);
      if (!Number.isNaN(parsedSampleId)) {
        sample = await samplesCollection.findOne({ sampleID: parsedSampleId });
      }
    }

    if (!sample) {
      throw new Error('Amostra não encontrada para validação de consentimento');
    }

    const patientId = sample.patientID || sample.patientId;
    if (!patientId) {
      throw new Error('Amostra sem patientID para validação de consentimento');
    }

    const consentsCollection = this.db.collection('patient_consents');
    const consent = await consentsCollection
      .find({ patientId, status: 'ACTIVE' })
      .sort({ signedAt: -1, createdAt: -1 })
      .limit(1)
      .toArray();

    const activeConsent = consent[0];
    if (!activeConsent) {
      throw new Error('Consentimento inexistente ou revogado para este paciente');
    }

    if (requiredScope && typeof requiredScope === 'string') {
      const responses = activeConsent.responses || {};
      if (responses[requiredScope] !== true) {
        throw new Error(`Consentimento não permite o escopo solicitado: ${requiredScope}`);
      }
    }

    return true;
  }
}

module.exports = new ConsentValidator();

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const Ajv = require('ajv');
const addFormats = require('ajv-formats');
const logger = require('../utils/logger');

const PROFILES_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '../resources/fhir/profiles');
const REQUIRED_RESOURCE_TYPES = ['Patient', 'Specimen', 'Observation', 'Organization', 'Bundle'];

class FhirValidatorService {
  constructor() {
    this.ajv = new Ajv({ allErrors: true, strict: false });
    addFormats(this.ajv);
    this.schemaMap = new Map();
    this.loaded = false;
    this.loadSchemas();
  }

  loadSchemas() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(PROFILES_DIR)) {
      logger.warn('Pasta de perfis FHIR não encontrada:', PROFILES_DIR);
      return;
    }

    const files = fs.readdirSync(PROFILES_DIR).filter((file) => file.endsWith('.json'));
    files.forEach((file) => {
      try {
        const fullPath = path.join(PROFILES_DIR, file);
        const raw = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
        const schema = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (!schema.$id) {
          logger.warn(`Schema sem $id ignorado: ${file}`);
          return;
        }
        this.ajv.addSchema(schema, schema.$id);
        const resourceType = file.replace('.schema.json', '').replace('.json', '');
        this.schemaMap.set(resourceType, schema.$id);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`Erro ao carregar schema FHIR ${file}:`, error.message);
      }
    });

    this.loaded = true;
  }

  isFhirResource(payload) {
    if (!payload) return false;
    if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
      return payload.some((item) => item && item.resourceType);
    }
    return Boolean(payload.resourceType || payload.entry);
  }

  getSchemaId(resourceType) {
    return this.schemaMap.get(resourceType) || null;
  }

  validateResource(resource) {
    const resourceType = resource?.resourceType;
    if (!resourceType) {
      return this.buildInvalidIssue('resourceType ausente', '/resourceType');
    }

    const schemaId = this.getSchemaId(resourceType);
    if (!schemaId) {
      return this.buildInvalidIssue(`Schema não encontrado para ${resourceType}`, `/resourceType`);
    }

    const validator = this.ajv.getSchema(schemaId);
    if (!validator) {
      return this.buildInvalidIssue(`Validador não carregado para ${resourceType}`, `/resourceType`);
    }

    const valid = validator(resource);
    if (valid) {
      return { valid: true, issues: [] };
    }

    const issues = (validator.errors || []).map((err) => {
      return {
        severity: 'error',
        code: 'invalid',
        diagnostics: this.friendlyMessageFromError(resourceType, err),
        expression: err.instancePath || err.schemaPath
      };
    });

    return { valid: false, issues };
  }

  buildInvalidIssue(message, expression) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      issues: [
        {
          severity: 'error',
          code: 'invalid',
          diagnostics: message,
          expression
        }
      ]
    };
  }

  friendlyMessageFromError(resourceType, error) {
    const path = error.instancePath || '';
    if (resourceType === 'Patient') {
      if (path.includes('/gender')) return "O campo 'Gênero' é inválido";
      if (path.includes('/birthDate')) return "O campo 'Data de Nascimento' é inválido";
      if (path.includes('/name')) return "O campo 'Nome' é inválido";
    }

    if (resourceType === 'Specimen') {
      if (path.includes('/subject')) return "O campo 'Paciente (subject)' é obrigatório";
      if (path.includes('/type')) return "O campo 'Tipo da amostra' é obrigatório";
    }

    if (resourceType === 'Observation') {
      if (path.includes('/status')) return "O campo 'Status' é inválido";
      if (path.includes('/code')) return "O campo 'Código da observação' é obrigatório";
    }

    if (resourceType === 'Organization') {
      if (path.includes('/name')) return "O campo 'Nome da organização' é obrigatório";
    }

    return error.message || 'Recurso FHIR inválido';
  }

  validatePayload(payload, allowedTypes = REQUIRED_RESOURCE_TYPES) {
    const issues = [];
    let resourcesValidated = 0;

    const validateOne = (resource) => {
      if (!resource || !resource.resourceType) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          code: 'invalid',
          diagnostics: 'resourceType ausente no recurso',
          expression: '/resourceType'
        });
        return;
      }

      if (!allowedTypes.includes(resource.resourceType)) {
        issues.push({
          severity: 'error',
          code: 'not-supported',
          diagnostics: `ResourceType ${resource.resourceType} não suportado neste escopo`,
          expression: '/resourceType'
        });
        return;
      }

      const result = this.validateResource(resource);
      if (!result.valid) {
        issues.push(...result.issues);
      }
      resourcesValidated += 1;
    };

    if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
      payload.forEach((resource) => validateOne(resource));
    } else if (payload.resourceType === 'Bundle' && Array.isArray(payload.entry)) {
      payload.entry.forEach((entry) => validateOne(entry.resource));
    } else {
      validateOne(payload);
    }

    return {
      valid: issues.length === 0,
      issues,
      resourcesValidated
    };
  }

  buildOperationOutcome(issues = []) {
    return {
      resourceType: 'OperationOutcome',
      issue: issues.map((issue) => ({
        severity: issue.severity || 'error',
        code: issue.code || 'invalid',
        diagnostics: issue.diagnostics,
        expression: issue.expression ? [issue.expression] : undefined
      }))
    };
  }
}

module.exports = new FhirValidatorService();

const logger = require('../utils/logger');

/**
 * Serviço de Transformação HL7 FHIR R4
 * Converte dados do BioAdvanceD para recursos FHIR R4
 */

class FHIRService {
  /**
   * Converte Patient para FHIR.Patient
   */
  patientToFHIR(patient) {
    try {
      const fhirPatient = {
        resourceType: 'Patient',
        id: patient.patientID?.toString() || patient._id?.toString(),
        identifier: [
          {
            system: 'http://bioavanced.local/patient-id',
            value: patient.patientID?.toString() || patient._id?.toString(),
          },
        ],
        name: [
          {
            use: 'official',
            family: this.extractFamilyName(patient.patientName),
            given: this.extractGivenNames(patient.patientName),
          },
        ],
        gender: this.mapSexToFHIR(patient.sex),
        birthDate: this.formatDate(patient.birthDate),
        extension: [],
      };

      // Adiciona extensões para dados adicionais
      if (patient.weight) {
        fhirPatient.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/patient-weight',
          valueQuantity: {
            value: patient.weight,
            unit: 'kg',
            system: 'http://unitsofmeasure.org',
            code: 'kg',
          },
        });
      }

      if (patient.heightCm) {
        fhirPatient.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/patient-height',
          valueQuantity: {
            value: patient.heightCm,
            unit: 'cm',
            system: 'http://unitsofmeasure.org',
            code: 'cm',
          },
        });
      }

      if (patient.recordNumber) {
        fhirPatient.identifier.push({
          system: 'http://bioavanced.local/record-number',
          value: patient.recordNumber.toString(),
        });
      }

      if (patient.clinicalUnit) {
        fhirPatient.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/clinical-unit',
          valueString: patient.clinicalUnit,
        });
      }

      // Adiciona condições (comorbidades)
      const conditions = [];
      if (patient.hypertension) conditions.push('Hypertension');
      if (patient.obesity) conditions.push('Obesity');
      if (patient.diabetesType1) conditions.push('Diabetes Type 1');
      if (patient.diabetesType2) conditions.push('Diabetes Type 2');
      if (patient.copd) conditions.push('COPD');
      if (patient.ckd) conditions.push('CKD');
      if (patient.asthma) conditions.push('Asthma');

      if (conditions.length > 0) {
        fhirPatient.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/conditions',
          valueString: conditions.join(', '),
        });
      }

      if (patient.icdCode) {
        fhirPatient.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/icd-code',
          valueString: patient.icdCode,
        });
      }

      return fhirPatient;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao converter Patient para FHIR:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Converte Sample para FHIR.Specimen
   */
  sampleToFHIR(sample, patientReference = null) {
    try {
      const fhirSpecimen = {
        resourceType: 'Specimen',
        id: sample.sampleID?.toString() || sample._id?.toString(),
        identifier: [
          {
            system: 'http://bioavanced.local/sample-id',
            value: sample.sampleID?.toString() || sample._id?.toString(),
          },
        ],
        status: this.mapSampleStatusToFHIR(sample.currentStatus),
        type: {
          coding: [
            {
              system: 'http://snomed.info/sct',
              code: this.mapSampleTypeToSNOMED(sample.sampleType),
              display: sample.sampleType,
            },
          ],
        },
        subject: patientReference || {
          reference: `Patient/${sample.patientID}`,
        },
        receivedTime: this.formatDateTime(sample.registrationDate || sample.registerDate),
        extension: [],
      };

      if (sample.barcode) {
        fhirSpecimen.identifier.push({
          system: 'http://bioavanced.local/barcode',
          value: sample.barcode.toString(),
        });
      }

      if (sample.sampleOrigin) {
        fhirSpecimen.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/sample-origin',
          valueString: sample.sampleOrigin,
        });
      }

      if (sample.extractionProtocol) {
        fhirSpecimen.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/extraction-protocol',
          valueString: sample.extractionProtocol,
        });
      }

      if (sample.quantity) {
        fhirSpecimen.quantity = {
          value: sample.quantity,
          unit: 'µL',
          system: 'http://unitsofmeasure.org',
          code: 'uL',
        };
      }

      if (sample.quality !== undefined && sample.quality !== null) {
        fhirSpecimen.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/sample-quality',
          valueCode: this.mapQualityToFHIR(sample.quality),
        });
      }

      if (sample.locationID) {
        fhirSpecimen.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/location-id',
          valueInteger: sample.locationID,
        });
      }

      if (sample.linkedProject) {
        fhirSpecimen.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/linked-project',
          valueString: sample.linkedProject,
        });
      }

      // HL7 FHIR - Campos obrigatórios adicionais
      if (sample.accessionNumber) {
        fhirSpecimen.identifier.push({
          system: 'http://bioavanced.local/accession-number',
          value: sample.accessionNumber.toString(),
        });
      }

      if (sample.orderNumber) {
        fhirSpecimen.request = [{
          reference: `ServiceRequest/${sample.orderNumber}`,
        }];
      }

      if (sample.receivedTime) {
        fhirSpecimen.receivedTime = this.formatDateTime(sample.receivedTime);
      }

      if (sample.processingStatus) {
        fhirSpecimen.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/processing-status',
          valueCode: sample.processingStatus,
        });
      }

      if (sample.protocolApplied) {
        fhirSpecimen.processing = [{
          description: sample.protocolApplied,
          time: this.formatDateTime(sample.receivedTime || sample.registrationDate),
        }];
      }

      if (sample.specimenCollection) {
        fhirSpecimen.collection = sample.specimenCollection;
      }

      if (sample.linkedFiles && Array.isArray(sample.linkedFiles) && sample.linkedFiles.length > 0) {
        fhirSpecimen.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/linked-files',
          valueReference: sample.linkedFiles.map(file => ({
            reference: `DocumentReference/${file}`,
          })),
        });
      }

      return fhirSpecimen;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao converter Sample para FHIR:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Converte Result para FHIR.Observation e/ou FHIR.DiagnosticReport
   */
  resultToFHIR(result, sampleReference = null) {
    try {
      const fhirObservation = {
        resourceType: 'Observation',
        id: result.resultID?.toString() || result._id?.toString(),
        identifier: [
          {
            system: 'http://bioavanced.local/result-id',
            value: result.resultID?.toString() || result._id?.toString(),
          },
        ],
        status: 'final',
        category: [
          {
            coding: [
              {
                system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category',
                code: 'laboratory',
                display: 'Laboratory',
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
        code: {
          coding: [
            {
              system: 'http://loinc.org',
              code: result.testCode || 'UNKNOWN',
              display: result.testName || 'Unknown Test',
            },
          ],
        },
        subject: sampleReference || {
          reference: `Specimen/${result.sampleID}`,
        },
        effectiveDateTime: this.formatDateTime(result.testDate || result.createdAt),
        valueString: result.resultValue || null,
        extension: [],
      };

      if (result.filePath) {
        fhirObservation.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/result-file',
          valueString: result.filePath,
        });
      }

      if (result.fileType) {
        fhirObservation.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/result-file-type',
          valueString: result.fileType,
        });
      }

      // Cria DiagnosticReport se necessário
      const fhirDiagnosticReport = {
        resourceType: 'DiagnosticReport',
        id: `dr-${result.resultID || result._id}`,
        identifier: [
          {
            system: 'http://bioavanced.local/diagnostic-report-id',
            value: result.resultID?.toString() || result._id?.toString(),
          },
        ],
        status: 'final',
        category: [
          {
            coding: [
              {
                system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0074',
                code: 'LAB',
                display: 'Laboratory',
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
        code: {
          coding: [
            {
              system: 'http://loinc.org',
              code: result.testCode || 'UNKNOWN',
              display: result.testName || 'Unknown Test',
            },
          ],
        },
        subject: sampleReference || {
          reference: `Specimen/${result.sampleID}`,
        },
        effectiveDateTime: this.formatDateTime(result.testDate || result.createdAt),
        result: [
          {
            reference: `Observation/${fhirObservation.id}`,
          },
        ],
      };

      return {
        observation: fhirObservation,
        diagnosticReport: fhirDiagnosticReport,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao converter Result para FHIR:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Converte Temperature para FHIR.Device + FHIR.Observation
   */
  temperatureToFHIR(temperature) {
    try {
      const fhirDevice = {
        resourceType: 'Device',
        id: `device-${temperature.sensorId}`,
        identifier: [
          {
            system: 'http://bioavanced.local/sensor-id',
            value: temperature.sensorId?.toString(),
          },
        ],
        status: this.mapSensorStatusToFHIR(temperature.sensorStatus),
        type: {
          coding: [
            {
              system: 'http://snomed.info/sct',
              code: '706689003',
              display: 'Temperature sensor',
            },
          ],
        },
        extension: [],
      };

      if (temperature.locationId) {
        fhirDevice.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/location-id',
          valueInteger: temperature.locationId,
        });
      }

      if (temperature.facility) {
        fhirDevice.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/facility',
          valueString: temperature.facility,
        });
      }

      if (temperature.zone) {
        fhirDevice.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/zone',
          valueString: temperature.zone,
        });
      }

      const fhirObservation = {
        resourceType: 'Observation',
        id: `temp-${temperature._id || temperature.timestamp}`,
        identifier: [
          {
            system: 'http://bioavanced.local/temperature-id',
            value: temperature._id?.toString() || temperature.timestamp?.toString(),
          },
        ],
        status: this.mapReadingStatusToFHIR(temperature.readingStatus),
        category: [
          {
            coding: [
              {
                system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category',
                code: 'vital-signs',
                display: 'Vital Signs',
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
        code: {
          coding: [
            {
              system: 'http://loinc.org',
              code: '8310-5',
              display: 'Body temperature',
            },
          ],
        },
        device: {
          reference: `Device/${fhirDevice.id}`,
        },
        effectiveDateTime: this.formatDateTime(temperature.timestamp),
        valueQuantity: {
          value: temperature.temperatureValue,
          unit: temperature.temperatureUnit || '°C',
          system: 'http://unitsofmeasure.org',
          code: temperature.temperatureUnit === '°F' ? '[degF]' : '[degC]',
        },
        extension: [],
      };

      if (temperature.signalQuality) {
        fhirObservation.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/signal-quality',
          valueString: temperature.signalQuality,
        });
      }

      if (temperature.batteryLevel !== undefined && temperature.batteryLevel !== null) {
        fhirObservation.extension.push({
          url: 'http://bioavanced.local/StructureDefinition/battery-level',
          valueInteger: temperature.batteryLevel,
        });
      }

      return {
        device: fhirDevice,
        observation: fhirObservation,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao converter Temperature para FHIR:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Valida recurso FHIR
   */
  validateFHIRResource(resource) {
    if (!resource.resourceType) {
      throw new Error('Recurso FHIR deve ter resourceType');
    }

    if (!resource.id) {
      throw new Error('Recurso FHIR deve ter id');
    }

    return true;
  }

  /**
   * Busca recurso por identifier
   */
  async findResourceByIdentifier(db, collection, identifierSystem, identifierValue) {
    try {
      const query = {
        'fhir.identifier': {
          $elemMatch: {
            system: identifierSystem,
            value: identifierValue.toString(),
          },
        },
      };

      return await db.collection(collection).findOne(query);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao buscar recurso por identifier:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  // Métodos auxiliares

  extractFamilyName(fullName) {
    if (!fullName) return '';
    const parts = fullName.trim().split(/\s+/);
    return parts[parts.length - 1] || '';
  }

  extractGivenNames(fullName) {
    if (!fullName) return [];
    const parts = fullName.trim().split(/\s+/);
    return parts.slice(0, -1);
  }

  mapSexToFHIR(sex) {
    const mapping = {
      M: 'male',
      F: 'female',
      O: 'other',
    };
    return mapping[sex] || 'unknown';
  }

  mapSampleStatusToFHIR(status) {
    const mapping = {
      Available: 'available',
      Withdrawn: 'unavailable',
      Expired: 'unsatisfactory',
      Destroyed: 'unavailable',
    };
    return mapping[status] || 'available';
  }

  mapSampleTypeToSNOMED(sampleType) {
    // Mapeamento básico - pode ser expandido
    const mapping = {
      Sangue: '119297000',
      Urina: '122575003',
      Saliva: '119361006',
      DNA: '118234003',
      RNA: '118234003',
    };
    return mapping[sampleType] || '118234003'; // Default: Specimen
  }

  mapQualityToFHIR(quality) {
    const mapping = {
      0: 'not-assessed',
      1: 'suitable',
      2: 'not-suitable',
    };
    return mapping[quality] || 'not-assessed';
  }

  mapSensorStatusToFHIR(status) {
    const mapping = {
      normal: 'active',
      error: 'inactive',
      maintenance: 'inactive',
    };
    return mapping[status] || 'unknown';
  }

  mapReadingStatusToFHIR(status) {
    const mapping = {
      valid: 'final',
      invalid: 'cancelled',
      pending: 'preliminary',
    };
    return mapping[status] || 'final';
  }

  formatDate(date) {
    if (!date) return null;
    if (date instanceof Date) {
      return date.toISOString().split('T')[0];
    }
    if (typeof date === 'string') {
      return date.split('T')[0];
    }
    return null;
  }

  formatDateTime(date) {
    if (!date) return null;
    if (date instanceof Date) {
      return date.toISOString();
    }
    if (typeof date === 'string') {
      return new Date(date).toISOString();
    }
    return null;
  }
}

module.exports = new FHIRService();

const logger = require('../utils/logger');
const { ObjectId } = require('mongodb');

/**
 * Service de Geração HL7
 * Health Level Seven - Padrão de interoperabilidade em saúde
 * 
 * Suporta:
 * - HL7 v2.x (mensagens pipe-delimited)
 * - FHIR R4 (JSON)
 * - CDA (Clinical Document Architecture - XML)
 */
class HL7Service {
  /**
   * Formata data/hora no formato HL7 v2.x (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS)
   */
  formatHL7DateTime(date) {
    if (!date) return '';
    const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
    
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    const hours = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const minutes = String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    const seconds = String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0');
    
    return `${year}${month}${day}${hours}${minutes}${seconds}`;
  }

  /**
   * Formata data no formato HL7 v2.x (YYYYMMDD)
   */
  formatHL7Date(date) {
    if (!date) return '';
    const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
    
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    
    return `${year}${month}${day}`;
  }

  /**
   * Gera mensagem HL7 v2.x para arquivo de análise
   * Formato: Pipe-delimited (|)
   * 
   * Segmentos:
   * - MSH: Message Header
   * - PID: Patient Identification (apenas patientID anonimizado)
   * - OBR: Observation Request
   * - OBX: Observation/Result
   * - SPM: Specimen
   */
  async generateHL7v2Message(db, sampleFile, sample, patientID) {
    try {
      const messageID = this.generateMessageID();
      const timestamp = this.formatHL7DateTime(new Date());
      const facilityName = process.env.FACILITY_NAME || 'BioAdvanceD';
      
      // MSH - Message Header
      const msh = this.buildMSH(messageID, timestamp);
      
      // PID - Patient Identification (LGPD: apenas patientID anonimizado)
      const pid = this.buildPID(patientID);
      
      // SPM - Specimen
      const spm = this.buildSPM(sampleFile, sample);
      
      // OBR - Observation Request
      const obr = this.buildOBR(sampleFile, sample);
      
      // OBX - Observation/Result
      const obx = this.buildOBX(sampleFile, sample);
      
      // Monta mensagem completa
      const message = [
        msh,
        pid,
        spm,
        obr,
        obx
      ].filter(Boolean).join('\r');
      
      return message;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao gerar mensagem HL7 v2.x:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * MSH - Message Header
   * Formato: MSH|^~\\&|SendingApp|SendingFacility|ReceivingApp|ReceivingFacility|DateTime|Security|MessageType|MessageID|ProcessingID|VersionID
   */
  buildMSH(messageID, timestamp) {
    const sendingApp = 'BioAdvanceD';
    const sendingFacility = process.env.FACILITY_NAME || 'BioAdvanceD';
    const receivingApp = '';
    const receivingFacility = '';
    const security = '';
    const messageType = 'ORU^R01^ORU_R01'; // Observation Result (unsolicited)
    const processingID = 'P'; // Production
    const versionID = '2.8';
    
    return `MSH|^~\\&|${sendingApp}|${sendingFacility}|${receivingApp}|${receivingFacility}|${timestamp}|${security}|${messageType}|${messageID}|${processingID}|${versionID}`;
  }

  /**
   * PID - Patient Identification
   * LGPD: Apenas patientID anonimizado (8 dígitos), sem dados pessoais
   */
  buildPID(patientID) {
    const pid2 = ''; // Patient ID (Internal)
    const pid3 = `${patientID}^^^BioAdvanceD^MR`; // Patient Identifier List (anonimizado)
    const pid5 = '^^^' ; // Patient Name (vazio - LGPD)
    const pid7 = ''; // Date/Time of Birth (vazio - LGPD)
    const pid8 = ''; // Administrative Sex (vazio - LGPD)
    
    return `PID|1|${pid2}|${pid3}||${pid5}||${pid7}||${pid8}|||||||||||||||||||||||||`;
  }

  /**
   * SPM - Specimen
   */
  buildSPM(sampleFile, sample) {
    const spmId = sample._id?.toString() || sample.sampleID || '';
    const specimenType = sample.sampleType || '';
    const collectionDateTime = sampleFile.collectionDateTime 
      ? this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.collectionDateTime)
      : (sample.registrationDate ? this.formatHL7DateTime(sample.registrationDate) : '');
    
    return `SPM|1|${spmId}||${specimenType}|||${collectionDateTime}|||||||`;
  }

  /**
   * OBR - Observation Request
   */
  buildOBR(sampleFile, sample) {
    const placerOrderNumber = sampleFile.orderNumber || '';
    const fillerOrderNumber = sampleFile.accessionNumber || sampleFile._id?.toString() || '';
    const universalServiceID = sampleFile.loincCode 
      ? `${sampleFile.loincCode}^${sampleFile.fileType}^LN`
      : `^${sampleFile.fileType}`;
    const observationDateTime = sampleFile.analysisDateTime 
      ? this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.analysisDateTime)
      : (sampleFile.processingDateTime ? this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.processingDateTime) : this.formatHL7DateTime(new Date()));
    const specimenReceivedDateTime = sampleFile.processingDateTime 
      ? this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.processingDateTime)
      : this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.uploadDate || new Date());
    
    return `OBR|1|${placerOrderNumber}|${fillerOrderNumber}||${universalServiceID}|${observationDateTime}||||||${specimenReceivedDateTime}|||||||||||||||||||${sampleFile.resultStatus || 'F'}`;
  }

  /**
   * OBX - Observation/Result
   */
  buildOBX(sampleFile, sample) {
    const valueType = sampleFile.fileType === 'RAW' ? 'ED' : 'TX'; // ED = Encapsulated Data, TX = Text
    const observationID = sampleFile.loincCode || `FILE^${sampleFile.fileType}`;
    const observationValue = sampleFile.resultValue !== null && sampleFile.resultValue !== undefined
      ? `${sampleFile.resultValue}${sampleFile.unitOfMeasure ? `^${sampleFile.unitOfMeasure}` : ''}`
      : sampleFile.fileName;
    const units = sampleFile.unitOfMeasure || '';
    const referencesRange = '';
    const abnormalFlags = this.mapInterpretationToHL7(sampleFile.interpretation);
    const observationResultStatus = sampleFile.resultStatus || 'F'; // F = Final, P = Preliminary, C = Canceled
    
    return `OBX|1|${valueType}|${observationID}|${sampleFile.fileName}||${observationValue}|${units}||${referencesRange}||${abnormalFlags}|||${observationResultStatus}|||${this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.uploadDate || new Date())}||`;
  }

  /**
   * Mapeia interpretação para flags HL7
   * N = Normal, A = Abnormal, H = High, L = Low, HH = Very High, LL = Very Low
   */
  mapInterpretationToHL7(interpretation) {
    if (!interpretation) return '';
    const upper = String(interpretation).toUpperCase();
    const map = {
      'N': 'N',
      'NORMAL': 'N',
      'A': 'A',
      'ABNORMAL': 'A',
      'ANORMAL': 'A',
      'H': 'H',
      'HIGH': 'H',
      'ALTO': 'H',
      'L': 'L',
      'LOW': 'L',
      'BAIXO': 'L',
      'HH': 'HH',
      'VERY HIGH': 'HH',
      'MUITO ALTO': 'HH',
      'LL': 'LL',
      'VERY LOW': 'LL',
      'MUITO BAIXO': 'LL',
      'C': 'C',
      'CRITICAL': 'C',
      'CRÍTICO': 'C'
    };
    return map[upper] || '';
  }

  /**
   * Gera ID único para mensagem HL7
   */
  generateMessageID() {
    const timestamp = Date.now();
    const random = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9).toUpperCase();
    return `MSG${timestamp}${random}`;
  }

  /**
   * Gera Resource FHIR R4 (DiagnosticReport + Observation + Specimen)
   */
  async generateFHIRResource(db, sampleFile, sample, patientID) {
    try {
      const baseUrl = process.env.API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3000';
      const fileID = sampleFile._id?.toString() || '';
      
      // DiagnosticReport
      const diagnosticReport = {
        resourceType: 'DiagnosticReport',
        id: fileID,
        status: this.mapStatusToFHIR(sampleFile.resultStatus),
        category: [{
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0074',
            code: 'LAB',
            display: 'Laboratory'
          }]
        }],
        code: sampleFile.loincCode ? {
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://loinc.org',
            code: sampleFile.loincCode,
            display: sampleFile.fileType
          }]
        } : {
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0074',
            code: 'LAB',
            display: 'Laboratory Analysis'
          }]
        },
        subject: {
          reference: `Patient/${patientID}`,
          identifier: {
            system: `${baseUrl}/fhir/Patient`,
            value: patientID
          }
        },
        effectiveDateTime: sampleFile.analysisDateTime 
          ? (sampleFile.analysisDateTime instanceof Date ? sampleFile.analysisDateTime.toISOString() : new Date(sampleFile.analysisDateTime).toISOString())
          : (sampleFile.uploadDate ? (sampleFile.uploadDate instanceof Date ? sampleFile.uploadDate.toISOString() : new Date(sampleFile.uploadDate).toISOString()) : new Date().toISOString()),
        issued: sampleFile.uploadDate 
          ? (sampleFile.uploadDate instanceof Date ? sampleFile.uploadDate.toISOString() : new Date(sampleFile.uploadDate).toISOString())
          : new Date().toISOString(),
        specimen: [{
          reference: `Specimen/${sample._id?.toString() || sample.sampleID}`
        }],
        result: [{
          reference: `Observation/${fileID}`
        }],
        presentedForm: [{
          contentType: this.getMimeType(sampleFile.fileType),
          url: `${baseUrl}/api/samples/${sample._id?.toString()}/files/${fileID}/download`,
          title: sampleFile.fileName,
          creation: sampleFile.uploadDate 
            ? (sampleFile.uploadDate instanceof Date ? sampleFile.uploadDate.toISOString() : new Date(sampleFile.uploadDate).toISOString())
            : new Date().toISOString()
        }],
        identifier: sampleFile.accessionNumber ? [{
          system: `${baseUrl}/fhir/DiagnosticReport`,
          value: sampleFile.accessionNumber
        }] : [],
        meta: {
          versionId: '1',
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      };

      // Observation
      const observation = {
        resourceType: 'Observation',
        id: fileID,
        status: this.mapStatusToFHIR(sampleFile.resultStatus),
        category: [{
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/observation-category',
            code: 'laboratory',
            display: 'Laboratory'
          }]
        }],
        code: sampleFile.loincCode ? {
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://loinc.org',
            code: sampleFile.loincCode,
            display: sampleFile.fileType
          }]
        } : {
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v2-0074',
            code: sampleFile.fileType,
            display: sampleFile.fileType
          }]
        },
        subject: {
          reference: `Patient/${patientID}`,
          identifier: {
            system: `${baseUrl}/fhir/Patient`,
            value: patientID
          }
        },
        effectiveDateTime: sampleFile.analysisDateTime 
          ? (sampleFile.analysisDateTime instanceof Date ? sampleFile.analysisDateTime.toISOString() : new Date(sampleFile.analysisDateTime).toISOString())
          : new Date().toISOString(),
        issued: sampleFile.uploadDate 
          ? (sampleFile.uploadDate instanceof Date ? sampleFile.uploadDate.toISOString() : new Date(sampleFile.uploadDate).toISOString())
          : new Date().toISOString(),
        valueString: sampleFile.fileName,
        interpretation: sampleFile.interpretation ? [{
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ObservationInterpretation',
            code: this.mapInterpretationToFHIR(sampleFile.interpretation),
            display: sampleFile.interpretation
          }]
        }] : [],
        specimen: {
          reference: `Specimen/${sample._id?.toString() || sample.sampleID}`
        },
        meta: {
          versionId: '1',
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      };

      // Specimen
      const specimen = {
        resourceType: 'Specimen',
        id: sample._id?.toString() || sample.sampleID?.toString() || '',
        type: {
          coding: [{
            system: 'http://snomed.info/sct',
            code: this.mapSampleTypeToSNOMED(sample.sampleType),
            display: sample.sampleType
          }]
        },
        subject: {
          reference: `Patient/${patientID}`,
          identifier: {
            system: `${baseUrl}/fhir/Patient`,
            value: patientID
          }
        },
        collection: {
          collectedDateTime: sample.registrationDate
            ? (sample.registrationDate instanceof Date ? sample.registrationDate.toISOString() : new Date(sample.registrationDate).toISOString())
            : new Date().toISOString()
        },
        identifier: sample.barcode ? [{
          system: `${baseUrl}/fhir/Specimen`,
          value: sample.barcode
        }] : [],
        meta: {
          versionId: '1',
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      };

      // Bundle FHIR
      const bundle = {
        resourceType: 'Bundle',
        id: `bundle-${fileID}`,
        type: 'document',
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        entry: [
          {
            fullUrl: `${baseUrl}/fhir/DiagnosticReport/${fileID}`,
            resource: diagnosticReport
          },
          {
            fullUrl: `${baseUrl}/fhir/Observation/${fileID}`,
            resource: observation
          },
          {
            fullUrl: `${baseUrl}/fhir/Specimen/${sample._id?.toString() || sample.sampleID}`,
            resource: specimen
          }
        ],
        meta: {
          versionId: '1',
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      };

      return bundle;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao gerar resource FHIR:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Gera documento CDA (Clinical Document Architecture)
   */
  async generateCDA(db, sampleFile, sample, patientID) {
    try {
      const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
      const fileID = sampleFile._id?.toString() || '';
      
      // XML CDA básico conforme HL7 CDA Release 2.0
      const cda = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ClinicalDocument xmlns="urn:hl7-org:v3" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <realmCode code="BR"/>
  <typeId root="2.16.840.1.113883.1.3" extension="POCD_HD000040"/>
  <templateId root="2.16.840.1.113883.10.20.22.1.1"/>
  <id root="${fileID}" extension="${sampleFile.accessionNumber || fileID}"/>
  <code code="11502-2" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" codeSystemName="LOINC" displayName="Laboratory Report"/>
  <title>Laboratory Analysis Report</title>
  <effectiveTime value="${this.formatHL7DateTime(new Date())}"/>
  <confidentialityCode code="N" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.5.25"/>
  <languageCode code="pt-BR"/>
  <recordTarget>
    <patientRole>
      <id extension="${patientID}" root="2.16.840.1.113883.3.933"/>
      <!-- LGPD: Apenas ID anonimizado, sem dados pessoais -->
    </patientRole>
  </recordTarget>
  <author>
    <time value="${this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.uploadDate || new Date())}"/>
    <assignedAuthor>
      <id extension="${sampleFile.uploaderAnonId || 'USR-SYSTEM'}" root="2.16.840.1.113883.3.933"/>
    </assignedAuthor>
  </author>
  <custodian>
    <assignedCustodian>
      <representedCustodianOrganization>
        <id root="2.16.840.1.113883.3.933"/>
        <name>${process.env.FACILITY_NAME || 'BioAdvanceD'}</name>
      </representedCustodianOrganization>
    </assignedCustodian>
  </custodian>
  <component>
    <structuredBody>
      <component>
        <section>
          <templateId root="2.16.840.1.113883.10.20.22.2.10"/>
          <code code="26436-6" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" codeSystemName="LOINC" displayName="Laboratory Studies"/>
          <title>Laboratory Analysis</title>
          <text>
            <paragraph>
              <content ID="file-description">File: ${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.fileName)}</content>
              <content>Type: ${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.fileType)}</content>
              <content>Size: ${this.formatFileSize(sampleFile.fileSize)}</content>
              ${sampleFile.loincCode ? `<content>LOINC Code: ${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.loincCode)}</content>` : ''}
              ${sampleFile.procedureCode ? `<content>Procedure Code: ${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.procedureCode)}</content>` : ''}
              ${sampleFile.resultStatus ? `<content>Status: ${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.resultStatus)}</content>` : ''}
              ${sampleFile.interpretation ? `<content>Interpretation: ${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.interpretation)}</content>` : ''}
            </paragraph>
          </text>
          <entry>
            <organizer classCode="BATTERY" moodCode="EVN">
              <code code="26436-6" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" codeSystemName="LOINC"/>
              <statusCode code="completed"/>
              <component>
                <observation classCode="OBS" moodCode="EVN">
                  <code code="${sampleFile.loincCode || 'LAB'}" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" codeSystemName="LOINC" displayName="${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.fileType)}"/>
                  <statusCode code="completed"/>
                  <effectiveTime value="${this.formatHL7DateTime(sampleFile.analysisDateTime || sampleFile.uploadDate || new Date())}"/>
                  ${sampleFile.resultValue !== null && sampleFile.resultValue !== undefined ? `
                  <value xsi:type="PQ" value="${sampleFile.resultValue}" unit="${sampleFile.unitOfMeasure || ''}"/>
                  ` : `
                  <value xsi:type="ED" mediaType="${this.getMimeType(sampleFile.fileType)}">${this.escapeXML(sampleFile.fileName)}</value>
                  `}
                  ${sampleFile.interpretation ? `
                  <interpretationCode code="${this.mapInterpretationToHL7(sampleFile.interpretation)}" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.5.83"/>
                  ` : ''}
                </observation>
              </component>
            </organizer>
          </entry>
        </section>
      </component>
      <component>
        <section>
          <templateId root="2.16.840.1.113883.10.20.22.2.7.1"/>
          <code code="30954-2" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" codeSystemName="LOINC" displayName="Relevant Diagnostic Tests"/>
          <title>Specimen Information</title>
          <text>
            <paragraph>
              <content>Sample ID: ${this.escapeXML(String(sample._id || sample.sampleID || ''))}</content>
              <content>Sample Type: ${this.escapeXML(sample.sampleType || '')}</content>
              ${sample.barcode ? `<content>Barcode: ${this.escapeXML(sample.barcode)}</content>` : ''}
              ${sample.registrationDate ? `<content>Collection Date: ${this.formatHL7Date(sample.registrationDate)}</content>` : ''}
            </paragraph>
          </text>
        </section>
      </component>
    </structuredBody>
  </component>
</ClinicalDocument>`;
      
      return cda;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao gerar documento CDA:', error.message);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Mapeia status para FHIR
   */
  mapStatusToFHIR(status) {
    if (!status) return 'final';
    const upper = String(status).toUpperCase();
    const map = {
      'F': 'final',
      'FINAL': 'final',
      'P': 'preliminary',
      'PRELIMINARY': 'preliminary',
      'PRELIMINAR': 'preliminary',
      'C': 'cancelled',
      'CANCELED': 'cancelled',
      'CANCELADO': 'cancelled'
    };
    return map[upper] || 'final';
  }

  /**
   * Mapeia interpretação para FHIR
   */
  mapInterpretationToFHIR(interpretation) {
    if (!interpretation) return 'N';
    const upper = String(interpretation).toUpperCase();
    const map = {
      'N': 'N',
      'NORMAL': 'N',
      'A': 'A',
      'ABNORMAL': 'A',
      'ANORMAL': 'A',
      'H': 'H',
      'HIGH': 'H',
      'ALTO': 'H',
      'L': 'L',
      'LOW': 'L',
      'BAIXO': 'L',
      'HH': 'HH',
      'VERY HIGH': 'HH',
      'MUITO ALTO': 'HH',
      'LL': 'LL',
      'VERY LOW': 'LL',
      'MUITO BAIXO': 'LL',
      'C': 'CRIT',
      'CRITICAL': 'CRIT',
      'CRÍTICO': 'CRIT'
    };
    return map[upper] || 'N';
  }

  /**
   * Mapeia tipo de amostra para código SNOMED CT (simplificado)
   */
  mapSampleTypeToSNOMED(sampleType) {
    if (!sampleType) return '119297000'; // Body substance (default)
    const map = {
      'Sangue': '420135007', // Blood specimen
      'Urina': '122575003', // Urine specimen
      'Saliva': '258467004', // Saliva specimen
      'Tecido': '119361006', // Tissue specimen
      'DNA': '119297000', // Body substance
      'RNA': '119297000', // Body substance
      'Plasma': '119361006', // Tissue specimen
      'Soro': '119297000' // Body substance
    };
    return map[sampleType] || '119297000';
  }

  /**
   * Obtém MIME type baseado no tipo de arquivo
   */
  getMimeType(fileType) {
    const map = {
      'RAW': 'application/octet-stream',
      'ZIP': 'application/zip',
      'CSV': 'text/csv',
      'XLS': 'application/vnd.ms-excel',
      'XLSX': 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
      'PDF': 'application/pdf',
      'TXT': 'text/plain'
    };
    return map[fileType] || 'application/octet-stream';
  }

  /**
   * Escapa XML para prevenir injection
   */
  escapeXML(str) {
    if (!str) return '';
    return String(str)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
      .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
      .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
      .replace(/'/g, '&apos;');
  }

  /**
   * Formata tamanho de arquivo
   */
  formatFileSize(bytes) {
    if (!bytes || bytes === 0) return '0 bytes';
    const k = 1024;
    const sizes = ['bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
    return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];
  }
}

module.exports = new HL7Service();

const crypto = require('crypto');
const logger = require('../utils/logger');
const fs = require('fs');

function sha256Hex(input) {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(String(input)).digest('hex');
}

class HL7AuditService {
  constructor() {
    this.LOG_TYPE = 'HL7_HASH';
  }

  async _hashFHIRResources(db, date) {
    const samplesCol = db.collection('amostras');
    // search for samples with a 'fhir' field and createdAt on date
    const start = new Date(date + 'T00:00:00.000Z');
    const end = new Date(date + 'T23:59:59.999Z');

    const docs = await samplesCol.find({ 'fhir': { $exists: true }, createdAt: { $gte: start, $lte: end } }).toArray();
    const results = [];
    for (const doc of docs) {
      try {
        const json = JSON.stringify(doc.fhir);
        const hash = sha256Hex(json);
        results.push({ type: 'fhir', sampleId: doc._id, hash, doc });
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('Erro ao gerar hash FHIR da amostra:', err.message || err);
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  async _hashHL7Files(db, date) {
    const filesCol = db.collection('sample_files');
    const start = new Date(date + 'T00:00:00.000Z');
    const end = new Date(date + 'T23:59:59.999Z');

    // Find files that likely are HL7 (fileType contains 'hl7' or filename ends with .hl7)
    const candidates = await filesCol.find({
      uploadDate: { $gte: start, $lte: end },
      $or: [ { fileType: /hl7/i }, { fileName: /\.hl7$/i } ]
    }).toArray();

    const results = [];
    for (const f of candidates) {
      try {
        if (f.storagePath && fs.existsSync(f.storagePath)) {
          const content = fs.readFileSync(f.storagePath, 'utf8');
          const hash = sha256Hex(content);
          results.push({ type: 'hl7', fileId: f._id, hash, file: f });
        } else {
          // Fallback to fileName+meta hashing
          const hash = sha256Hex(f.fileName + '|' + (f.fileSize || 0));
          results.push({ type: 'hl7', fileId: f._id, hash, note: 'arquivo não encontrado em disco' });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        logger.error('Erro ao gerar hash do arquivo HL7:', err.message || err);
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  async buildHL7HashesForDate(date, db) {
    const fhir = await this._hashFHIRResources(db, date);
    const hl7 = await this._hashHL7Files(db, date);

    // Insert logs for each hash if not already present
    const logsCol = db.collection('logs');
    const inserted = [];
    for (const item of [...fhir, ...hl7]) {
      const existing = await logsCol.findOne({ 'payload.sourceId': item.sampleId || item.fileId, 'action': this.LOG_TYPE });
      if (existing) continue;

      const payload = { type: item.type, sourceId: item.sampleId || item.fileId };
      const logDoc = {
        date: date,
        timestampISO: new Date().toISOString(),
        action: this.LOG_TYPE,
        entity: 'HL7Audit',
        message: `Hash ${item.type}`,
        payload,
        auditHash: item.hash,
        createdAt: new Date()
      };
      await logsCol.insertOne(logDoc);
      inserted.push(logDoc);
    }

    return { fhir, hl7, inserted };
  }

  async buildHL7MerkleForDate(date, db) {
    // Ensure HL7/FHIR hashes are present in logs
    await this.buildHL7HashesForDate(date, db);

    // Use integrityCheckService to build merkle over logs (it already reads logs.auditHash)
    const integrityService = require('./integrityCheckService');
    const res = await integrityService.buildMerkleForDate(date, db);
    return res; // {date, root, leaves, docs, getProofForHash}
  }
}

module.exports = new HL7AuditService();

const { getQueue } = require('../config/queue');
const ImportJob = require('../models/ImportJob');
const ImportMetrics = require('../models/ImportMetrics');
const fhirService = require('./fhir.service');
const fhirValidator = require('./fhir-validator.service');
const logger = require('../utils/logger');
const { v4: uuidv4 } = require('uuid');
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const notificationService = require('./notification.service');
const csv = require('csv-parser');
let XLSX;

/**
 * Serviço de Importação Assíncrona
 * Gerencia jobs na fila e processamento assíncrono
 */

class ImportAsyncService {
  /**
   * Valida arquivo e retorna metadata
   */
  async validateFile(file, dataType) {
    const errors = [];
    const metadata = {
      fileName: file.originalname,
      fileSize: file.size,
      mimeType: file.mimetype,
      extension: path.extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase(),
      rowCount: 0,
      headers: [],
    };

    // Valida formato
    const validFormats = {
      patients: ['.csv', '.xlsx', '.json'],
      samples: ['.csv', '.xlsx', '.json'],
      results: ['.zip', '.raw', '.csv'],
      temperature: ['.csv'],
      locations: ['.csv', '.json'],
    };

    const validExtensions = validFormats[dataType] || [];
    if (!validExtensions.includes(metadata.extension)) {
      errors.push(`Formato de arquivo inválido. Formatos aceitos: ${validExtensions.join(', ')}`);
    }

    // Valida tamanho (máximo 100MB)
    if (file.size > 100 * 1024 * 1024) {
      errors.push('Arquivo muito grande. Tamanho máximo: 100MB');
    }

    // Valida existência do arquivo
    if (!fs.existsSync(file.path)) {
      errors.push('Arquivo não encontrado');
    }

    // Tenta coletar e normalizar headers antecipadamente para CSV/XLSX
    try {
      if (metadata.extension === '.csv' || metadata.extension === '.xlsx') {
        metadata.headers = await this.getHeadersFromFile(file, dataType);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      logger.warn('Não foi possível normalizar cabeçalhos:', e.message);
    }

    // Validação FHIR para JSON
    if (metadata.extension === '.json') {
      try {
        const raw = fs.readFileSync(file.path, 'utf8');
        const payload = JSON.parse(raw);

        if (fhirValidator.isFhirResource(payload)) {
          const fhirValidation = fhirValidator.validatePayload(payload, ['Patient', 'Specimen', 'Observation', 'Organization', 'Bundle']);
          metadata.fhir = true;
          metadata.fhirResourcesValidated = fhirValidation.resourcesValidated || 0;

          if (!fhirValidation.valid) {
            const operationOutcome = fhirValidator.buildOperationOutcome(fhirValidation.issues || []);
            metadata.operationOutcome = operationOutcome;
            errors.push(...(fhirValidation.issues || []).map(issue => issue.diagnostics));
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        errors.push(error.message || 'Arquivo JSON inválido');
      }
    }

    return {
      valid: errors.length === 0,
      errors,
      metadata,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Normaliza texto de header: remove BOM, espaços, acentos e parênteses; lower-case
   */
  normalizeHeader(header) {
    if (header === undefined || header === null) return '';
    let s = String(header).replace(/^[\uFEFF]/, '').trim().toLowerCase();
    s = s.replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)\s*/g, ' ');
    s = s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
    s = s.replace(/\s+/g, '');
    s = s.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
    return s;
  }

  /**
   * Mapeia aliases para a chave canônica
   */
  canonicalizeHeader(original) {
    const normalized = this.normalizeHeader(original);
    const fieldMapping = {
      // patientId aliases
      patientid: 'patientID',
      idpaciente: 'patientID',
      idpaciente: 'patientID',
      // sampleType aliases
      sampletype: 'sampleType',
      tipoamostra: 'sampleType',
      // collection/registration date aliases
      collectiondate: 'registrationDate',
      datacoleta: 'registrationDate',
      registerdate: 'registrationDate',
      // location aliases
      locationid: 'locationID',
      idlocalizacao: 'locationID',
      equipmenttype: 'equipmentType',
      tipoequipamento: 'equipmentType',
      equipmentid: 'equipmentID',
      idequipamento: 'equipmentID',
      block: 'block',
      bloco: 'block',
      rack: 'rack',
      prateleira: 'rack',
      drawer: 'drawer',
      gaveta: 'drawer',
      box: 'box',
      caixa: 'box',
      wellposition: 'wellPosition',
      eppendorfwell: 'wellPosition',
    };
    return fieldMapping[normalized] || (typeof original === 'string' ? original.trim() : normalized);
  }

  /**
   * Encontra índice da linha de cabeçalhos em XLSX
   */
  findHeaderRow(sheetRows, dataType) {
    const candidates = new Set([
      'patientid', 'sampletype', 'sampleorigin', 'extractionprotocol',
      'equipmenttype', 'block', 'rack', 'drawer', 'box'
    ]);
    for (let i = 0; i < sheetRows.length; i++) {
      const row = sheetRows[i];
      if (!Array.isArray(row)) continue;
      const normalizedRow = row.map(h => this.normalizeHeader(h));
      const hit = normalizedRow.some(h => candidates.has(h));
      if (hit) return i;
    }
    return -1;
  }

  /**
   * Lê headers de arquivo CSV/XLSX e aplica canonicalização
   */
  async getHeadersFromFile(file, dataType) {
    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();
    if (ext === '.csv') {
      return await new Promise((resolve) => {
        let resolved = false;
        fs.createReadStream(file.path)
          .pipe(csv())
          .on('headers', (headers) => {
            if (resolved) return;
            const canonical = headers.map(h => this.canonicalizeHeader(h));
            resolved = true;
            resolve(canonical);
          })
          .on('error', () => resolve([]))
          .on('end', () => {
            if (!resolved) resolve([]);
          });
      });
    }

    if (ext === '.xlsx') {
      try {
        if (!XLSX) XLSX = require('xlsx');
        const workbook = XLSX.readFile(file.path, { cellDates: true });
        let sheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
        const ws = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
        const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { defval: null, raw: false, header: 1 }) || [];
        const headerIndex = this.findHeaderRow(rows, dataType);
        if (headerIndex === -1) return [];
        const headers = (rows[headerIndex] || []).map(h => this.canonicalizeHeader(h));
        return headers;
      } catch (e) {
        logger.warn('Falha ao ler headers XLSX:', e.message);
        return [];
      }
    }

    return [];
  }

  /**
   * Cria job de importação na fila
   */
  async createImportJob(db, userID, file, dataType, options = {}) {
    try {
      const queue = getQueue();
      const jobID = uuidv4();

      // Valida arquivo
      const validation = await this.validateFile(file, dataType);
      if (!validation.valid) {
        // Notifica falha imediata com jobID gerado, sem enfileirar
        await notificationService.notifyJobFailed(userID, {
          jobID,
          status: 'failed',
          dataType,
          fileName: file.originalname,
          error: validation.errors.join(', '),
          completedAt: new Date(),
        });
        throw new Error(`Validação falhou: ${validation.errors.join(', ')}`);
      }

      // Cria job no banco
      const jobData = {
        jobID,
        userID,
        dataType,
        filePath: file.path,
        fileName: file.originalname,
        fileSize: file.size,
        status: 'pending',
        progress: 0,
        metadata: validation.metadata,
        options,
      };

      const job = ImportJob.create(jobData);
      const validationResult = ImportJob.validate(jobData);
      if (!validationResult.isValid) {
        throw new Error(`Dados do job inválidos: ${validationResult.errors.join(', ')}`);
      }

      // Salva job no banco
      const jobsCollection = db.collection('importJobs');
      await jobsCollection.insertOne({
        ...job.toJSON(),
        createdAt: new Date(),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      });

      // Adiciona job na fila
      const queueJob = await queue.add(
        'import',
        {
          jobID,
          userID,
          dataType,
          filePath: file.path,
          fileName: file.originalname,
          fileSize: file.size,
          options,
        },
        {
          jobId: jobID,
          priority: options.priority || 0,
        }
      );

      logger.info(`Job ${jobID} criado na fila`);

      // Notifica que job foi enfileirado
      await notificationService.notifyJobQueued(userID, {
        jobID,
        status: 'pending',
        dataType,
        fileName: file.originalname,
        progress: 0,
      });

      return {
        jobID,
        status: 'pending',
        message: 'Job criado com sucesso',
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao criar job de importação:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Obtém status do job
   */
  async getJobStatus(db, jobID) {
    try {
      const jobsCollection = db.collection('importJobs');
      const job = await jobsCollection.findOne({ jobID });

      if (!job) {
        throw new Error('Job não encontrado');
      }

      // Tenta obter status atualizado da fila
      const queue = getQueue();
      let queueJob = null;
      try {
        queueJob = await queue.getJob(jobID);
      } catch (err) {
        // Job pode não estar mais na fila
      }

      if (queueJob) {
        const state = await queueJob.getState();
        const progress = queueJob.progress || 0;

        // Atualiza status no banco se necessário
        if (state !== job.status) {
          await jobsCollection.updateOne(
            { jobID },
            {
              $set: {
                status: state,
                progress: progress,
                updatedAt: new Date(),
              },
            }
          );
          job.status = state;
          job.progress = progress;
        }
      }

      return job;
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao obter status do job:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Lista jobs
   */
  async listJobs(db, filters = {}) {
    try {
      const jobsCollection = db.collection('importJobs');
      const query = {};

      if (filters.userID) {
        query.userID = filters.userID;
      }

      if (filters.dataType) {
        query.dataType = filters.dataType;
      }

      if (filters.status) {
        query.status = filters.status;
      }

      const limit = parseInt(filters.limit || '50', 10);
      const skip = parseInt(filters.skip || '0', 10);

      const jobs = await jobsCollection
        .find(query)
        .sort({ createdAt: -1 })
        .limit(limit)
        .skip(skip)
        .toArray();

      const total = await jobsCollection.countDocuments(query);

      return {
        jobs,
        total,
        limit,
        skip,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao listar jobs:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Cancela job
   */
  async cancelJob(db, jobID) {
    try {
      const queue = getQueue();
      const queueJob = await queue.getJob(jobID);

      if (queueJob) {
        await queueJob.remove();
      }

      const jobsCollection = db.collection('importJobs');
      await jobsCollection.updateOne(
        { jobID },
        {
          $set: {
            status: 'cancelled',
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          },
        }
      );

      return { success: true, message: 'Job cancelado com sucesso' };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao cancelar job:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Salva métricas de importação
   */
  async saveMetrics(db, jobData) {
    try {
      const metricsCollection = db.collection('importMetrics');

      const metrics = ImportMetrics.create({
        jobID: jobData.jobID,
        userID: jobData.userID,
        dataType: jobData.dataType,
        date: new Date(),
        totalJobs: 1,
        totalRecords: jobData.totalRecords || 0,
        successCount: jobData.successCount || 0,
        errorCount: jobData.errorCount || 0,
        averageProcessingTime: jobData.processingTime || 0,
        fhirResourcesCreated: jobData.fhirResourcesCreated || 0,
        fhirResourcesUpdated: jobData.fhirResourcesUpdated || 0,
      });

      await metricsCollection.insertOne(metrics.toJSON());

      // Atualiza métricas consolidadas (agregação diária)
      await this.updateConsolidatedMetrics(db, jobData);

      logger.info(`Métricas salvas para job ${jobData.jobID}`);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao salvar métricas:', error);
      // Não lança erro para não interromper o processamento
    }
  }

  /**
   * Atualiza métricas consolidadas
   */
  async updateConsolidatedMetrics(db, jobData) {
    try {
      const metricsCollection = db.collection('importMetrics');
      const today = new Date();
      today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

      const consolidated = await metricsCollection.findOne({
        date: { $gte: today, $lt: new Date(today.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) },
        dataType: jobData.dataType,
        jobID: null, // Métricas consolidadas não têm jobID
      });

      if (consolidated) {
        await metricsCollection.updateOne(
          { _id: consolidated._id },
          {
            $inc: {
              totalJobs: 1,
              totalRecords: jobData.totalRecords || 0,
              successCount: jobData.successCount || 0,
              errorCount: jobData.errorCount || 0,
              fhirResourcesCreated: jobData.fhirResourcesCreated || 0,
              fhirResourcesUpdated: jobData.fhirResourcesUpdated || 0,
            },
            $set: {
              updatedAt: new Date(),
            },
          }
        );
      } else {
        const newConsolidated = ImportMetrics.create({
          jobID: null,
          userID: null,
          dataType: jobData.dataType,
          date: today,
          totalJobs: 1,
          totalRecords: jobData.totalRecords || 0,
          successCount: jobData.successCount || 0,
          errorCount: jobData.errorCount || 0,
          averageProcessingTime: jobData.processingTime || 0,
          fhirResourcesCreated: jobData.fhirResourcesCreated || 0,
          fhirResourcesUpdated: jobData.fhirResourcesUpdated || 0,
        });

        await metricsCollection.insertOne(newConsolidated.toJSON());
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao atualizar métricas consolidadas:', error);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Obtém relatório do job
   */
  async getJobReport(db, jobID) {
    try {
      const job = await this.getJobStatus(db, jobID);

      return {
        jobID: job.jobID,
        status: job.status,
        dataType: job.dataType,
        fileName: job.fileName,
        totalRecords: job.totalRecords,
        successCount: job.successCount,
        errorCount: job.errorCount,
        errors: job.errors,
        progress: job.progress,
        createdAt: job.createdAt,
        startedAt: job.startedAt,
        completedAt: job.completedAt,
        fhirResources: job.fhirResources || [],
      };
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao obter relatório do job:', error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Limpa arquivo temporário
   */
  cleanupFile(filePath) {
    try {
      if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Erro ao limpar arquivo temporário:', error.message);
    }
  }
}
