import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Archive, File, FileImage, FileText, UploadCloud, Barcode, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Loader } from 'lucide-react';
import Button from './UI/Button';
import Input from './UI/Input';
import { analysisFileService } from '../services/api';
import './AnalysisUpload.css';

const formatBytes = (bytes) => {
  if (!bytes && bytes !== 0) return '';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];
  let value = bytes;
  let index = 0;
  while (value >= 1024 && index < units.length - 1) {
    value /= 1024;
    index += 1;
  }
  return `${value.toFixed(2)} ${units[index]}`;
};

const getExtension = (name) => {
  const parts = String(name || '').toLowerCase().split('.');
  return parts.length > 1 ? `.${parts.pop()}` : '';
};

const getFileIcon = (extension) => {
  if (['.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'].includes(extension)) {
    return FileImage;
  }
  if (['.pdf', '.txt', '.csv', '.raw', '.fcs'].includes(extension)) {
    return FileText;
  }
  if (['.zip', '.rar'].includes(extension)) {
    return Archive;
  }
  return File;
};

export default function AnalysisUpload({ sampleId: initialSampleId = '' }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState(null);
  const [sampleId, setSampleId] = useState(initialSampleId);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
  const [validating, setValidating] = useState(false);
  const [validated, setValidated] = useState(null);
  const [qrScanMode, setQrScanMode] = useState(false);

  const extension = useMemo(() => getExtension(file?.name), [file]);
  const FileIcon = useMemo(() => getFileIcon(extension), [extension]);

  const handleFileChange = (event) => {
    const selectedFile = event.target.files?.[0] || null;
    setFile(selectedFile);
    setProgress(0);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');
  };

  const validateSampleId = async (id) => {
    if (!id || id.trim() === '') {
      setValidated(null);
      return;
    }

    setValidating(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await analysisFileService.validateSample(id);
      
      if (response.success) {
        setValidated({
          success: true,
          sample: response.sample,
          patient: response.patient
        });
      } else {
        setValidated({
          success: false,
          error: response.error || 'Falha na validação'
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const errorMessage = err?.response?.data?.error || err?.message || 'Erro ao validar amostra';
      setValidated({
        success: false,
        error: errorMessage
      });
    } finally {
      setValidating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSampleIdChange = async (event) => {
    const value = event.target.value;
    setSampleId(value);
    
    // Valida apenas após parar de digitar (com delay)
    if (value.trim().length > 0) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (value === sampleId) { // Verifica se o valor não mudou
          validateSampleId(value);
        }
      }, 800);
    } else {
      setValidated(null);
    }
  };

  const handleQrInput = async (event) => {
    const scannedValue = event.target.value.trim();
    if (scannedValue) {
      setSampleId(scannedValue);
      await validateSampleId(scannedValue);
      setQrScanMode(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = async () => {
    if (!file) {
      setError('Selecione um arquivo para upload');
      return;
    }
    if (!sampleId) {
      setError('Informe o ID da amostra');
      return;
    }
    if (!validated?.success) {
      setError('Valide a amostra antes de enviar');
      return;
    }

    setUploading(true);
    setError('');
    setSuccess('');

    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('sampleId', sampleId);

      await analysisFileService.upload(formData, (event) => {
        if (!event.total) return;
        const percent = Math.round((event.loaded * 100) / event.total);
        setProgress(percent);
      });

      setSuccess('Arquivo enviado com sucesso');
      setFile(null);
      setProgress(0);
      setSampleId('');
      setValidated(null);
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err?.response?.data?.error || err?.message || 'Erro ao enviar arquivo';
      setError(message);
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="analysis-upload">
      <div className="analysis-upload-header">
        <div>
          <h3 className="analysis-upload-title">Upload de Arquivo de Analise</h3>
          <p className="analysis-upload-subtitle">Envie imagens, documentos e dados brutos com acompanhamento de progresso.</p>
        </div>
        <UploadCloud size={24} className="analysis-upload-icon" />
      </div>

      <div className="analysis-upload-grid">
        <div className="analysis-upload-field">
          <label htmlFor="analysis-file">Arquivo</label>
          <input
            id="analysis-file"
            type="file"
            onChange={handleFileChange}
            disabled={uploading}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="analysis-upload-field">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
            <label>ID da Amostra</label>
            <button 
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setQrScanMode(!qrScanMode)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: '4px',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                fontSize: '12px',
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: '#0066cc',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}
            >
              <Barcode size={14} /> QR Code
            </button>
          </div>
          
          {qrScanMode ? (
            <Input
              autoFocus
              type="text"
              onBlur={() => setQrScanMode(false)}
              onChange={handleQrInput}
              placeholder="Escaneie o código de barras/QR code"
              disabled={uploading}
            />
          ) : (
            <Input
              value={sampleId}
              onChange={handleSampleIdChange}
              placeholder="Digite o ID, código de barras ou escaneie QR code"
              disabled={uploading}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Validação Status */}
      {validating && (
        <div className="analysis-upload-validating">
          <Loader size={16} style={{ animation: 'spin 1s linear infinite' }} />
          <span>Validando amostra...</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {validated && (
        <div className={`analysis-upload-validation ${validated.success ? 'success' : 'error'}`}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
            {validated.success ? (
              <>
                <CheckCircle size={18} style={{ color: '#22c55e' }} />
                <div style={{ fontSize: '14px', color: '#16a34a' }}>
                  <strong>✓ Amostra válida:</strong> {validated.sample.sampleID} ({validated.sample.barcode})
                  <br />
                  <small>Paciente com consentimento assinado</small>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <AlertCircle size={18} style={{ color: '#ef4444' }} />
                <div style={{ fontSize: '14px', color: '#991b1b' }}>
                  <strong>✗ Erro:</strong> {validated.error}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {file && (
        <div className="analysis-upload-file">
          <div className="analysis-upload-file-icon">
            <FileIcon size={20} />
          </div>
          <div className="analysis-upload-file-details">
            <div className="analysis-upload-file-name">{file.name}</div>
            <div className="analysis-upload-file-meta">
              <span>{extension || 'Sem extensao'}</span>
              <span>{formatBytes(file.size)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="analysis-upload-progress">
        <div className="analysis-upload-progress-bar">
          <div
            className="analysis-upload-progress-fill"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <span className="analysis-upload-progress-label">{progress}%</span>
      </div>

      {error && <div className="analysis-upload-error">{error}</div>}
      {success && <div className="analysis-upload-success">{success}</div>}

      <Button 
        variant="primary" 
        onClick={handleUpload} 
        disabled={uploading || !validated?.success}
      >
        {uploading ? 'Enviando...' : 'Enviar Arquivo'}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Modal from './UI/Modal';
import Input from './UI/Input';
import Select from './UI/Select';
import Button from './UI/Button';
import Card from './UI/Card';
import { useSamples } from '../hooks/useSamples';
import { useEquipment } from '../hooks/useEquipment';
import { useAnalysisTypes } from '../hooks/useAnalysisTypes';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { resultService } from '../services/api';
import { Sample } from '../types/models';
import { ANALYSIS_METHODS } from '../constants/labOptions';

type AnalysisUploadModalProps = {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  sampleId?: string;
  inline?: boolean;
};

export default function AnalysisUploadModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  sampleId,
  inline = false,
}: AnalysisUploadModalProps) {
  const { samples } = useSamples();
  const { equipment } = useEquipment();
  const { types, loading: loadingTypes, error: typesError } = useAnalysisTypes();
  const { user, hasRole } = useAuth();

  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [analysisType, setAnalysisType] = useState('');
  const [equipmentId, setEquipmentId] = useState('');
  const [method, setMethod] = useState('');
  const [researcher, setResearcher] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [sampleInput, setSampleInput] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [showValidation, setShowValidation] = useState(false);

  const resolvedSampleId = sampleId || sampleInput;
  const canEditResearcher = hasRole(['Administrador']) || user?.roleName === 'Administrador';

  const equipmentOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!equipment || equipment.length === 0) {
      return [{ value: '', label: 'Nenhum equipamento disponível' }];
    }
    return [
      { value: '', label: 'Selecione o equipamento' },
      ...equipment.map((e) => ({
        value: String(e.equipmentID),
        label: `${e.equipmentDescription || 'Equipamento'} (${e.equipmentID})`,
      })),
    ];
  }, [equipment]);

  const methodOptions = useMemo(() => {
    return [
      { value: '', label: 'Selecione o método' },
      ...ANALYSIS_METHODS.map((analysisMethod) => ({
        value: analysisMethod,
        label: analysisMethod,
      }))
    ];
  }, []);

  const analysisTypeOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (loadingTypes) {
      return [{ value: '', label: 'Carregando opções...' }];
    }

    if (!types || types.length === 0) {
      return [{ value: '', label: 'Nenhum tipo disponível' }];
    }

    return [
      { value: '', label: 'Selecione o tipo' },
      ...types.map((type) => ({
        value: type.code,
        label: type.name,
      }))
    ];
  }, [types, loadingTypes]);

  const sampleOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!samples || samples.length === 0) return [];
    return samples.map((s: Sample) => ({
      value: String(s.sampleID || s._id || ''),
      label: `${s.sampleID || s._id} ${s.barcode ? `• ${s.barcode}` : ''}`,
    }));
  }, [samples]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setError('');
      setFile(null);
      setAnalysisType('');
      setEquipmentId('');
      setMethod('');
      setDescription('');
      setSubmitting(false);
      setShowValidation(false);
      setResearcher(
        user?.name || user?.username || user?.email || ''
      );
      if (sampleId) {
        setSampleInput(sampleId);
      } else {
        setSampleInput('');
      }
    }
  }, [isOpen, sampleId, user]);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!isFormValid) {
      setShowValidation(true);
      setError('');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError('');
    setShowValidation(false);

    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('analysisType', analysisType);
      formData.append('sampleID', resolvedSampleId);
      formData.append('method', method.trim());
      formData.append('responsibleResearcher', researcher.trim());
      formData.append('description', description.trim());
      formData.append('equipmentID', equipmentId);

      await resultService.upload(formData);
      onSuccess?.();
      onClose();
      setFile(null);
      setAnalysisType('');
      setEquipmentId('');
      setMethod('');
      setDescription('');
      if (!sampleId) setSampleInput('');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Erro ao enviar arquivo');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const isFormValid = Boolean(
    file &&
    analysisType &&
    resolvedSampleId &&
    method &&
    researcher.trim() &&
    equipmentId
  );

  const fileError = showValidation && !file ? 'Selecione um arquivo' : '';
  const analysisTypeError = showValidation && !analysisType ? 'Selecione o tipo de análise' : '';
  const equipmentError = showValidation && !equipmentId ? 'Selecione o equipamento utilizado' : '';
  const methodError = showValidation && !method ? 'Selecione o método/protocolo' : '';
  const researcherError = showValidation && !researcher.trim() ? 'Informe o pesquisador responsável' : '';
  const sampleError = showValidation && !resolvedSampleId ? 'Selecione a amostra' : '';

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const formContent = (
    <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '1rem' }}>
        {error && (
          <div style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="analysis-upload-file">Arquivo</label>
          <input
            id="analysis-upload-file"
            type="file"
            onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
            disabled={submitting}
          />
          {fileError && (
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
              {fileError}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>Tipo de Análise</label>
          <Select
            value={analysisType}
            onChange={(e) => setAnalysisType(e.target.value)}
            options={analysisTypeOptions}
            error={analysisTypeError}
            disabled={loadingTypes}
          />
          {typesError && (
            <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
              {typesError}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>Equipamento Utilizado</label>
          <Select
            value={equipmentId}
            onChange={(e) => setEquipmentId(e.target.value)}
            options={equipmentOptions}
            error={equipmentError}
            disabled={!equipment || equipment.length === 0}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>Método / Protocolo</label>
          <Select
            value={method}
            onChange={(e) => setMethod(e.target.value)}
            options={methodOptions}
            error={methodError}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label>Pesquisador Responsável</label>
          <Input
            value={researcher}
            onChange={(e) => setResearcher(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Pesquisador"
            error={researcherError}
            disabled={!canEditResearcher}
          />
        </div>

        {!sampleId && (
          <div>
            <label>ID da Amostra</label>
            <Input
              list="sample-list"
              value={sampleInput}
              onChange={(e) => setSampleInput(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Digite ou selecione a amostra"
              error={sampleError}
              helperText="Selecione um ID cadastrado ou digite manualmente"
            />
            <datalist id="sample-list">
              {sampleOptions.map((s) => (
                <option key={s.value} value={s.value}>
                  {s.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </datalist>
          </div>
        )}

        {sampleId && (
          <div>
            <label>ID da Amostra</label>
            <Input value={sampleId} disabled />
          </div>
        )}

        <div>
          <label>Descrição / Observações</label>
          <textarea
            value={description}
            onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
            rows={4}
            style={{
              width: '100%',
              padding: '0.5rem',
              borderRadius: '4px',
              border: '1px solid var(--border)',
            }}
            placeholder="Observações"
          />
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose} disabled={submitting}>
            Cancelar
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={submitting || !isFormValid}>
            {submitting ? 'Enviando...' : 'Enviar'}
          </Button>
        </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (inline) {
    return (
      <Card style={{ marginBottom: '2rem' }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <h2 style={{ margin: 0 }}>Enviar Arquivo de Análise</h2>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onClose} disabled={submitting}>
            Ocultar
          </Button>
        </div>
        {formContent}
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="Enviar Arquivo de Análise">
      {formContent}
    </Modal>
  );
}

          </div>
          <StatusBadge status={status} />
        </div>

import { CSSProperties, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import SignatureCanvas from 'react-signature-canvas';
import Button from '../UI/Button';

type SignaturePadProps = {
  onConfirm: (dataUrl: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  confirmDisabled?: boolean;
  confirmLabel?: string;
};

const styles: Record<string, CSSProperties> = {
  container: {
    display: 'flex',
    flexDirection: 'column',
    gap: '1rem'
  },
  canvasWrapper: {
    border: '2px dashed #c7d2fe',
    borderRadius: '12px',
    backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
    padding: '0.5rem',
    minHeight: '220px'
  },
  canvas: {
    width: '100%',
    height: '220px'
  },
  actions: {
    display: 'flex',
    gap: '0.75rem',
    justifyContent: 'flex-end',
    flexWrap: 'wrap'
  },
  helperText: {
    fontSize: '0.85rem',
    color: '#b00020'
  },
  hint: {
    fontSize: '0.85rem',
    color: '#6b7280'
  }
};

export default function SignaturePad({
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
  confirmDisabled,
  confirmLabel
}: SignaturePadProps) {
  const signatureRef = useRef<SignatureCanvas | null>(null);
  const [hasSignature, setHasSignature] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState('');

  const handleEnd = () => {
    const isEmpty = signatureRef.current?.isEmpty() ?? true;
    setHasSignature(!isEmpty);
    if (!isEmpty) {
      setErrorMessage('');
    }
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    signatureRef.current?.clear();
    setHasSignature(false);
    setErrorMessage('');
  };

  const handleConfirm = () => {
    const isEmpty = signatureRef.current?.isEmpty() ?? true;
    if (isEmpty) {
      setErrorMessage('Por favor, assine antes de confirmar.');
      return;
    }
    const dataUrl = signatureRef.current?.toDataURL('image/png');
    if (dataUrl) {
      onConfirm(dataUrl);
      handleClear();
    }
  };

  const isConfirmDisabled = useMemo(() => (confirmDisabled ?? false) || !hasSignature, [confirmDisabled, hasSignature]);

  return (
    <div style={styles.container}>
      <div style={styles.canvasWrapper} aria-label="Area de assinatura">
        <SignatureCanvas
          ref={signatureRef}
          penColor="#1f2937"
          onEnd={handleEnd}
          canvasProps={{ style: styles.canvas }}
        />
      </div>

      <span style={styles.hint}>Use o dedo ou caneta para assinar.</span>
      {errorMessage && <span style={styles.helperText}>{errorMessage}</span>}

      <div style={styles.actions}>
        <Button variant="danger" onClick={handleClear} type="button">
          Limpar
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel} type="button">
          Cancelar
        </Button>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleConfirm} disabled={isConfirmDisabled} type="button">
          {confirmLabel || 'Confirmar Assinatura'}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { CSSProperties, useMemo } from 'react';

export type ConsentStatus = 'GRANTED' | 'PENDING' | 'REVOKED' | 'EXPIRED' | string;

type StatusBadgeProps = {
  status?: ConsentStatus;
};

type BadgePalette = {
  bg: string;
  fg: string;
  label: string;
};

const palette: Record<string, BadgePalette> = {
  GRANTED: { bg: '#e1f5eb', fg: '#007a4d', label: 'Assinado' },
  PENDING: { bg: '#fff1db', fg: '#b65a00', label: 'Pendente' },
  REVOKED: { bg: '#ffe3e3', fg: '#b00020', label: 'Revogado' },
  DEFAULT: { bg: '#f1f3f5', fg: '#6b7280', label: 'Expirado' }
};

const styles: Record<string, CSSProperties> = {
  badge: {
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: '0.35rem 0.75rem',
    borderRadius: '999px',
    fontSize: '0.75rem',
    fontWeight: 700,
    letterSpacing: '0.3px',
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
    lineHeight: 1
  }
};

export default function StatusBadge({ status }: StatusBadgeProps) {
  const normalized = useMemo(() => (status || '').toString().trim().toUpperCase(), [status]);
  const colors = palette[normalized] || palette.DEFAULT;
  const badgeStyle: CSSProperties = {
    ...styles.badge,
    backgroundColor: colors.bg,
    color: colors.fg
  };

  return <span style={badgeStyle}>{colors.label}</span>;
}

ARQUIVO: C:\Projeto\BioAvanceD\frontend\src\components\ConsentForm.tsx

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Card from './UI/Card';
import Button from './UI/Button';
import Input from './UI/Input';
import { ConsentPermission } from '../types/models';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import './ConsentForm.css';

interface ConsentFormProps {
  patientName: string;
  templateText: string;
  permissions: ConsentPermission[];
  onSubmit: (payload: { responses: Record<string, boolean>; signatureName: string }) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export default function ConsentForm({
  patientName,
  templateText,
  permissions,
  onSubmit,
  onCancel
}: ConsentFormProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [responses, setResponses] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
  const [signatureName, setSignatureName] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const initialResponses: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    (permissions || []).forEach((permission) => {
      initialResponses[permission.key] = false;
    });
    setResponses(initialResponses);
  }, [permissions]);

  const handleToggle = (key: string) => {
    setResponses((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [key]: !prev[key]
    }));
  };

  const requiredPermissionKeys = useMemo(() => {
    const explicitRequired = (permissions || [])
      .filter((permission) => permission.required)
      .map((permission) => permission.key);

    if (explicitRequired.length > 0) {
      return explicitRequired;
    }

    const normalized = (permissions || []).find((permission) =>
      permission.key?.toLowerCase().includes('terms') ||
      permission.key?.toLowerCase().includes('termos') ||
      permission.label?.toLowerCase().includes('termos gerais')
    );
    return normalized?.key ? [normalized.key] : permissions?.[0]?.key ? [permissions[0].key] : [];
  }, [permissions]);

  const isHtmlContent = useMemo(() => {
    if (!templateText) return false;
    return /<\/?[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(templateText);
  }, [templateText]);

  const hasRequiredConsent = requiredPermissionKeys.length === 0
    ? false
    : requiredPermissionKeys.every((key) => responses[key] === true);
  const hasSignature = signatureName.trim().length > 3;
  const canSubmit = hasRequiredConsent && hasSignature;

  return (
    <div className="consent-form">
      <div className="consent-form-header">
        <h2>{t('consent.form.header')}</h2>
        <p>{t('consent.form.patientLabel')} <strong>{patientName}</strong></p>
      </div>

      <div className="consent-form-grid">
        <Card className="consent-document">
          <div className="consent-content" role="region" aria-label={t('consent.form.contentLabel')}>
            {isHtmlContent ? (
              <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: templateText }} />
            ) : (
              <pre>{templateText}</pre>
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <div className="consent-panel">
          <Card title={t('consent.form.panelTitle')}>
            <div className="consent-permissions">
              {(permissions || []).map((permission) => {
                const isRequired = requiredPermissionKeys.includes(permission.key);
                return (
                  <label key={permission.key} className="consent-switch">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={!!responses[permission.key]}
                      onChange={() => handleToggle(permission.key)}
                    />
                    <span>
                      {permission.label}
                      {isRequired && <strong className="consent-required"> ({t('consent.form.required')})</strong>}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <Input
              label={t('consent.form.signatureLabel')}
              value={signatureName}
              onChange={(event) => setSignatureName(event.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('consent.form.signaturePlaceholder')}
            />

            <div className="consent-actions">
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel}>
                {t('common.cancel')}
              </Button>
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => onSubmit({ responses, signatureName })} disabled={!canSubmit}>
                {t('common.confirm')}
              </Button>
            </div>
            {!hasRequiredConsent && (
              <span className="consent-hint">{t('consent.form.hint')}</span>
            )}
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import styles from './CryoBoxGrid.module.css';

type CryoBoxGridProps = {
  occupiedPositions?: string[]; // ['A1','A2',...]
  selectedPosition?: string | null;
  onSelect?: (position: string) => void;
};

export function CryoBoxGrid({
  occupiedPositions = [],
  selectedPosition = null,
  onSelect,
}: CryoBoxGridProps) {
  const positions = useMemo(() => {
    const list: string[] = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < 9; r++) {
      const rowLabel = String.fromCharCode(65 + r); // A..I
      for (let c = 1; c <= 9; c++) {
        list.push(`${rowLabel}${c}`);
      }
    }
    return list;
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className={styles.grid} aria-label="CryoBox 9x9">
      {positions.map((pos) => {
        const isOccupied = occupiedPositions.includes(pos);
        const isSelected = selectedPosition === pos;
        const ariaState = isSelected ? 'selecionado' : isOccupied ? 'ocupado' : 'livre';
        const classes = [
          styles.cell,
          isOccupied && styles.occupied,
          isSelected && styles.selected,
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(' ');

        return (
          <button
            key={pos}
            type="button"
            className={classes}
            aria-label={`Posição ${pos} ${ariaState}`}
            onClick={() => onSelect?.(pos)}
            data-tooltip={isOccupied ? `Amostra em ${pos}` : undefined}
          >
            <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { Globe } from 'lucide-react';
import './LanguageSelector.css';

export default function LanguageSelector() {
  const { language, setLanguage, t } = useLanguage();
  const selectId = 'language-selector';

  const handleLanguageChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const newLang = e.target.value as 'pt-BR' | 'en-US' | 'es-ES';
    setLanguage(newLang);
  };

  return (
    <div className="language-selector">
      <Globe size={18} />
      <label htmlFor={selectId} className="sr-only">
        {t('app.language')}
      </label>
      <select
        id={selectId}
        name="language"
        value={language}
        onChange={handleLanguageChange}
        className="language-select"
        aria-label={t('app.language')}
      >
        <option value="pt-BR">{t('app.portuguese')}</option>
        <option value="en-US">{t('app.english')}</option>
        <option value="es-ES">{t('app.spanish')}</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { User as UserType } from '../../types/models';
import Button from '../UI/Button';
import LanguageSelector from '../LanguageSelector';
import { LogOut, User } from 'lucide-react';
import './Header.css';

export default function Header() {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await logout();
    navigate('/login');
  };

  const getAccessTypeLabel = (user?: UserType) => {
    if (user?.roleName) {
      const roleMap: Record<string, string> = {
        'Administrador': t('roles.administrator'),
        'Coordenador': t('roles.coordinator'),
        'Técnico': t('roles.technician'),
        'Usuário Externo': t('roles.externalUser'),
      };
      return roleMap[user.roleName] || user.roleName;
    }
    switch (user?.accessType) {
      case 1:
        return t('roles.basic');
      case 2:
        return t('roles.intermediate');
      case 3:
        return t('roles.complete');
      default:
        return t('roles.unknown');
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="header">
      <div className="header-content">
        <h2 className="header-title">{t('app.title')}</h2>
        <div className="header-user-section">
          <LanguageSelector />
          {user && (
            <div className="user-info">
              <User size={18} />
              <div className="user-details">
                <span className="user-name">{user.name}</span>
                <span className="user-access">{t('roles.access')}: {getAccessTypeLabel(user)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleLogout} className="logout-button">
            <LogOut size={18} />
            {t('auth.logout')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { NavLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { canRoleAccessRoute } from '../../utils/rolePermissions';
import { 
  Menu, 
  X, 
  LayoutDashboard, 
  Users, 
  FlaskConical, 
  FileText, 
  Box, 
  MessageCircle, 
  Shield, 
  ShieldCheck,
  BarChart3, 
  FileSearch, 
  Database, 
  UserCog 
} from 'lucide-react';
import './Sidebar.css';

export default function Sidebar() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  
  // Mapeia accessType para roleName se não tiver roleName
  let roleName = user?.roleName;
  if (!roleName && user?.accessType) {
    const roleNameMap: Record<number, string> = {
      1: 'Usuário Externo',
      2: 'Técnico',
      3: 'Coordenador',
      4: 'Administrador'
    };
    roleName = roleNameMap[user.accessType] as any;
  }

  const allMenuItems = [
    { path: '/dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard, label: t('navigation.dashboard'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico', 'Usuário Externo'] },
    { path: '/patients', icon: Users, label: t('navigation.patients'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'] },
    { path: '/samples', icon: FlaskConical, label: t('navigation.samples'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'] },
    { path: '/samples/withdrawal-return', icon: FlaskConical, label: t('navigation.withdrawalReturn') || 'Retirada/Devolução', roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'] },
    { path: '/samples/custody-reports', icon: FileSearch, label: t('navigation.custodyReports') || 'Relatórios de Custódia', roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'] },
    { path: '/results', icon: FileText, label: t('navigation.results'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'] },
    { path: '/facility-management', icon: Box, label: t('navigation.facilityManagement'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'] },
    { path: '/assistant', icon: MessageCircle, label: t('navigation.assistant'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico', 'Usuário Externo'] },
    { path: '/consent-manager', icon: ShieldCheck, label: t('navigation.ethicsConsent') || 'Ética e Consentimento', roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador'] },
    { path: '/user/security', icon: Shield, label: t('navigation.userSecurity'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico', 'Usuário Externo'] },
    { path: '/reports', icon: BarChart3, label: t('navigation.reports'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Usuário Externo'] },
    { path: '/logs', icon: FileSearch, label: t('navigation.logs'), roles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador'] },
    { path: '/system-management', icon: UserCog, label: t('navigation.systemManagement') || 'Gerenciamento do Sistema', roles: ['Administrador'] },
    { path: '/backup', icon: Database, label: t('navigation.backup'), roles: ['Administrador'] },
  ];

  // Filtra itens baseado na role do usuário
  const menuItems = allMenuItems.filter(item => {
    if (!roleName) {
      // Se não tem roleName nem accessType, não mostra nada (exceto dashboard)
      if (item.path === '/dashboard') return true;
      return false;
    }
    // Verifica se a role do usuário está na lista de roles permitidas
    return item.roles.includes(roleName) || canRoleAccessRoute(roleName, item.path);
  });

  return (
    <>
      {/* Menu hambúrguer para mobile */}
      <button 
        className="sidebar-toggle"
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        aria-label="Toggle menu"
      >
        {isOpen ? <X size={24} /> : <Menu size={24} />}
      </button>
      
      {/* Overlay para fechar sidebar no mobile */}
      {isOpen && (
        <div 
          className="sidebar-overlay"
          onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      
      <aside className={`sidebar ${isOpen ? 'open' : ''}`}>
        <div className="sidebar-header">
          <h1 className="sidebar-title">{t('app.title')}</h1>
          <p className="sidebar-subtitle">{t('app.subtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <nav className="sidebar-nav">
          {menuItems.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon;
            return (
              <NavLink
                key={item.path}
                to={item.path}
                className={({ isActive }) =>
                  `sidebar-link ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}`
                }
                onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
              >
                <Icon size={20} />
                <span>{item.label}</span>
              </NavLink>
            );
          })}
        </nav>
      </aside>
    </>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: C:\Projeto\BioAvanceD\frontend\src\components\ProtectedRoute.tsx
================================================================================
import { Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { canRoleAccessRoute, RoleName } from '../utils/rolePermissions';

interface ProtectedRouteProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  requiredAccessType?: number;
  requiredRole?: RoleName | RoleName[];
}

export default function ProtectedRoute({ children, requiredAccessType, requiredRole }: ProtectedRouteProps) {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading, hasAccess, hasRole, canAccessRoute, user, token } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  // Adiciona log para debug
  useEffect(() => {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      console.log('[ProtectedRoute] Estado de autenticação:', {
        isAuthenticated,
        isLoading,
        hasUser: !!user,
        hasToken: !!token,
        path: location.pathname
      });
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, isLoading, user, token, location.pathname]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        justifyContent: 'center', 
        alignItems: 'center', 
        height: '100vh' 
      }}>
        <p>Carregando...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Verifica se tem token no localStorage mesmo que o estado ainda não tenha sido atualizado
  // Isso evita logout prematuro durante re-renderizações
  const hasStoredToken = typeof window !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('token');
  
  if (!isAuthenticated && !hasStoredToken) {
    console.log('[ProtectedRoute] Redirecionando para login - sem autenticação e sem token armazenado');
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  }

  // Se tem token armazenado mas ainda está carregando, aguarda
  if (!isAuthenticated && hasStoredToken && isLoading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        justifyContent: 'center', 
        alignItems: 'center', 
        height: '100vh' 
      }}>
        <p>Carregando...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Verifica acesso por role (prioridade)
  // Se não tiver roleName mas tiver accessType, tenta mapear
  if (requiredRole && !hasRole(requiredRole)) {
    // Log de debug em desenvolvimento
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
      console.log('[ProtectedRoute] Acesso negado por role:', {
        requiredRole,
        userRoleName: user?.roleName,
        userAccessType: user?.accessType,
        hasRoleResult: hasRole(requiredRole),
        path: location.pathname
      });
    }
    
    // Se não tem roleName mas tem accessType, tenta verificar por accessType
    if (!user?.roleName && user?.accessType) {
      const roleNameMap: Record<number, string> = {
        1: 'Usuário Externo',
        2: 'Técnico',
        3: 'Coordenador',
        4: 'Administrador'
      };
      const mappedRole = roleNameMap[user.accessType];
      if (mappedRole && hasRole(mappedRole as any)) {
        // Role mapeada tem acesso, permite
      } else {
        return (
          <div style={{ 
            display: 'flex', 
            justifyContent: 'center', 
            alignItems: 'center', 
            height: '100vh',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: '1rem'
          }}>
            <h2>Acesso Negado</h2>
            <p>Esta página requer permissões de {Array.isArray(requiredRole) ? requiredRole.join(' ou ') : requiredRole}.</p>
            <p>Sua role atual: <strong>{mappedRole || `AccessType ${user.accessType}`}</strong></p>
            <button onClick={() => window.history.back()}>Voltar</button>
          </div>
        );
      }
    } else {
      return (
        <div style={{ 
          display: 'flex', 
          justifyContent: 'center', 
          alignItems: 'center', 
          height: '100vh',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: '1rem'
        }}>
          <h2>Acesso Negado</h2>
          <p>Esta página requer permissões de {Array.isArray(requiredRole) ? requiredRole.join(' ou ') : requiredRole}.</p>
          <p>Sua role atual: <strong>{user?.roleName || 'Não definida'}</strong></p>
          <button onClick={() => window.history.back()}>Voltar</button>
        </div>
      );
    }
  }

  // Verifica acesso por accessType (compatibilidade)
  if (requiredAccessType && !hasAccess(requiredAccessType)) {
    return (
      <div style={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        justifyContent: 'center', 
        alignItems: 'center', 
        height: '100vh',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: '1rem'
      }}>
        <h2>Acesso Negado</h2>
        <p>Você não tem permissão para acessar esta página.</p>
        <p>Sua role atual: <strong>{user?.roleName || 'Não definida'}</strong></p>
        <button onClick={() => window.history.back()}>Voltar</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Verifica acesso por rota (verificação adicional)
  // Permite acesso ao dashboard, /user/security e /security/mfa-setup mesmo sem roleName (para compatibilidade)
  const allowedRoutesWithoutRole = ['/dashboard', '/user/security', '/security/mfa-setup'];
  if (!allowedRoutesWithoutRole.includes(location.pathname) && !canAccessRoute(location.pathname)) {
    return (
      <div style={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        justifyContent: 'center', 
        alignItems: 'center', 
        height: '100vh',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        gap: '1rem'
      }}>
        <h2>Acesso Negado</h2>
        <p>Você não tem permissão para acessar esta página.</p>
        <p>Sua role atual: <strong>{user?.roleName || (user?.accessType ? `AccessType ${user.accessType}` : 'Não definida')}</strong></p>
        <button onClick={() => window.history.back()}>Voltar</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Upload, Download, Trash2, File, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import Button from './UI/Button';
import Modal from './UI/Modal';
import Table from './UI/Table';
import { useSampleFiles } from '../hooks/useSampleFiles';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { SampleFile } from '../types/models';
import './SampleFilesSection.css';

// Botão Exportar removido conforme solicitado

interface SampleFilesSectionProps {
  sampleID: string;
}

export default function SampleFilesSection({ sampleID }: SampleFilesSectionProps) {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { files, loading, error, loadFiles, uploadFile, downloadFile, deleteFile } = useSampleFiles(sampleID);
  const [showUploadModal, setShowUploadModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deletingFileId, setDeletingFileId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Verifica permissões
  const canUploadDelete = user?.roleName === 'Administrador' || user?.roleName === 'Coordenador' || 
                          user?.accessType === 4 || user?.accessType === 3;

  // Carrega arquivos ao montar e quando sampleID mudar
  useEffect(() => {
    if (sampleID) {
      loadFiles();
    }
  }, [sampleID]);


  const handleFileSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      // Valida tipo de arquivo
      const allowedExtensions = ['.raw', '.zip', '.csv', '.xls', '.xlsx', '.pdf', '.txt'];
      const ext = '.' + file.name.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase();
      
      if (!allowedExtensions.includes(ext)) {
        setUploadError(t('sampleFiles.invalidFileType') || 'Tipo de arquivo inválido');
        return;
      }

      // Valida tamanho (100MB)
      if (file.size > 100 * 1024 * 1024) {
        setUploadError(t('sampleFiles.maxSize') || 'Arquivo muito grande. Tamanho máximo: 100MB');
        return;
      }

      setSelectedFile(file);
      setUploadError(null);
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = async () => {
    if (!selectedFile) {
      setUploadError(t('sampleFiles.fileRequired') || 'Arquivo é obrigatório');
      return;
    }

    try {
      setUploading(true);
      setUploadError(null);
      await uploadFile(selectedFile);
      setShowUploadModal(false);
      setSelectedFile(null);
      // Limpa input
      const fileInput = document.getElementById('file-upload-input') as HTMLInputElement;
      if (fileInput) fileInput.value = '';
    } catch (err: any) {
      setUploadError(err.message || t('sampleFiles.uploadError') || 'Erro ao fazer upload');
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = async (file: SampleFile) => {
    if (!file._id) return;
    
    try {
      await downloadFile(file._id, file.fileName);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || t('sampleFiles.downloadError') || 'Erro ao fazer download');
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (file: SampleFile) => {
    if (!file._id) return;

    if (!confirm(t('sampleFiles.deleteConfirm') || 'Tem certeza que deseja excluir este arquivo?')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      setDeletingFileId(file._id);
      await deleteFile(file._id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err.message || t('sampleFiles.deleteError') || 'Erro ao excluir arquivo');
    } finally {
      setDeletingFileId(null);
    }
  };


  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string => {
    if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} bytes`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(2)} KB`;
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`;
    return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB`;
  };

  const getFileTypeLabel = (fileType: string): string => {
    const typeMap: Record<string, string> = {
      'RAW': t('sampleFiles.fileTypes.RAW') || 'RAW',
      'ZIP': t('sampleFiles.fileTypes.ZIP') || 'ZIP',
      'CSV': t('sampleFiles.fileTypes.CSV') || 'CSV',
      'XLS': t('sampleFiles.fileTypes.XLS') || 'XLS',
      'XLSX': t('sampleFiles.fileTypes.XLSX') || 'XLSX',
      'PDF': t('sampleFiles.fileTypes.PDF') || 'PDF',
      'TXT': t('sampleFiles.fileTypes.TXT') || 'TXT'
    };
    return typeMap[fileType] || fileType;
  };

  return (
    <div className="sample-files-section">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
        <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 600, margin: 0, color: 'var(--text)' }}>
          {t('sampleFiles.title') || 'Arquivos de Análise'}
        </h3>
        {canUploadDelete && (
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={() => setShowUploadModal(true)}
            style={{ padding: '0.5rem 1rem', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}
          >
            <Upload size={16} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
            {t('sampleFiles.uploadFile') || 'Enviar Arquivo'}
          </Button>
        )}
        {!canUploadDelete && (
          <span style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-light)', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
            {t('sampleFiles.viewOnly') || 'Você pode visualizar e fazer download dos arquivos'}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div style={{ 
          padding: '0.75rem', 
          backgroundColor: '#fee', 
          border: '1px solid #fcc', 
          borderRadius: '4px',
          marginBottom: '1rem',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '0.5rem'
        }}>
          <AlertCircle size={16} color="var(--danger)" />
          <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>{error}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <p style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '2rem', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>
          {t('common.loading') || 'Carregando...'}
        </p>
      ) : files.length === 0 ? (
        <div style={{ 
          textAlign: 'center', 
          padding: '2rem', 
          backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', 
          borderRadius: '6px',
          color: 'var(--text-light)'
        }}>
          <File size={48} style={{ margin: '0 auto 1rem', opacity: 0.5 }} />
          <p>{t('sampleFiles.noFiles') || 'Nenhum arquivo associado a esta amostra'}</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
          <Table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>{t('sampleFiles.fileName') || 'Nome do Arquivo'}</th>
                <th>{t('sampleFiles.fileType') || 'Tipo'}</th>
                <th>{t('sampleFiles.fileSize') || 'Tamanho'}</th>
                <th>{t('sampleFiles.uploadDate') || 'Data de Upload'}</th>
                <th>{t('sampleFiles.uploadedBy') || 'Enviado por'}</th>
                <th>{t('sampleFiles.actions') || 'Ações'}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {files.map((file) => (
                <tr key={file._id}>
                  <td>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                      {file.fileName}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span className="file-type-badge" data-type={file.fileType}>
                      {getFileTypeLabel(file.fileType)}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{formatFileSize(file.fileSize)}</td>
                  <td>
                    {new Date(file.uploadDate).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', {
                      day: '2-digit',
                      month: '2-digit',
                      year: 'numeric',
                      hour: '2-digit',
                      minute: '2-digit'
                    })}
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>
                      {file.uploaderAnonId || 'N/A'}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem', alignItems: 'center' }}>
                      <Button
                        variant="secondary"
                        onClick={() => handleDownload(file)}
                        style={{ padding: '0.375rem', minWidth: 'auto' }}
                        title={t('sampleFiles.download') || 'Download'}
                      >
                        <Download size={14} />
                      </Button>
                      {canUploadDelete && (
                        <Button
                          variant="danger"
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(file)}
                          disabled={deletingFileId === file._id}
                          style={{ padding: '0.375rem', minWidth: 'auto' }}
                          title={t('sampleFiles.delete') || 'Excluir'}
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={14} />
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modal de Upload */}
      {showUploadModal && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={showUploadModal}
          onClose={() => {
            setShowUploadModal(false);
            setSelectedFile(null);
            setUploadError(null);
          }}
          title={t('sampleFiles.uploadTitle') || 'Upload de Arquivo de Análise'}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1rem' }}>
            <p style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>
              {t('sampleFiles.uploadDescription') || 'Envie arquivos de análise gerados por equipamentos laboratoriais'}
            </p>
            
            <div>
              <label style={{ display: 'block', marginBottom: '0.5rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                {t('sampleFiles.selectFile') || 'Selecionar Arquivo'} *
              </label>
              <input
                id="file-upload-input"
                type="file"
                onChange={handleFileSelect}
                accept=".raw,.zip,.csv,.xls,.xlsx,.pdf,.txt"
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '0.5rem',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border)',
                  borderRadius: '4px',
                  fontSize: '0.875rem'
                }}
              />
              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
                {t('sampleFiles.allowedTypes') || 'Tipos permitidos: .raw, .zip, .csv, .xls, .xlsx, .pdf, .txt'}
              </p>
              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>
                {t('sampleFiles.maxSize') || 'Tamanho máximo: 100MB'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {selectedFile && (
              <div style={{ 
                padding: '0.75rem', 
                backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', 
                borderRadius: '4px',
                fontSize: '0.875rem'
              }}>
                <strong>{selectedFile.name}</strong>
                <br />
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>
                  {formatFileSize(selectedFile.size)}
                </span>
              </div>
            )}

            {uploadError && (
              <div style={{ 
                padding: '0.75rem', 
                backgroundColor: '#fee', 
                border: '1px solid #fcc', 
                borderRadius: '4px',
                color: 'var(--danger)',
                fontSize: '0.875rem'
              }}>
                {uploadError}
              </div>
            )}

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: '1rem' }}>
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowUploadModal(false);
                  setSelectedFile(null);
                  setUploadError(null);
                }}
                disabled={uploading}
              >
                {t('common.cancel') || 'Cancelar'}
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={handleUpload}
                disabled={!selectedFile || uploading}
              >
                {uploading ? (t('common.loading') || 'Enviando...') : (t('sampleFiles.uploadFile') || 'Enviar Arquivo')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Search, MapPin, AlertCircle, Loader } from 'lucide-react';
import { storageApi } from '../services/storageApi';
import './SampleLocator.css';

interface SampleLocation {
  sampleID: string;
  barcode: string;
  storageLocation: {
    freezerName: string;
    shelfName: string;
    rackName: string;
    boxName: string;
    boxID: number;
    position: string;
    dimension: { rows: number; cols: number };
  };
}

interface SampleLocatorProps {}

export const SampleLocator: React.FC<SampleLocatorProps> = () => {
  const [searchInput, setSearchInput] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<SampleLocation | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [releasing, setReleasing] = useState(false);

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!searchInput.trim()) {
      setError('Por favor, insira um ID ou código de barras da amostra');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setResult(null);

    try {
      const response = await storageApi.getSampleLocation(searchInput);
      if (response.success && response.data) {
        setResult(response.data as SampleLocation);
      } else {
        setError(`Amostra "${searchInput}" não encontrada no banco de dados.`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err.message?.includes('401') || err.message?.includes('token')) {
        setError('Sessão expirada. Por favor, faça login novamente.');
      } else if (err.message?.includes('404')) {
        setError(`Amostra "${searchInput}" não encontrada no banco de dados.`);
      } else {
        setError(`Erro ao buscar amostra: ${err.message || 'Erro desconhecido'}`);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRelease = async () => {
    if (!result) return;

    setReleasing(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const response = await storageApi.releaseSample(result.sampleID);
      if (response.success) {
        setResult(null);
        setSearchInput('');
      } else {
        setError(`Erro ao liberar amostra: ${response.error}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(`Erro ao liberar amostra: ${err.message || 'Erro desconhecido'}`);
    } finally {
      setReleasing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !loading) {
      handleSearch();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="sample-locator">
      <div className="sample-locator-header">
        <div className="sample-locator-title">
          <MapPin size={24} />
          <h3>Localizar Amostra</h3>
        </div>
        <p className="sample-locator-description">
          Encontre a localização exata de qualquer amostra no sistema de armazenagem
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="sample-locator-search">
        <div className="search-input-group">
          <Search size={18} />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Digite o ID ou código de barras da amostra..."
            value={searchInput}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchInput(e.target.value)}
            onKeyPress={handleKeyPress}
            disabled={loading}
            className="search-input"
          />
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={handleSearch}
          disabled={loading}
          className="btn-search"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader size={16} className="spinner" />
              Procurando...
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Search size={16} />
              Procurar
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="error-box">
          <AlertCircle size={20} />
          <div>
            <strong>Erro</strong>
            <p>{error}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {result && (
        <div className="result-box">
          <div className="result-header">
            <h4>📍 Localização Encontrada</h4>
          </div>

          <div className="result-content">
            <div className="info-row">
              <span className="label">Amostra ID:</span>
              <code>{result.sampleID}</code>
            </div>
            <div className="info-row">
              <span className="label">Código de Barras:</span>
              <code>{result.barcode}</code>
            </div>

            <div className="hierarchy-section">
              <h5>Hierarquia de Armazenagem:</h5>
              <div className="hierarchy-badges">
                <span className="badge freezer-badge">{result.storageLocation.freezerName}</span>
                <span className="hierarchy-arrow">→</span>
                <span className="badge shelf-badge">{result.storageLocation.shelfName}</span>
                <span className="hierarchy-arrow">→</span>
                <span className="badge rack-badge">{result.storageLocation.rackName}</span>
                <span className="hierarchy-arrow">→</span>
                <span className="badge box-badge">{result.storageLocation.boxName}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="info-row">
              <span className="label">Caixa ID:</span>
              <code>#{result.storageLocation.boxID}</code>
            </div>
            <div className="info-row">
              <span className="label">Dimensões:</span>
              <code>
                {result.storageLocation.dimension.rows}x{result.storageLocation.dimension.cols}
              </code>
            </div>
            <div className="info-row highlight">
              <span className="label">Posição:</span>
              <span className="position-badge">{result.storageLocation.position}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="result-actions">
            <button
              onClick={handleSearch}
              className="btn-secondary"
              disabled={releasing}
            >
              Nova Busca
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleRelease}
              disabled={releasing}
              className="btn-danger"
            >
              {releasing ? (
                <>
                  <Loader size={16} className="spinner" />
                  Liberando...
                </>
              ) : (
                'Liberar Posição'
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {!result && !loading && !error && (
        <div className="empty-state">
          <Search size={48} />
          <p>Digite um ID ou código de barras para localizar uma amostra</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Sample } from '../types/models';

export type SampleLifecycleStatus = NonNullable<Sample['status']>;

type Props = {
  status: SampleLifecycleStatus;
};

const palette: Record<SampleLifecycleStatus, { bg: string; fg: string; label: string }> = {
  AVAILABLE: { bg: '#e1f5eb', fg: '#009E73', label: 'Disponível' },
  PARTIAL: { bg: '#e6f3fb', fg: '#56B4E9', label: 'Parcial' },
  DEPLETED: { bg: '#f4f4f4', fg: '#777777', label: 'Esgotada' },
  UNAVAILABLE: { bg: '#ffe8dc', fg: '#D55E00', label: 'Indisponível' },
};

export default function SampleStatusBadge({ status }: Props) {
  const normalized = (status || 'AVAILABLE').toUpperCase() as SampleLifecycleStatus;
  const colors = palette[normalized] || palette.AVAILABLE;

  return (
    <span
      style={{
        display: 'inline-block',
        padding: '0.35rem 0.7rem',
        borderRadius: '999px',
        fontSize: '0.78rem',
        fontWeight: 700,
        letterSpacing: '0.2px',
        backgroundColor: colors.bg,
        color: colors.fg,
        textTransform: 'uppercase',
      }}
    >
      {colors.label}
    </span>
  );
}
