import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { userSecurityService } from '../services/api';

interface SecurityStatus {
  securityScore: number;
  overallLevel: 'strong' | 'medium' | 'weak';
  alternativeMethodsCount: number;
}

interface MFAStatus {
  primaryEnabled: boolean;
  primarySetupDate?: string | Date;
  phoneEnabled: boolean;
  phoneNumber?: string;
  passkeys?: Array<{ id: string; name?: string }>;
  recoveryCodes?: {
    remaining: number;
    codes?: string[];
  };
}

interface PasswordStatus {
  lastChanged?: string | Date;
  expiresAt?: string | Date;
  strength?: 'weak' | 'medium' | 'strong';
  strengthScore?: number;
}

interface Session {
  id: string;
  deviceName?: string;
  browser?: string;
  os?: string;
  location?: string;
  lastAccess: string | Date;
  isCurrent: boolean;
}

export function useUserSecurity() {
  const [securityStatus, setSecurityStatus] = useState<SecurityStatus | null>(null);
  const [mfaStatus, setMfaStatus] = useState<MFAStatus | null>(null);
  const [passwordStatus, setPasswordStatus] = useState<PasswordStatus | null>(null);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Session[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const refreshData = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // Tenta buscar dados do backend
      try {
        const [statusRes, mfaRes, passwordRes, sessionsRes] = await Promise.all([
          userSecurityService.getStatus(),
          userSecurityService.getMFAStatus(),
          userSecurityService.getPasswordStatus(),
          userSecurityService.getSessions()
        ]);

        setSecurityStatus(statusRes.data?.data || statusRes.data);
        setMfaStatus(mfaRes.data?.data || mfaRes.data);
        setPasswordStatus(passwordRes.data?.data || passwordRes.data);
        setSessions(sessionsRes.data?.data || sessionsRes.data || []);
      } catch (apiErr: any) {
        // Se o backend não estiver disponível, usa dados mockados para desenvolvimento
        console.warn('Backend não disponível, usando dados mockados:', apiErr.message);
        
        // Dados mockados para desenvolvimento
        const mockSecurityStatus: SecurityStatus = {
          securityScore: 75,
          overallLevel: 'medium',
          alternativeMethodsCount: 1
        };

        const mockMFAStatus: MFAStatus = {
          primaryEnabled: true,
          primarySetupDate: new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 30 dias atrás
          phoneEnabled: false,
          passkeys: [],
          recoveryCodes: {
            remaining: 8,
            codes: []
          }
        };

        const mockPasswordStatus: PasswordStatus = {
          lastChanged: new Date(Date.now() - 60 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // 60 dias atrás
          expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000), // Expira em 30 dias
          strength: 'strong',
          strengthScore: 4
        };

        const mockSessions: Session[] = [
          {
            id: '1',
            deviceName: 'Chrome no Windows',
            browser: 'Chrome 120',
            os: 'Windows 11',
            location: 'São Paulo, Brasil',
            lastAccess: new Date(),
            isCurrent: true
          }
        ];

        setSecurityStatus(mockSecurityStatus);
        setMfaStatus(mockMFAStatus);
        setPasswordStatus(mockPasswordStatus);
        // Não sobrescreve a lista atual se já houver sessões carregadas (evita reintroduzir mocks após revogação)
        setSessions(prev => (prev && prev.length ? prev : mockSessions));
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Erro ao carregar dados de segurança');
      console.error('Erro ao carregar dados de segurança:', err);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const updateMFA = useCallback(async (method: 'phone' | 'passkey', enabled: boolean) => {
    try {
      await userSecurityService.updateMFA(method, enabled);
      await refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(err.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Erro ao atualizar MFA');
    }
  }, [refreshData]);

  const updatePassword = useCallback(async (currentPassword: string, newPassword: string) => {
    try {
      await userSecurityService.updatePassword(currentPassword, newPassword);
      await refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(err.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Erro ao atualizar senha');
    }
  }, [refreshData]);

  const updatePhone = useCallback(async (phone: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await userSecurityService.updatePhone(phone);
      
      // Aguarda um pouco para garantir que o banco foi atualizado
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
      
      // Atualiza os dados
      await refreshData();
      
      return response;
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errorMessage = err.response?.data?.error || 
                          err.response?.data?.message || 
                          err.message || 
                          'Erro ao atualizar telefone';
      throw new Error(errorMessage);
    }
  }, [refreshData]);

  const addPasskey = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      // Verifica se WebAuthn está disponível
      if (!window.PublicKeyCredential) {
        throw new Error('WebAuthn não é suportado neste navegador. Use um navegador moderno (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari).');
      }

      // Verifica se está em contexto seguro (HTTPS ou localhost)
      // WebAuthn requer HTTPS ou localhost/127.0.0.1
      const hostname = window.location.hostname;
      const protocol = window.location.protocol;
      const isLocalhost = hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '127.0.0.1';
      const isHTTPS = protocol === 'https:';
      const isSecureContext = window.isSecureContext || isHTTPS || isLocalhost;
      
      if (!isSecureContext) {
        const isIP = hostname.match(/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/);
        if (isIP) {
          throw new Error('WebAuthn requer HTTPS para endereços IP. Acesse via HTTPS (https://) ou use localhost.');
        } else {
          throw new Error('WebAuthn requer HTTPS ou localhost. Acesse via HTTPS (https://) ou localhost.');
        }
      }
      
      // Aviso para IPs em HTTP (pode não funcionar)
      const isIP = hostname.match(/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/);
      if (isIP && !isHTTPS) {
        console.warn('WebAuthn pode não funcionar com endereços IP em HTTP. Use HTTPS ou localhost para melhor compatibilidade.');
      }

      // Primeiro, solicita ao backend para iniciar o registro
      const challengeResponse = await userSecurityService.startPasskeyRegistration();
      const responseData = challengeResponse.data?.data || challengeResponse.data;
      const challenge = responseData?.challenge;
      const userId = responseData?.userId;
      const userEmail = responseData?.userEmail;
      const userName = responseData?.userName;

      if (!challenge) {
        throw new Error('Erro ao obter desafio do servidor');
      }

      if (!userId) {
        throw new Error('Erro ao obter ID do usuário');
      }

      // Converte challenge de base64 para ArrayBuffer
      const challengeBuffer = Uint8Array.from(atob(challenge), c => c.charCodeAt(0));

      // Prepara dados do usuário - userId deve ser um ArrayBuffer
      // Converte o userId (string) para ArrayBuffer usando TextEncoder
      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
      const userIdBuffer = encoder.encode(userId);

      // Determina o rp.id baseado no hostname
      // WebAuthn requer um domínio válido ou localhost
      let rpId = window.location.hostname;
      if (rpId === 'localhost' || rpId === '127.0.0.1') {
        rpId = 'localhost';
      } else if (rpId.match(/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/)) {
        // WebAuthn não funciona bem com IPs - precisa de um domínio válido
        // Tenta usar o IP, mas pode falhar
        console.warn('WebAuthn pode não funcionar com endereços IP. Use um domínio válido ou localhost.');
        rpId = window.location.hostname;
      }

      // Cria credencial usando WebAuthn API
      const credential = await navigator.credentials.create({
        publicKey: {
          challenge: challengeBuffer,
          rp: {
            name: 'BioAvanceD',
            id: rpId
          },
          user: {
            id: userIdBuffer,
            name: userEmail || 'user@bioavanced.com',
            displayName: userName || 'Usuário BioAvanceD'
          },
          pubKeyCredParams: [
            { alg: -7, type: 'public-key' }, // ES256
            { alg: -257, type: 'public-key' } // RS256
          ],
          authenticatorSelection: {
            authenticatorAttachment: 'cross-platform', // Permite tanto platform quanto cross-platform
            userVerification: 'preferred',
            requireResidentKey: false
          },
          timeout: 60000,
          attestation: 'none'
        }
      }) as PublicKeyCredential;

      if (!credential || !credential.response) {
        throw new Error('Erro ao criar credencial. Tente novamente.');
      }

      const response = credential.response as AuthenticatorAttestationResponse;

      // Converte os dados para base64
      const credentialIdArray = new Uint8Array(credential.rawId);
      const credentialIdBase64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...credentialIdArray));

      const attestationObjectArray = new Uint8Array(response.attestationObject);
      const attestationObjectBase64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...attestationObjectArray));

      // PublicKey pode não estar disponível em todos os casos
      let publicKeyBase64 = '';
      if (response.getPublicKey) {
        const publicKeyArray = new Uint8Array(response.getPublicKey());
        publicKeyBase64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...publicKeyArray));
      }

      // Obtém nome do dispositivo
      const deviceName = navigator.userAgentData?.platform || 
                        navigator.platform || 
                        'Dispositivo Desconhecido';

      await userSecurityService.completePasskeyRegistration({
        credentialId: credentialIdBase64,
        publicKey: publicKeyBase64,
        attestationObject: attestationObjectBase64,
        deviceName: deviceName
      });

      await refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      // Trata erros específicos do WebAuthn
      if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
        throw new Error('Operação cancelada pelo usuário ou timeout. Tente novamente.');
      } else if (err.name === 'InvalidStateError') {
        throw new Error('Esta passkey já está cadastrada ou há um erro no estado da autenticação.');
      } else if (err.name === 'NotSupportedError') {
        throw new Error('Seu dispositivo ou navegador não suporta passkeys. Use um navegador moderno com suporte a WebAuthn.');
      } else if (err.name === 'SecurityError') {
        throw new Error('Erro de segurança. WebAuthn requer HTTPS ou localhost. Certifique-se de que está usando um contexto seguro.');
      } else if (err.name === 'TypeError' && err.message.includes('credentials')) {
        throw new Error('Erro ao acessar a API de credenciais. Verifique se o navegador suporta WebAuthn.');
      } else if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
        throw new Error('Operação cancelada.');
      }
      
      // Log do erro completo para debug
      console.error('Erro ao adicionar passkey:', err);
      
      throw new Error(err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Erro ao adicionar passkey');
    }
  }, [refreshData]);

  const removePasskey = useCallback(async (passkeyId: string) => {
    try {
      await userSecurityService.removePasskey(passkeyId);
      await refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(err.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Erro ao remover passkey');
    }
  }, [refreshData]);

  const generateRecoveryCodes = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const response = await userSecurityService.generateRecoveryCodes();
      const codes = response.data?.data?.codes || response.data?.codes || [];
      
      if (!codes || codes.length === 0) {
        throw new Error('Nenhum código foi gerado');
      }
      
      // Atualiza o estado local com os códigos retornados
      // O getMFAStatus não retorna códigos em texto claro (por segurança),
      // então precisamos manter os códigos gerados no estado
      setMfaStatus(prev => prev ? {
        ...prev,
        recoveryCodes: {
          remaining: codes.length,
          codes: codes // Mantém os códigos em texto claro para exibição
        }
      } : prev);
      
      // Atualiza o remaining sem fazer refresh completo (para não perder os códigos)
      // O refresh completo será feito quando o modal for fechado
      
      return codes;
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(err.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Erro ao gerar códigos de recuperação');
    }
  }, []);

  const revokeSession = useCallback(async (sessionId: string) => {
    try {
      await userSecurityService.revokeSession(sessionId);
      // Remoção otimista da lista
      setSessions(prev => prev.filter(s => s.id !== sessionId));
      await refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(err.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Erro ao revogar sessão');
    }
  }, [refreshData]);

  const revokeAllSessions = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      await userSecurityService.revokeAllSessions();
      // Mantém apenas a sessão atual na lista (otimista)
      setSessions(prev => prev.filter(s => s.isCurrent));
      await refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      throw new Error(err.response?.data?.error || err.message || 'Erro ao revogar todas as sessões');
    }
  }, [refreshData]);

  return {
    securityStatus,
    mfaStatus,
    passwordStatus,
    sessions,
    loading,
    error,
    refreshData,
    updateMFA,
    updatePassword,
    updatePhone,
    addPasskey,
    removePasskey,
    generateRecoveryCodes,
    revokeSession,
    revokeAllSessions
  };
}

import ptBR from './pt-BR.json';
import enUS from './en-US.json';
import esES from './es-ES.json';

export type Language = 'pt-BR' | 'en-US' | 'es-ES';

const translations: Record<Language, any> = {
  'pt-BR': ptBR,
  'en-US': enUS,
  'es-ES': esES,
};

let currentLanguage: Language = 'pt-BR';

/**
 * Define o idioma atual do sistema
 */
export function setLanguage(lang: Language): void {
  if (translations[lang]) {
    currentLanguage = lang;
    // Salva no localStorage para persistência
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem('app_language', lang);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Retorna o idioma atual
 */
export function getLanguage(): Language {
  return currentLanguage;
}

/**
 * Inicializa o idioma a partir do localStorage ou navegador
 */
export function initLanguage(): Language {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return 'pt-BR';
  }

  // Tenta carregar do localStorage
  const savedLang = localStorage.getItem('app_language') as Language;
  if (savedLang && translations[savedLang]) {
    currentLanguage = savedLang;
    return savedLang;
  }

  // Tenta detectar do navegador
  const browserLang = navigator.language || (navigator as any).userLanguage;
  if (browserLang) {
    if (browserLang.startsWith('en')) {
      currentLanguage = 'en-US';
      return 'en-US';
    }
    if (browserLang.startsWith('es')) {
      currentLanguage = 'es-ES';
      return 'es-ES';
    }
    if (browserLang.startsWith('pt')) {
      currentLanguage = 'pt-BR';
      return 'pt-BR';
    }
  }

  // Padrão: pt-BR
  currentLanguage = 'pt-BR';
  return 'pt-BR';
}

/**
 * Função de tradução com fallback automático
 * @param key - Chave de tradução (ex: "auth.login" ou "common.save")
 * @param fallback - Texto de fallback caso a chave não exista (opcional)
 * @returns Texto traduzido
 */
export function t(key: string, fallback?: string): string {
  const keys = key.split('.');
  let value: any = translations[currentLanguage];

  // Navega pela estrutura do objeto
  for (const k of keys) {
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && k in value) {
      value = value[k];
    } else {
      // Fallback para pt-BR se não encontrar no idioma atual
      if (currentLanguage !== 'pt-BR') {
        let ptValue: any = translations['pt-BR'];
        for (const ptKey of keys) {
          if (ptValue && typeof ptValue === 'object' && ptKey in ptValue) {
            ptValue = ptValue[ptKey];
          } else {
            return fallback || key;
          }
        }
        return ptValue || fallback || key;
      }
      return fallback || key;
    }
  }

  return typeof value === 'string' ? value : (fallback || key);
}

// Inicializa o idioma ao carregar o módulo
if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  initLanguage();
}

export default {
  setLanguage,
  getLanguage,
  initLanguage,
  t,
};

import { useState } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import { Plus, Edit, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Access } from '../types/models';
import { useAccess } from '../hooks/useAccess';
import './AccessPage.css';

export default function AccessPage() {
  const { accesses, loading, error, createAccess, updateAccess, deleteAccess } = useAccess();
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingAccess, setEditingAccess] = useState<Access | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Controle de Acesso</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Gerenciamento de tipos de acesso e permissões</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}>
          <Plus size={18} />
          Novo Tipo de Acesso
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}

      <Card>
        <Table headers={['ID', 'Tipo de Relatório', 'Ações']}>
          {accesses.map((access) => (
            <tr key={access.reportID}>
              <td>{access.reportID}</td>
              <td>{access.reportType}</td>
              <td>
                <div className="table-actions">
                  <button
                    className="action-button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setEditingAccess(access);
                      setIsModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                    title="Editar"
                  >
                    <Edit size={16} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="action-button danger"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir este tipo de acesso?')) {
                        try {
                          await deleteAccess(access.reportID);
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          alert(err.message);
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    title="Excluir"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsModalOpen(false);
          setEditingAccess(null);
        }}
        title={editingAccess ? 'Editar Acesso' : 'Novo Tipo de Acesso'}
      >
        <AccessForm
          access={editingAccess}
          onSave={async (data) => {
            try {
              if (editingAccess) {
                await updateAccess(editingAccess.reportID, data);
              } else {
                await createAccess(data);
              }
              setIsModalOpen(false);
              setEditingAccess(null);
            } catch (err: any) {
              alert(err.message);
            }
          }}
          onCancel={() => {
            setIsModalOpen(false);
            setEditingAccess(null);
          }}
        />
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function AccessForm({
  access,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: {
  access: Access | null;
  onSave: (data: Partial<Access>) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const editingAccess = access !== null;
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Access>>(
    access || {
      reportType: '',
    }
  );

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.reportType || formData.reportType.trim() === '') {
      alert('Por favor, selecione um tipo de relatório');
      return;
    }
    
    // Validação conforme método do diagrama
    if (!validateAccessType(formData.reportType)) {
      alert('Tipo de acesso inválido');
      return;
    }
    
    // Remove reportID ao criar novo (será gerado no backend)
    const dataToSave = editingAccess 
      ? formData 
      : { reportType: formData.reportType.trim() };
    
    onSave(dataToSave);
  };

  // Implementação do método validateAccessType do diagrama
  const validateAccessType = (description: string): boolean => {
    const validTypes = [
      'Relatório de Pacientes',
      'Relatório de Amostras',
      'Relatório de Temperatura',
      'Relatório de Sensores',
      'Acesso Completo',
    ];
    return validTypes.includes(description) || description.length > 0;
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="form">
      <div className="form-grid">
        <div className="form-grid-full">
          <label className="form-label">Tipo de Relatório *</label>
          <select
            value={formData.reportType || ''}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setFormData({ ...formData, reportType: e.target.value })
            }
            required
            className="form-select"
          >
            <option value="">Selecione um tipo...</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Pacientes">Relatório de Pacientes</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Amostras">Relatório de Amostras</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Temperatura">Relatório de Temperatura</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Sensores">Relatório de Sensores</option>
            <option value="Acesso Completo">Acesso Completo</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        {!editingAccess && (
          <div className="form-grid-full">
            <p className="form-help-text">
              ℹ️ O ID será gerado automaticamente pelo sistema
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="form-actions">
        <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel}>
          Cancelar
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit">Salvar</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

  color: var(--error-color);
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import { MessageCircle, Send, Lightbulb, BookOpen, HelpCircle, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAssistant, AssistantResponse, TutorialResponse } from '../hooks/useAssistant';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import './AssistantPage.css';

export default function AssistantPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const { consult, answer, getContextualHelp, requestTutorial, getSuggestions, loading, error } = useAssistant();
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const [conversation, setConversation] = useState<Array<{ type: 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string; suggestions?: any[] }>>([]);
  const [tutorial, setTutorial] = useState<TutorialResponse | null>(null);
  const [showTutorial, setShowTutorial] = useState(false);

  const handleAsk = async () => {
    if (!question.trim()) return;

    const userQuestion = question;
    setQuestion('');
    
    // Adiciona pergunta do usuário
    setConversation(prev => [...prev, { type: 'user', content: userQuestion }]);

    try {
      const response = await answer(userQuestion);
      
      // Adiciona resposta do assistente
      setConversation(prev => [...prev, {
        type: 'assistant',
        content: response.answer,
        suggestions: response.suggestions
      }]);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setConversation(prev => [...prev, {
        type: 'assistant',
        content: `${t('common.error')}: ${err.message}`
      }]);
    }
  };

  const handleQuickAction = async (action: string) => {
    let response: AssistantResponse;
    
    switch (action) {
      case 'contextual':
        response = await getContextualHelp('sistema');
        setConversation(prev => [...prev, {
          type: 'assistant',
          content: response.contextualHelp?.content || response.answer,
          suggestions: response.suggestions
        }]);
        break;
      case 'tutorial':
        const tutorialData = await requestTutorial('cadastrar paciente');
        setTutorial(tutorialData);
        setShowTutorial(true);
        break;
      default:
        const suggestions = await getSuggestions(action);
        setConversation(prev => [...prev, {
          type: 'assistant',
          content: t('assistant.suggestionsFor').replace('{action}', action),
          suggestions: suggestions
        }]);
    }
  };

  const handleSuggestionClick = (route: string) => {
    navigate(route);
  };

  return (
    <div className="assistant-page">
      <div className="assistant-header">
        <h1>
          <Sparkles /> {t('assistant.title')}
        </h1>
        <p>{t('assistant.subtitle')}</p>
      </div>

      <div className="assistant-content">
        <div className="assistant-main">
          <Card className="chat-card">
            <div className="chat-messages">
              {conversation.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="welcome-message">
                  <MessageCircle size={48} />
                  <h3>{t('assistant.welcome')}</h3>
                  <p>{t('assistant.welcomeHint')}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                conversation.map((msg, index) => (
                  <div key={index} className={`message ${msg.type}`}>
                    <div className="message-content">
                      {msg.content}
                    </div>
                    {msg.suggestions && msg.suggestions.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="suggestions">
                        <h4>{t('assistant.suggestions')}:</h4>
                        {msg.suggestions.map((suggestion, idx) => (
                          <Button
                            key={idx}
                            variant="secondary"
                            onClick={() => handleSuggestionClick(suggestion.route)}
                          >
                            {suggestion.action}
                          </Button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
              {loading && (
                <div className="message assistant">
                  <div className="message-content">
                    {t('assistant.thinking')}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="chat-input">
              <Input
                value={question}
                onChange={(e) => setQuestion(e.target.value)}
                onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAsk()}
                placeholder={t('assistant.placeholder')}
                disabled={loading}
              />
              <Button onClick={handleAsk} disabled={loading || !question.trim()}>
                <Send size={16} /> {t('common.submit')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>

        <div className="assistant-sidebar">
          <Card className="quick-actions">
            <h3>{t('assistant.quickActions')}</h3>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => handleQuickAction('contextual')}
              disabled={loading}
              className="action-button"
            >
              <HelpCircle /> {t('assistant.contextualHelp')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => handleQuickAction('tutorial')}
              disabled={loading}
              className="action-button"
            >
              <BookOpen /> {t('assistant.tutorial')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => handleQuickAction('paciente')}
              disabled={loading}
              className="action-button"
            >
              <Lightbulb /> {t('assistant.patientSuggestions')}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => handleQuickAction('amostra')}
              disabled={loading}
              className="action-button"
            >
              <Lightbulb /> {t('assistant.sampleSuggestions')}
            </Button>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showTutorial && tutorial && (
        <Card className="tutorial-modal">
          <h2>{t('assistant.tutorialTitle')}: {tutorial.topic}</h2>
          <p className="estimated-time">{t('assistant.estimatedTime')}: {tutorial.estimatedTime}</p>
          <ol className="tutorial-steps">
            {tutorial.steps.map((step, index) => (
              <li key={index}>{step}</li>
            ))}
          </ol>
          <Button onClick={() => setShowTutorial(false)}>{t('common.close')}</Button>
        </Card>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="error-message">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import { Database, Download, RotateCcw, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { useBackup, Backup } from '../hooks/useBackup';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import './BackupPage.css';

export default function BackupPage() {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { performBackup, listBackups, restoreBackup, loading, error } = useBackup();
  const [backups, setBackups] = useState<Backup[]>([]);
  const [isRestoreModalOpen, setIsRestoreModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedBackup, setSelectedBackup] = useState<Backup | null>(null);
  const [backupStatus, setBackupStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'creating' | 'success' | 'error'>('idle');

  useEffect(() => {
    loadBackups();
  }, []);

  const loadBackups = async () => {
    try {
      const backupsList = await listBackups();
      setBackups(backupsList);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Erro ao carregar backups:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateBackup = async () => {
    try {
      setBackupStatus('creating');
      await performBackup();
      setBackupStatus('success');
      await loadBackups();
      setTimeout(() => setBackupStatus('idle'), 3000);
    } catch (err) {
      setBackupStatus('error');
      setTimeout(() => setBackupStatus('idle'), 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleRestore = async () => {
    if (!selectedBackup) return;

    const confirmMessage = t('backup.restoreConfirm').replace('{fileName}', selectedBackup.fileName);
    if (!confirm(confirmMessage)) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await restoreBackup(selectedBackup.fileName);
      alert(t('backup.restoreSuccess'));
      setIsRestoreModalOpen(false);
      setSelectedBackup(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errorMessage = t('backup.restoreError').replace('{error}', err.message);
      alert(errorMessage);
    }
  };

  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number) => {
    if (bytes < 1024) return bytes + ' B';
    if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(2) + ' KB';
    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + ' MB';
  };

  const formatDate = (date: Date | string) => {
    return new Date(date).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
  };

  // Verifica se o usuário é Administrador
  const isAdmin = user?.roleName === 'Administrador' || user?.accessType === 3;

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div className="backup-page">
        <div className="access-denied">
          <AlertCircle size={48} />
          <h2>{t('backup.accessDenied')}</h2>
          <p>{t('backup.accessDeniedMessage')}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="backup-page">
      <div className="backup-header">
          <h1>
            <Database /> {t('backup.management')}
          </h1>
          <p>{t('backup.description')}</p>
      </div>

      <div className="backup-content">
        <Card className="backup-actions">
          <h2>{t('backup.createTitle')}</h2>
          <p>{t('backup.createDescription')}</p>
          
          <div className="backup-status">
            {backupStatus === 'creating' && (
              <div className="status-message creating">
                <Clock /> {t('backup.creating')}
              </div>
            )}
            {backupStatus === 'success' && (
              <div className="status-message success">
                <CheckCircle /> {t('backup.success')}
              </div>
            )}
            {backupStatus === 'error' && (
              <div className="status-message error">
                <AlertCircle /> {t('backup.error')}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateBackup}
            disabled={loading || backupStatus === 'creating'}
            className="create-backup-button"
          >
            <Database /> {t('backup.create')}
          </Button>
        </Card>

        <Card className="backups-list">
          <h2>{t('backup.listTitle')}</h2>
          {error && (
            <div className="error-message">
              <AlertCircle /> {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {backups.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="empty-message">{t('backup.noBackups')}</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="backups-table">
              <table>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th>{t('backup.fileName')}</th>
                    <th>{t('backup.size')}</th>
                    <th>{t('backup.createdAt')}</th>
                    <th>{t('backup.actions')}</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {backups.map((backup, index) => (
                    <tr key={index}>
                      <td>{backup.fileName}</td>
                      <td>{formatFileSize(backup.size)}</td>
                      <td>{formatDate(backup.createdAt)}</td>
                      <td>
                        <Button
                          variant="secondary"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSelectedBackup(backup);
                            setIsRestoreModalOpen(true);
                          }}
                        >
                          <RotateCcw size={16} /> {t('backup.restore')}
                        </Button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          <Button
            variant="secondary"
            onClick={loadBackups}
            disabled={loading}
            className="refresh-button"
          >
            {t('common.refresh')}
          </Button>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {isRestoreModalOpen && selectedBackup && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={isRestoreModalOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setIsRestoreModalOpen(false);
            setSelectedBackup(null);
          }}
          title={t('backup.restore')}
        >
          <div className="restore-modal">
            <p>
              {t('backup.restoreAbout')}
            </p>
            <div className="backup-info">
              <strong>{selectedBackup.fileName}</strong>
              <p>{t('backup.size')}: {formatFileSize(selectedBackup.size)}</p>
              <p>{t('backup.createdAt')}: {formatDate(selectedBackup.createdAt)}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="warning-message">
              <AlertCircle />
              <p>
                <strong>{t('common.warning')}:</strong> {t('backup.restoreWarning')}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="modal-actions">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => {
                  setIsRestoreModalOpen(false);
                  setSelectedBackup(null);
                }}
              >
                {t('common.cancel')}
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={handleRestore}
                disabled={loading}
                className="restore-button"
              >
                <RotateCcw /> {t('backup.confirmRestore')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import Spinner from '../components/UI/Spinner';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import { useToast } from '../components/UI/ToastContainer';
import { consentService } from '../services/api';
import { ConsentPolicy, ConsentPolicyPermission } from '../types/models';
import './ConsentManager.css';

const emptyPermission = (): ConsentPolicyPermission => ({
  key: '',
  label: '',
  required: false
});

export default function ConsentManager() {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'new' | 'history'>('new');
  const [version, setVersion] = useState('');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [htmlContent, setHtmlContent] = useState('');
  const [validFrom, setValidFrom] = useState(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    return today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  });
  const [permissions, setPermissions] = useState<ConsentPolicyPermission[]>([emptyPermission()]);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<ConsentPolicy[]>([]);
  const [loadingHistory, setLoadingHistory] = useState(false);

  const canSubmit = useMemo(() => {
    const hasPermissions = permissions.some(permission => permission.key.trim() && permission.label.trim());
    return version.trim() && title.trim() && htmlContent.trim() && hasPermissions;
  }, [version, title, htmlContent, permissions]);

  const loadHistory = async () => {
    setLoadingHistory(true);
    try {
      const response = await consentService.getAllPolicies();
      const payload = (response as any)?.data?.data ?? (response as any)?.data ?? [];
      setHistory(Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : []);
    } catch (error: any) {
      showToast(error?.message || 'Erro ao carregar histórico de versões', 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoadingHistory(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadHistory();
  }, []);

  const handleAddPermission = () => {
    setPermissions((prev) => [...prev, emptyPermission()]);
  };

  const handleRemovePermission = (index: number) => {
    setPermissions((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== index));
  };

  const handleUpdatePermission = (index: number, field: keyof ConsentPolicyPermission, value: string | boolean) => {
    setPermissions((prev) =>
      prev.map((permission, idx) =>
        idx === index ? { ...permission, [field]: value } : permission
      )
    );
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!canSubmit) {
      showToast('Preencha todos os campos obrigatórios', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload = {
        version: version.trim(),
        title: title.trim(),
        htmlContent: htmlContent.trim(),
        validFrom: new Date(validFrom).toISOString(),
        active: true,
        granularPermissions: permissions
          .filter(permission => permission.key.trim() && permission.label.trim())
          .map(permission => ({
            key: permission.key.trim(),
            label: permission.label.trim(),
            required: Boolean(permission.required)
          }))
      };

      await consentService.createPolicy(payload);
      showToast('Nova versão publicada com sucesso', 'success');

      setVersion('');
      setTitle('');
      setHtmlContent('');
      setPermissions([emptyPermission()]);
      setActiveTab('history');
      await loadHistory();
    } catch (error: any) {
      showToast(error?.message || 'Erro ao publicar nova versão', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="page consent-manager">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Gestão de Consentimento Dinâmico</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Crie versões do TCLE com permissões granulares e acompanhe o histórico.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="consent-manager-tabs">
        <Button
          variant={activeTab === 'new' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
          className={`btn-small ${activeTab === 'new' ? '' : 'btn-ghost'}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('new')}
        >
          Nova Versão
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant={activeTab === 'history' ? 'primary' : 'secondary'}
          className={`btn-small ${activeTab === 'history' ? '' : 'btn-ghost'}`}
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('history')}
        >
          Histórico
        </Button>
      </div>

      {activeTab === 'new' ? (
        <div className="consent-manager-grid">
          <Card className="consent-manager-form">
            <div className="consent-manager-form-fields">
              <div className="consent-manager-form-row">
                <Input label="Versão" value={version} onChange={(event) => setVersion(event.target.value)} placeholder="Ex: 2.0" />
                <Input label="Título" value={title} onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)} placeholder="Ex: TCLE Pesquisa Genética" />
                <Input
                  label="Data de Vigência"
                  type="date"
                  value={validFrom}
                  onChange={(event) => setValidFrom(event.target.value)}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="consent-manager-textarea">
                <label htmlFor="consent-html-content" className="input-label">Conteúdo do TCLE</label>
                <textarea
                  id="consent-html-content"
                  value={htmlContent}
                  onChange={(event) => setHtmlContent(event.target.value)}
                  rows={12}
                  className="consent-textarea"
                  placeholder="Cole aqui o texto completo do TCLE (HTML permitido)"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </Card>

          <Card className="consent-manager-permissions">
            <div className="consent-manager-permissions-header">
              <h2 className="consent-manager-section-title">Permissões granulares</h2>
              <Button variant="secondary" className="btn-small btn-ghost" onClick={handleAddPermission}>
                + Adicionar
              </Button>
            </div>
            <div className="consent-manager-permissions-list">
              {permissions.map((permission, index) => (
                <div key={`${permission.key}-${index}`} className="consent-permission-card">
                  <Input
                    label="ID da Permissão"
                    value={permission.key}
                    onChange={(event) => handleUpdatePermission(index, 'key', event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Ex: genetic_usage"
                  />
                  <Input
                    label="Texto para o Paciente"
                    value={permission.label}
                    onChange={(event) => handleUpdatePermission(index, 'label', event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Ex: Aceito uso genético"
                  />
                  <label className="consent-required-toggle">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={!!permission.required}
                      onChange={(event) => handleUpdatePermission(index, 'required', event.target.checked)}
                      aria-label={`Permissão obrigatória ${permission.key || index + 1}`}
                    />
                    É obrigatório?
                  </label>
                  {permissions.length > 1 && (
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      className="btn-small btn-ghost consent-remove-button"
                      onClick={() => handleRemovePermission(index)}
                    >
                      Remover permissão
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Card>

          <div className="consent-manager-actions">
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={!canSubmit || isSubmitting}>
              {isSubmitting ? 'Publicando...' : 'Publicar Nova Versão'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <Card className="consent-manager-history">
          <div className="consent-manager-history-header">
            <h2 className="consent-manager-section-title">Histórico de versões</h2>
            <Button variant="secondary" className="btn-small btn-ghost" onClick={loadHistory}>
              Atualizar
            </Button>
          </div>

          {loadingHistory ? (
            <div className="consent-manager-loading">
              <Spinner size="sm" />
              <span>Carregando histórico...</span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Table headers={['Versão', 'Título', 'Vigência', 'Status']}>
              {history.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={4} className="consent-manager-empty">
                    Nenhuma versão cadastrada.
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                history.map((policy) => (
                  <tr key={policy._id || `${policy.version}-${policy.title}`}>
                    <td className="consent-manager-version">{policy.version}</td>
                    <td>{policy.title}</td>
                    <td>
                      {policy.validFrom ? new Date(policy.validFrom).toLocaleDateString() : '--'}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      <span className={`consent-status ${policy.active ? 'active' : 'inactive'}`}>
                        {policy.active ? 'Ativo' : 'Inativo'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </Table>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import ConsentForm from '../components/ConsentForm';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Spinner from '../components/UI/Spinner';
import { consentService, patientService } from '../services/api';
import { ConsentTemplate } from '../types/models';
import { useToast } from '../components/UI/ToastContainer';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import './ConsentPage.css';

export default function ConsentPage() {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const { t } = useLanguage();

  const [patientName, setPatientName] = useState(t('consent.page.defaultPatientName'));
  const [template, setTemplate] = useState<ConsentTemplate | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const patientId = useMemo(() => id || '', [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const fetchData = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const [patientResponse, templateResponse] = await Promise.all([
          patientService.getById(patientId),
          consentService.getActiveTemplate()
        ]);

        const patientPayload = (patientResponse as any)?.data?.data ?? (patientResponse as any)?.data;
        const name = patientPayload?.patientName || patientPayload?.patientID || patientId;

        if (isMounted) {
          setPatientName(name ? String(name) : t('consent.page.defaultPatientName'));
          setTemplate(templateResponse.data?.data || null);
        }
      } catch (fetchError: any) {
        if (isMounted) {
          const message = fetchError?.message || t('consent.page.loadError');
          setError(message);
          showToast(message, 'error');
        }
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    if (patientId) {
      fetchData();
    } else {
      setLoading(false);
      setError(t('consent.page.missingPatient'));
    }

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [patientId]);

  const handleSubmit = async (payload: { responses: Record<string, boolean>; signatureName: string }) => {
    if (!template?._id) return;

    try {
      await consentService.createPatientConsent({
        patientId,
        templateId: template._id,
        responses: payload.responses,
        signatureName: payload.signatureName
      } as any);

      showToast(t('consent.page.submitSuccess'), 'success');
      navigate('/patients');
    } catch (submitError: any) {
      showToast(submitError?.message || t('consent.page.submitError'), 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    navigate('/patients');
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="page consent-page">
        <Card>
          <div className="consent-page-status">
            <Spinner size="sm" label={t('consent.page.loading')} />
            <span>{t('consent.page.loading')}</span>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !template) {
    return (
      <div className="page consent-page">
        <Card title={t('consent.page.cardTitle')}>
          <div className="consent-page-error">
            {error || t('consent.page.noActiveTemplate')}
          </div>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleCancel}>
            {t('common.back')}
          </Button>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="page consent-page">
      <ConsentForm
        patientName={patientName}
        templateText={template.htmlContent || template.content}
        permissions={template.permissions || []}
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        onCancel={handleCancel}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import { Users, FlaskConical, FileText, Thermometer, Box, Radio, Shield, FileSearch } from 'lucide-react';
import { usePatients } from '../hooks/usePatients';
import { useSamples } from '../hooks/useSamples';
import { useResults } from '../hooks/useResults';
import { useTemperature } from '../hooks/useTemperature';
import { usePolicies } from '../hooks/usePolicies';
import { useEquipment } from '../hooks/useEquipment';
import { useSensors } from '../hooks/useSensors';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { securityService } from '../services/api';
import './Dashboard.css';

export default function Dashboard() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user, hasAccess, hasRole } = useAuth();
  const { t, language } = useLanguage();
  const { patients, loading: loadingPatients } = usePatients();
  const { samples, loading: loadingSamples } = useSamples();
  const { results, loading: loadingResults } = useResults();
  const { temperatures, loading: loadingTemperatures, viewControl } = useTemperature();
  const { policies, loading: loadingPolicies } = usePolicies();
  const { equipment, loading: loadingEquipment } = useEquipment();
  const { sensors, loading: loadingSensors } = useSensors();
  const [consentQueueStats, setConsentQueueStats] = useState<{ waiting: number; delayed: number; active: number; failed: number; totalQueued: number; available: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [loadingConsentQueue, setLoadingConsentQueue] = useState(false);

  // TEMPORARIAMENTE DESATIVADO: Não há sensores cadastrados ainda
  const TEMPERATURE_READING_DISABLED = true;

  // Carrega controle de temperatura (não bloqueia o carregamento da dashboard)
  useEffect(() => {
    // Apenas tenta carregar se não estiver desativado, não estiver carregando e se a função existir
    if (!TEMPERATURE_READING_DISABLED && viewControl && !loadingTemperatures) {
      viewControl().catch((err) => {
        // Erro não bloqueia o carregamento da dashboard
        console.warn('Erro ao carregar controle de temperatura:', err);
      });
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []); // Executa apenas uma vez ao montar

  // Calcula estatísticas reais
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    // Garante que todos os dados sejam arrays
    const temperaturesArray = Array.isArray(temperatures) ? temperatures : [];
    const policiesArray = Array.isArray(policies) ? policies : [];
    // Para pacientes, se não houver dados e não estiver carregando, usa contagem mínima de 0
    // (os mockados são apenas para exibição na página, não para contagem na dashboard)
    const patientsArray = Array.isArray(patients) ? patients : [];
    const samplesArray = Array.isArray(samples) ? samples : [];
    const resultsArray = Array.isArray(results) ? results : [];
    const equipmentArray = Array.isArray(equipment) ? equipment : [];
    const sensorsArray = Array.isArray(sensors) ? sensors : [];

    // Calcula alertas de temperatura
    let temperatureAlerts = 0;
    temperaturesArray.forEach((temp) => {
      const policy = policiesArray.find((p) => p.policyID?.toString() === temp.policyID?.toString());
      if (policy) {
        if (
          temp.temperatureValue < policy.minThreshold ||
          temp.temperatureValue > policy.maxThreshold ||
          temp.readingStatus !== 'valid'
        ) {
          temperatureAlerts++;
        }
      }
    });

    return {
      patients: patientsArray.length,
      samples: samplesArray.length,
      results: resultsArray.length,
      temperatureAlerts,
      equipment: equipmentArray.length,
      sensors: sensorsArray.length,
      policies: policiesArray.length,
    };
  }, [patients, samples, results, temperatures, policies, equipment, sensors]);

  const loading = loadingPatients || loadingSamples || loadingResults || loadingTemperatures || 
                  loadingPolicies || loadingEquipment || loadingSensors;

  const isAdmin = user?.roleName === 'Administrador' || user?.accessType === 4;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;

    let mounted = true;
    const fetchQueueStats = async () => {
      setLoadingConsentQueue(true);
      try {
        const response = await securityService.getConsentQueueStatus();
        const payload = (response as any)?.data?.data;
        if (mounted) {
          setConsentQueueStats(payload || null);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (mounted) {
          setConsentQueueStats(null);
        }
      } finally {
        if (mounted) {
          setLoadingConsentQueue(false);
        }
      }
    };

    fetchQueueStats();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchQueueStats, 15000);
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [isAdmin]);

  // Define quais cards cada tipo de acesso pode ver
  const statCards = useMemo(() => {
    if (!user) return [];

    const allCards = [
      {
        title: t('dashboard.patients'),
        value: stats.patients,
        icon: Users,
        color: 'var(--primary)',
        link: '/patients',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [1, 2, 3, 4], // Inclui Administrador (4)
      },
      {
        title: t('dashboard.samples'),
        value: stats.samples,
        icon: FlaskConical,
        color: 'var(--success)',
        link: '/samples',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [1, 2, 3],
      },
      {
        title: t('dashboard.custodyReports') || 'Relatórios de Custódia',
        value: stats.samples,
        icon: FileSearch,
        color: '#4b5563',
        link: '/samples/custody-reports',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [2, 3, 4],
      },
      {
        title: t('dashboard.results'),
        value: stats.results,
        icon: FileText,
        color: 'var(--warning)',
        link: '/results',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [1, 2, 3],
      },
      {
        title: t('dashboard.temperatureAlerts'),
        value: stats.temperatureAlerts,
        icon: Thermometer,
        color: 'var(--danger)',
        link: '/temperature',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [2, 3, 4], // Administrador (4) também tem acesso
      },
      {
        title: t('dashboard.equipment'),
        value: stats.equipment,
        icon: Box,
        color: 'var(--secondary)',
        link: '/equipment',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [2, 3, 4], // Administrador (4) também tem acesso
      },
      {
        title: t('dashboard.sensors'),
        value: stats.sensors,
        icon: Radio,
        color: '#8b5cf6',
        link: '/sensors',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [2, 3, 4], // Administrador (4) também tem acesso
      },
      {
        title: t('dashboard.policies'),
        value: stats.policies,
        icon: Shield,
        color: '#06b6d4',
        link: '/policies',
        allowedRoles: ['Administrador', 'Coordenador', 'Técnico'],
        allowedAccessTypes: [2, 3, 4], // Administrador (4) também tem acesso
      },
    ];

    // Filtra cards baseado no role ou accessType
    return allCards.filter(card => {
      // Se tem roleName, usa ele
      if (user.roleName) {
        return card.allowedRoles.includes(user.roleName);
      }
      
      // Fallback para accessType com lógica hierárquica
      // Administrador (4) tem acesso a tudo
      if (user.accessType === 4) {
        return true;
      }
      // Coordenador (3) tem acesso a tudo exceto itens exclusivos de admin
      if (user.accessType === 3) {
        return card.allowedAccessTypes.includes(3) || card.allowedAccessTypes.includes(2);
      }
      // Técnico (2) tem acesso aos seus itens
      if (user.accessType === 2) {
        return card.allowedAccessTypes.includes(2) || card.allowedAccessTypes.includes(1);
      }
      // Usuário Externo (1) tem acesso apenas aos seus itens
      return card.allowedAccessTypes.includes(user.accessType || 0);
    });
  }, [user, stats, t, language]);

  return (
    <div className="dashboard-bento">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">{t('dashboard.title')}</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">{t('dashboard.subtitle')}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPIs Top */}
      <div className="kpi-grid">
        {statCards.map((stat) => {
          const Icon = stat.icon;
          const handleClick = () => {
            if (stat.link) navigate(stat.link);
          };
          const isAlert = stat.title === t('dashboard.temperatureAlerts');
          const variant = stat.link === '/patients'
            ? 'primary'
            : stat.link === '/samples'
            ? 'success'
            : stat.link === '/sensors'
            ? 'action'
            : stat.link === '/temperature'
            ? 'danger'
            : 'primary';
          return (
            <Card
              key={stat.title}
              className={`kpi-card ${isAlert ? 'alert' : ''}`}
              style={{ background: 'var(--color-surface)', boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-card)', borderRadius: '8px', cursor: stat.link ? 'pointer' : 'default' }}
              onClick={handleClick}
            >
              <div className={`kpi-icon kpi-icon--${variant}`}>
                <Icon size={22} />
              </div>
              <div className="kpi-info">
                <p className="kpi-title">{stat.title}</p>
                <p className="kpi-value">{loading ? '...' : stat.value}</p>
              </div>
            </Card>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Main Area: Temperature Chart + Alerts */}
      <div className="content-grid">
        <Card
          className="temperature-card"
          style={{ background: 'var(--color-surface)', boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-card)', borderRadius: '12px' }}
        >
          <div className="temperature-card-header">
            <h2 className="temperature-card-title">Gráfico de Temperatura</h2>
            <p className="temperature-card-subtitle">Monitoramento térmico contínuo</p>
          </div>
          <div className="temperature-chart-slot">
            {/* Mantenha o componente atual do gráfico aqui, se existir */}
          </div>
        </Card>

        <div className="side-card-stack">
          <Card
            className="side-card"
            style={{ background: 'var(--color-surface)', boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-card)', borderRadius: '12px' }}
          >
            <h3 className="side-card-title">{t('dashboard.temperatureAlertsActive')}</h3>
            <p className="side-card-text">
              {stats.temperatureAlerts > 0
                ? t('dashboard.temperatureAlertsMessage').replace('{count}', stats.temperatureAlerts.toString())
                : 'Nenhum alerta ativo no momento.'}
            </p>
          </Card>

          {isAdmin && (
            <Card
              className="side-card consent-queue-card"
              style={{ background: 'var(--color-surface)', boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-card)', borderRadius: '12px' }}
            >
              <h3 className="side-card-title">Fila de Consentimentos</h3>
              {loadingConsentQueue ? (
                <p className="side-card-text">Carregando...</p>
              ) : consentQueueStats?.available ? (
                <div className="consent-queue-metrics">
                  <div>
                    <span className="consent-queue-label">Na fila</span>
                    <strong>{consentQueueStats.totalQueued ?? 0}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="consent-queue-label">Em envio</span>
                    <strong>{consentQueueStats.active ?? 0}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="consent-queue-label">Falhas</span>
                    <strong>{consentQueueStats.failed ?? 0}</strong>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="side-card-text">Fila indisponível (Redis não configurado).</p>
              )}
            </Card>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import { Plus, Edit, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Equipment } from '../types/models';
import { useEquipment } from '../hooks/useEquipment';
import './EquipmentPage.css';

export default function EquipmentPage() {
  const { equipment, loading, error, createEquipment, updateEquipment, deleteEquipment } = useEquipment();
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingEquipment, setEditingEquipment] = useState<Equipment | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Equipamentos</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Gerenciamento de equipamentos de armazenamento</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}>
          <Plus size={18} />
          Novo Equipamento
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}

      <Card>
        <Table headers={['ID', 'Descrição', 'Ações']}>
          {equipment.map((eq) => (
            <tr key={eq.equipmentID}>
              <td>{eq.equipmentID}</td>
              <td>{eq.equipmentDescription}</td>
              <td>
                <div className="table-actions">
                  <button
                    className="action-button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setEditingEquipment(eq);
                      setIsModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                    title="Editar"
                  >
                    <Edit size={16} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="action-button danger"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir este equipamento?')) {
                        try {
                          await deleteEquipment(eq.equipmentID);
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          alert(err.message);
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    title="Excluir"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsModalOpen(false);
          setEditingEquipment(null);
        }}
        title={editingEquipment ? 'Editar Equipamento' : 'Novo Equipamento'}
      >
        <EquipmentForm
          equipment={editingEquipment}
          onSave={async (data) => {
            try {
              if (editingEquipment) {
                await updateEquipment(editingEquipment.equipmentID, data);
              } else {
                await createEquipment(data);
              }
              setIsModalOpen(false);
              setEditingEquipment(null);
            } catch (err: any) {
              alert(err.message);
            }
          }}
          onCancel={() => {
            setIsModalOpen(false);
            setEditingEquipment(null);
          }}
        />
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function EquipmentForm({
  equipment,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: {
  equipment: Equipment | null;
  onSave: (data: Partial<Equipment>) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Equipment>>(
    equipment || {
      equipmentDescription: '',
    }
  );

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onSave(formData);
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="form">
      <div className="form-grid">
        <Input
          label="Descrição do Equipamento"
          value={formData.equipmentDescription || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, equipmentDescription: e.target.value })
          }
          required
        />
      </div>
      <div className="form-actions">
        <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel}>
          Cancelar
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit">Salvar</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
