import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import Spinner from '../components/UI/Spinner';
import BarcodeLabel from '../components/BarcodeLabel';
import { Upload, FileText, FileSpreadsheet, ArrowLeft, CheckCircle, XCircle, AlertCircle, Clock } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { importLGPDService } from '../services/api';
import { useAsyncImport } from '../hooks/useAsyncImport';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { useToast } from '../components/UI/ToastContainer';
import './ImportPage.css';

export default function ImportPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [patientFile, setPatientFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [sampleFile, setSampleFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [locationFile, setLocationFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [importType, setImportType] = useState<'patients' | 'samples' | 'locations' | null>(null);
  
  // Hook de importação assíncrona
  const {
    validating,
    creating,
    validationError,
    validationOutcome,
    job,
    isPolling,
    importFile,
    getReport,
    reset,
  } = useAsyncImport();
  const [showBatchLabels, setShowBatchLabels] = useState(false);
  const [batchSamples, setBatchSamples] = useState<Array<{ sampleId: string | number; barcode: string; acronym?: string }>>([]);
  const [loadingLabels, setLoadingLabels] = useState(false);
  const [labelsError, setLabelsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showOutcomeModal, setShowOutcomeModal] = useState(false);

  const canImportPatients = user?.roleName === 'Administrador' || user?.roleName === 'Coordenador' || user?.accessType === 3 || user?.accessType === 4;
  const canImportSamples = user?.roleName === 'Administrador' || user?.roleName === 'Coordenador' || user?.roleName === 'Técnico' || user?.accessType === 2 || user?.accessType === 3 || user?.accessType === 4;
  const canImportLocations = canImportSamples;

  const normalizeSamplesFromReport = (report: any) => {
    const candidates = [
      report?.samples,
      report?.createdSamples,
      report?.successfulSamples,
      report?.records,
      report?.data?.samples,
      report?.data?.records,
    ];

    const firstList = candidates.find(Array.isArray) || [];

    const mapped = firstList.map((entry: any, index: number) => {
      const fallbackId = `amostra-${index + 1}`;
      const sampleId =
        entry?.sampleID ??
        entry?.sampleId ??
        entry?._id ??
        entry?.id ??
        entry?.resource?.id ??
        entry?.resource?.identifier?.[0]?.value ??
        fallbackId;

      const barcodeValue =
        entry?.barcode ??
        entry?.sampleID ??
        entry?.sampleId ??
        entry?._id ??
        entry?.id ??
        entry?.resource?.identifier?.[0]?.value ??
        sampleId;

      const acronym =
        entry?.acronym ??
        entry?.sampleType ??
        entry?.type ??
        (entry?.patientID ? `P${entry.patientID}` : undefined) ??
        (entry?.resource?.subject?.reference || undefined);

      return {
        sampleId: sampleId || fallbackId,
        barcode: String(barcodeValue || sampleId || fallbackId),
        acronym,
      };
    });

    if (mapped.length > 0) {
      return mapped;
    }

    if (Array.isArray(report?.fhirResources)) {
      return report.fhirResources.map((resource: any, index: number) => {
        const fallbackId = `fhir-${index + 1}`;
        const sampleId = resource?.id || resource?.resource?.id || fallbackId;
        const barcodeValue =
          resource?.identifier?.[0]?.value ||
          resource?.resource?.identifier?.[0]?.value ||
          sampleId;
        const acronym = resource?.resourceType || resource?.resource?.resourceType;
        return {
          sampleId,
          barcode: String(barcodeValue || sampleId || fallbackId),
          acronym,
        };
      });
    }

    return [];
  };

  const handleFileChange = (
    allowedExtensions: string[],
    setSelectedFile: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<File | null>>
  ) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const selectedFile = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (selectedFile) {
      const ext = selectedFile.name.toLowerCase().split('.').pop();
      if (!ext || !allowedExtensions.includes(ext)) {
        setSelectedFile(null);
        return;
      }
      setSelectedFile(selectedFile);
      reset(); // Reseta estado anterior ao selecionar novo arquivo
    }
  };

  const resolveFileByType = (type: 'patients' | 'samples' | 'locations') => {
    if (type === 'patients') return patientFile;
    if (type === 'samples') return sampleFile;
    return locationFile;
  };

  const handleImport = async (type: 'patients' | 'samples' | 'locations') => {
    const selectedFile = resolveFileByType(type);
    if (!selectedFile) {
      showToast(t('import.errors.noFileSelected'), 'error');
      return;
    }

    setImportType(type);
    reset(); // Reseta estado anterior

    try {
      await importFile(selectedFile, type, {
        onCompleted: (job) => {
          // Sucesso - job já contém os resultados
          console.log('Importação concluída:', job);
        },
        onFailed: (job) => {
          // Falha - job contém os erros
          console.error('Importação falhou:', job);
          showToast(t('import.errors.importError'), 'error');
        },
      });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao iniciar importação:', err);
      showToast(err?.message || t('import.errors.startError'), 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadTemplate = async (type: 'patients' | 'samples', format: 'csv' | 'xlsx') => {
    try {
      const response = await importLGPDService.downloadTemplate(type, format);
      
      // Cria link de download
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([response.data]));
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.href = url;
      link.setAttribute('download', `${type}_template.${format}`);
      document.body.appendChild(link);
      link.click();
      link.remove();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      showToast(err.response?.data?.error || t('import.errors.templateError'), 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadLocationTemplate = () => {
    const headers = ['locationID', 'equipmentType', 'equipmentID', 'block', 'rack', 'drawer', 'box', 'wellPosition'];
    const csvContent = `${headers.join(',')}\n`;
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute('download', 'locations_template.csv');
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleOpenBatchLabels = async () => {
    if (!job?.jobID) return;
    setLabelsError(null);
    setLoadingLabels(true);
    try {
      const response = await getReport();
      const reportData = (response as any)?.data?.data || (response as any)?.data || response;
      const parsed = normalizeSamplesFromReport(reportData || {});
      setBatchSamples(parsed);
      setShowBatchLabels(true);
      if (!parsed || parsed.length === 0) {
        setLabelsError(t('import.labels.noSamples'));
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const message = err?.message || t('import.labels.loadError');
      setLabelsError(message);
      showToast(message, 'error');
    } finally {
      setLoadingLabels(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '1rem' }}>
          <Button onClick={() => navigate('/dashboard')} variant="secondary" style={{ minWidth: 'auto' }}>
            <ArrowLeft size={18} />
          </Button>
          <div>
            <h1 className="page-title">{t('import.title')}</h1>
            <p className="page-subtitle">{t('import.subtitle')}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="import-container">
        {/* Importação de Amostras */}
        <Card className="import-card">
          <div className="import-card-header">
            <h2>{t('import.samples.title')}</h2>
            <p>{t('import.samples.description')}</p>
          </div>

          {!canImportSamples && (
            <div className="import-warning">
              <AlertCircle size={20} />
              <span>{t('import.samples.noPermission')}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {canImportSamples && (
            <>
              <div className="import-actions">
                <div className="template-downloads">
                  <span>{t('import.samples.downloadTemplate')}</span>
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    onClick={() => handleDownloadTemplate('samples', 'csv')}
                  >
                    <FileText size={16} />
                    {t('import.template.csv')}
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    onClick={() => handleDownloadTemplate('samples', 'xlsx')}
                  >
                    <FileSpreadsheet size={16} />
                    {t('import.template.excel')}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="import-upload">
                <input
                  type="file"
                  id="samples-file"
                  accept=".csv,.xlsx"
                  onChange={handleFileChange(['csv', 'xlsx'], setSampleFile)}
                  disabled={isPolling && importType === 'samples'}
                  style={{ display: 'none' }}
                />
                <label htmlFor="samples-file" className="file-input-label">
                  <Upload size={20} />
                  {sampleFile ? sampleFile.name : t('import.samples.selectFile')}
                </label>
              </div>

              <Button
                onClick={() => handleImport('samples')}
                disabled={!sampleFile || validating || creating || (isPolling && importType === 'samples')}
                style={{ marginTop: '1rem', width: '100%' }}
              >
                {validating && importType === 'samples' && (
                  <>
                    <Spinner size="sm" style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
                    {t('import.status.validating')}
                  </>
                )}
                {creating && importType === 'samples' && (
                  <>
                    <Spinner size="sm" style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
                    {t('import.status.creatingJob')}
                  </>
                )}
                {isPolling && importType === 'samples' && job && (
                  <>
                    <Spinner size="sm" style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
                    {t('import.status.processingWithProgress').replace('{progress}', String(job.progress))}
                  </>
                )}
                {!validating && !creating && !(isPolling && importType === 'samples') && t('import.samples.import')}
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </Card>


        {/* Status do Job de Importação */}
        {job && importType && (
          <Card className="import-result-card">
            <h3>{t('import.result.title')}</h3>
            
            {/* Indicador de Status */}
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
              {job.status === 'completed' && <CheckCircle size={20} className="status-icon completed" style={{ color: '#4CAF50' }} />}
              {job.status === 'failed' && <XCircle size={20} className="status-icon failed" style={{ color: '#f44336' }} />}
              {(job.status === 'processing' || job.status === 'pending') && <Clock size={20} className="status-icon processing" style={{ color: '#FF9800' }} />}
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 'bold', textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
                {job.status === 'completed' && t('import.jobStatus.completed')}
                {job.status === 'failed' && t('import.jobStatus.failed')}
                {job.status === 'processing' && t('import.jobStatus.processing')}
                {job.status === 'pending' && t('import.jobStatus.pending')}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Barra de Progresso */}
            {(job.status === 'processing' || job.status === 'pending') && (
              <div style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
                <div style={{ 
                  width: '100%', 
                  height: '8px', 
                  backgroundColor: '#e0e0e0', 
                  borderRadius: '4px',
                  overflow: 'hidden'
                }}>
                  <div style={{ 
                    width: `${job.progress}%`, 
                    height: '100%', 
                    backgroundColor: '#4CAF50',
                    transition: 'width 0.3s ease'
                  }} />
                </div>
                <p style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem', fontSize: '0.9rem', color: '#666' }}>
                  {t('import.jobStatus.progress').replace('{progress}', String(job.progress))}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Estatísticas */}
            <div className="result-stats">
              <div className="result-stat">
                <span className="stat-label">{t('import.result.totalRecords')}:</span>
                <span className="stat-value">{job.totalRecords}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="result-stat success">
                <CheckCircle size={20} />
                <span className="stat-label">{t('import.result.successful')}:</span>
                <span className="stat-value">{job.successCount}</span>
              </div>
              {job.errorCount > 0 && (
                <div className="result-stat error">
                  <XCircle size={20} />
                  <span className="stat-label">{t('import.result.errors')}:</span>
                  <span className="stat-value">{job.errorCount}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {job.status === 'completed' && importType === 'samples' && (
              <div className="label-print-actions">
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  onClick={handleOpenBatchLabels}
                  disabled={loadingLabels}
                  title={t('import.labels.printTitle')}
                >
                  🖨️ {t('import.labels.printBatch')}
                </Button>
                {labelsError && <p className="label-print-error">{labelsError}</p>}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Detalhes de Erros */}
            {job.errors && job.errors.length > 0 && (
              <div className="errors-details" style={{ marginTop: '1rem' }}>
                <h4>{t('import.result.errorDetails')}:</h4>
                <div className="errors-list">
                  {job.errors.slice(0, 10).map((err: any, index: number) => (
                    <div key={index} className="error-item">
                      <strong>{err.row ? `${t('import.result.row')} ${err.row}:` : t('import.result.errorLabel')}</strong>
                      <ul>
                        <li>{err.error || (Array.isArray(err.errors) ? err.errors.join(', ') : String(err.errors))}</li>
                      </ul>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {job.errors.length > 10 && (
                    <p style={{ fontStyle: 'italic', color: '#666' }}>
                      {t('import.result.moreErrors').replace('{count}', String(job.errors.length - 10))}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Mensagem de Sucesso */}
            {job.status === 'completed' && job.errorCount === 0 && (
              <div style={{ 
                marginTop: '1rem', 
                padding: '1rem', 
                backgroundColor: '#e8f5e9', 
                borderRadius: '4px',
                color: '#2e7d32'
              }}>
                ✅ {t('import.result.successful')}: {t('import.result.allRecordsSuccess')}
              </div>
            )}
          </Card>
        )}

        {/* Mensagem de Erro de Validação */}
        {validationError && (
          <Card className="import-error-card">
            <AlertCircle size={20} />
            <span>{validationError}</span>
            {validationOutcome && (
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={() => setShowOutcomeModal(true)}
                style={{ marginLeft: '0.75rem' }}
              >
                {t('import.validation.viewTechnicalDetails')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </Card>
        )}

        {showBatchLabels && (
          <Modal
            isOpen={showBatchLabels}
            onClose={() => setShowBatchLabels(false)}
            title={t('import.labels.modalTitle')}
          >
            <div className="label-print-scope">
              {loadingLabels ? (
                <p><Spinner size="sm" label={t('import.labels.loading')} /> {t('import.labels.loading')}</p>
              ) : batchSamples.length === 0 ? (
                <p>{t('import.labels.noSamples')}</p>
              ) : (
                <div className="label-print-grid">
                  {batchSamples.map((sample) => (
                    <div key={String(sample.sampleId)} className="label-item">
                      <BarcodeLabel
                        sampleId={sample.sampleId}
                        barcode={sample.barcode}
                        acronym={sample.acronym}
                      />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="label-modal-actions">
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowBatchLabels(false)}>
                  {t('common.close')}
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={() => window.print()} disabled={loadingLabels || batchSamples.length === 0}>
                  {t('common.print')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </Modal>
        )}

        {showOutcomeModal && validationOutcome && (
          <Modal
            isOpen={showOutcomeModal}
            onClose={() => setShowOutcomeModal(false)}
            title={t('import.validation.detailsTitle')}
          >
            <pre style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
              {JSON.stringify(validationOutcome, null, 2)}
            </pre>
          </Modal>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import { Plus, Edit, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Location, Equipment } from '../types/models';
import { useLocations } from '../hooks/useLocations';
import { useEquipment } from '../hooks/useEquipment';
import './LocationPage.css';

// Função helper para obter a descrição do tipo de equipamento
function getEquipmentTypeDescription(equipmentType: number | undefined): string {
  if (!equipmentType) return '-';
  const types: Record<number, string> = {
    1: 'Freezer -80°C #1',
    2: 'Freezer -80°C #2',
    3: 'Freezer -20°C',
    4: 'Refrigerador 4°C',
    5: 'Nitrogênio Líquido',
  };
  return types[equipmentType] || `Tipo ${equipmentType}`;
}

export default function LocationPage() {
  const { equipment } = useEquipment();
  const { locations, loading, error, createLocation, updateLocation, deleteLocation } = useLocations();
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingLocation, setEditingLocation] = useState<Location | null>(null);

  // Importação de localizações
  const [importFile, setImportFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [importProgress, setImportProgress] = useState('');

  const handleImportLocations = async (file?: File) => {
    const fileToImport = file || importFile;
    if (!fileToImport) {
      alert('Selecione um arquivo para importar.');
      return;
    }
    setImporting(true);
    setImportProgress(`Arquivo: ${fileToImport.name}`);
    // Aqui você pode implementar a chamada real para o backend
    setTimeout(() => {
      setImporting(false);
      setImportProgress('Importação concluída (simulação)');
      setImportFile(null);
    }, 2000);
  };


  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Localizações</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Gerenciamento de localizações físicas de amostras</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}>
          <Plus size={18} />
          Nova Localização
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Seção de importação de localizações */}
      <Card className="import-card" style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <div className="import-card-header">
          <h2>Importação de Localizações</h2>
          <p>Importe localizações em lote via CSV ou Excel. Siga o template para garantir o formato correto.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="import-actions" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => {
            const url = '/import-templates/locations-template.csv';
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = url;
            link.setAttribute('download', 'locations-template.csv');
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            link.remove();
          }}>Baixar Template CSV</Button>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => {
            const url = '/import-templates/locations-template.xlsx';
            const link = document.createElement('a');
            link.href = url;
            link.setAttribute('download', 'locations-template.xlsx');
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            link.remove();
          }}>Baixar Template Excel</Button>
        </div>
        <div className="import-upload" style={{ border: '1px dashed #ccc', padding: 16, borderRadius: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <input type="file" accept=".csv, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" onChange={e => {
            const file = e.target.files?.[0];
            if (file) {
              setImportFile(file);
              setImportProgress('');
              setTimeout(() => handleImportLocations(file), 100);
            }
          }} />
          <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#666' }}>Selecione um arquivo CSV ou Excel conforme o template.</p>
        </div>
        {importing && <p>Importando localizações...</p>}
        {importProgress && <p style={{ color: '#166534' }}>{importProgress}</p>}
      </Card>

      {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}

      <Card>
        <Table
          headers={[
            'Tipo Equipamento',
            'Equipamento',
            'Bloco',
            'Prateleira',
            'Gaveta',
            'Caixa',
            'Poço Eppendorf',
            'Ações',
          ]}
        >
          {locations.map((location, index) => (
            <tr key={(location as any)._id || index}>
              <td>{location.equipmentType}</td>
              <td>
                {location.equipmentID
                  ? (() => {
                      const eq = equipment.find((e) => e.equipmentID === location.equipmentID);
                      if (eq) {
                        return (
                          <div>
                            <strong>ID {eq.equipmentID}</strong> - {eq.equipmentDescription}
                            {eq.model && <div style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Modelo: {eq.model}</div>}
                          </div>
                        );
                      }
                      return 'N/A';
                    })()
                  : <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-light)', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>Não vinculado</span>}
              </td>
              <td>{location.block}</td>
              <td>{location.rack}</td>
              <td>{location.drawer}</td>
              <td>{location.box}</td>
              <td>{location.wellPosition || location.eppendorfWell || '-'}</td>
              <td>
                <div className="table-actions">
                  <button
                    className="action-button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setEditingLocation(location);
                      setIsModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                    title="Editar"
                  >
                    <Edit size={16} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="action-button danger"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir esta localização?')) {
                        try {
                          // Assumindo que Location tem _id do MongoDB
                          const locationId = (location as any)._id || index.toString();
                          await deleteLocation(locationId);
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          alert(err.message);
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    title="Excluir"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsModalOpen(false);
          setEditingLocation(null);
        }}
        title={editingLocation ? 'Editar Localização' : 'Nova Localização'}
      >
        <LocationForm
          location={editingLocation}
          onSave={async (data) => {
            try {
              if (editingLocation) {
                const locationId = (editingLocation as any)._id || '';
                await updateLocation(locationId, data);
              } else {
                await createLocation(data);
              }
              setIsModalOpen(false);
              setEditingLocation(null);
            } catch (err: any) {
              alert(err.message);
            }
          }}
          onCancel={() => {
            setIsModalOpen(false);
            setEditingLocation(null);
          }}
        />
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function LocationForm({
  location,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: {
  location: Location | null;
  onSave: (data: Partial<Location>) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const [equipment] = useState<Equipment[]>([
    {
      equipmentID: 1,
      equipmentDescription: 'Freezer -80°C',
    },
    {
      equipmentID: 2,
      equipmentDescription: 'Refrigerador 4°C',
    },
  ]);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Location>>(() => {
    if (location) {
      return {
        equipmentType: location.equipmentType || 1,
        equipmentID: location.equipmentID,
        block: location.block || 1,
        rack: location.rack || 1,
        drawer: location.drawer || 1,
        box: location.box || 1,
        eppendorfWell: location.wellPosition || location.eppendorfWell || '',
      };
    }
    return {
      equipmentType: 1,
      equipmentID: undefined,
      block: 1,
      rack: 1,
      drawer: 1,
      box: 1,
      eppendorfWell: 'A1',
    };
  });

  // Atualiza o formData quando location muda (para edição)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (location) {
      setFormData({
        equipmentType: location.equipmentType || 1,
        equipmentID: location.equipmentID,
        block: location.block || 1,
        rack: location.rack || 1,
        drawer: location.drawer || 1,
        box: location.box || 1,
        eppendorfWell: location.wellPosition || location.eppendorfWell || '',
      });
    } else {
      setFormData({
        equipmentType: 1,
        equipmentID: undefined,
        block: 1,
        rack: 1,
        drawer: 1,
        box: 1,
        eppendorfWell: 'A1',
      });
    }
  }, [location]);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    // Prepara os dados para envio, convertendo tipos e campos
    const dataToSave: any = {
      equipmentType: formData.equipmentType ? Number(formData.equipmentType) : null,
      equipmentID: formData.equipmentID ? Number(formData.equipmentID) : undefined,
      block: formData.block ? Number(formData.block) : null,
      rack: formData.rack ? Number(formData.rack) : null,
      drawer: formData.drawer ? Number(formData.drawer) : null,
      box: formData.box ? Number(formData.box) : null,
    };
    
    // Converte eppendorfWell (string) para wellPosition (string)
    if (formData.eppendorfWell) {
      dataToSave.wellPosition = String(formData.eppendorfWell);
      // Remove eppendorfWell para evitar conflito
      delete dataToSave.eppendorfWell;
    }
    
    onSave(dataToSave);
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="form">
      <div className="form-grid">
        <div className="form-grid-full">
          <label className="input-label">Tipo de Equipamento *</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            value={formData.equipmentType || ''}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setFormData({ ...formData, equipmentType: parseInt(e.target.value) })
            }
            required
          >
            <option value="">Selecione um tipo de equipamento</option>
            <option value="1">1 - Freezer -80°C #1</option>
            <option value="2">2 - Freezer -80°C #2</option>
            <option value="3">3 - Freezer -20°C</option>
            <option value="4">4 - Refrigerador 4°C</option>
            <option value="5">5 - Nitrogênio Líquido</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid-full">
          <label className="input-label">Equipamento Cadastrado no Sistema *</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            value={formData.equipmentID || ''}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setFormData({
                ...formData,
                equipmentID: e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : undefined,
              })
            }
            required
          >
            <option value="">Selecione um equipamento cadastrado</option>
            {equipment.map((eq) => (
              <option key={eq.equipmentID} value={eq.equipmentID}>
                ID {eq.equipmentID} - {eq.equipmentDescription}
                {eq.model ? ` | Modelo: ${eq.model}` : ''}
                {eq.serialNumber ? ` | S/N: ${eq.serialNumber}` : ''}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <p className="form-help-text" style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem', fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>
            Selecione o equipamento físico cadastrado no sistema que será associado a esta localização
          </p>
        </div>
        <Input
          label="Bloco"
          type="number"
          value={formData.block || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, block: parseInt(e.target.value) })
          }
          required
        />
        <Input
          label="Prateleira"
          type="number"
          value={formData.rack || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, rack: parseInt(e.target.value) })
          }
          required
        />
        <Input
          label="Gaveta"
          type="number"
          value={formData.drawer || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, drawer: parseInt(e.target.value) })
          }
          required
        />
        <Input
          label="Caixa"
          type="number"
          value={formData.box || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, box: parseInt(e.target.value) })
          }
          required
        />
        <Input
          label="Poço Eppendorf (ex: A1)"
          value={formData.eppendorfWell || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, eppendorfWell: e.target.value })
          }
          required
        />
      </div>
      <div className="form-actions">
        <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel}>
          Cancelar
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit">Salvar</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import { Log } from '../types/models';
import { logService } from '../services/api';
import { formatPayload, formatMetadata } from '../utils/logFormatter';
import { formatEntityID } from '../utils/entityIdFormatter';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { 
  ArrowLeft,
  XCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertCircle
} from 'lucide-react';
import './LogsPage.css';

export default function LogDetailPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [log, setLog] = useState<Log | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadLog = async () => {
      if (!id) {
        setError(t('logs.detailPage.errors.missingId'));
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        setLoading(true);
        setError(null);
        
        // Limpa o ID para garantir que está em formato string
        const cleanId = typeof id === 'string' ? id : String(id);
        
        const response = await logService.getById(cleanId);
        
        if (response && response.data) {
          if (response.data.success && response.data.data) {
            setLog(response.data.data);
          } else if (response.data.error) {
            setError(response.data.error);
          } else {
            setError(t('logs.detailPage.notFound'));
          }
        } else {
          setError(t('logs.detailPage.errors.invalidResponse'));
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error('Erro ao carregar log:', err);
        const errorMessage = err.response?.data?.error || 
                           err.response?.data?.message || 
                           err.message || 
                           t('logs.detailPage.errors.load');
        setError(errorMessage);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    loadLog();
  }, [id]);

  const formatTimestamp = (log: Log) => {
    try {
      if (log.timestampISO) {
        const date = new Date(log.timestampISO);
        if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
          return date.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
            day: '2-digit',
            month: '2-digit',
            year: 'numeric',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            second: '2-digit'
          });
        }
      }
      if (log.timestamp) {
        let date: Date;
        if (typeof log.timestamp === 'string') {
          date = new Date(log.timestamp);
        } else if (log.timestamp instanceof Date) {
          date = log.timestamp;
        } else if (typeof log.timestamp === 'object' && (log.timestamp as any)?._type === 'Date') {
          // Se for um objeto Date serializado
          date = new Date((log.timestamp as any)._value || log.timestamp);
        } else {
          date = new Date(log.timestamp);
        }
        if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
          return date.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
            day: '2-digit',
            month: '2-digit',
            year: 'numeric',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            second: '2-digit'
          });
        }
      }
      if (log.dateTime) {
        const date = typeof log.dateTime === 'string' ? new Date(log.dateTime) : new Date(log.dateTime);
        if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
          return date.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
            day: '2-digit',
            month: '2-digit',
            year: 'numeric',
            hour: '2-digit',
            minute: '2-digit',
            second: '2-digit'
          });
        }
      }
      return 'N/A';
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Erro ao formatar timestamp:', error);
      return 'N/A';
    }
  };

  const getSeverityColor = (severity: string) => {
    if (!severity) return 'var(--text-light)';
    switch (severity.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'CRITICAL':
        return '#dc2626';
      case 'ERROR':
        return 'var(--danger)';
      case 'WARNING':
        return 'var(--warning)';
      case 'INFO':
        return '#3b82f6';
      default:
        return 'var(--text-light)';
    }
  };

  const getSeverityIcon = (severity: string) => {
    if (!severity) return <Info size={16} />;
    switch (severity.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'CRITICAL':
      case 'ERROR':
        return <XCircle size={16} />;
      case 'WARNING':
        return <AlertTriangle size={16} />;
      case 'INFO':
        return <Info size={16} />;
      default:
        return <Info size={16} />;
    }
  };

  const getResultColor = (result: string) => {
    if (!result) return 'var(--text-light)';
    switch (result.toUpperCase()) {
      case 'SUCCESS':
        return 'var(--success)';
      case 'ERROR':
      case 'FAILURE':
        return 'var(--danger)';
      case 'WARNING':
        return 'var(--warning)';
      default:
        return 'var(--text-light)';
    }
  };

  const getModuleColor = (module: string) => {
    if (!module) return 'var(--text-light)';
    const moduleLower = module.toLowerCase();
    if (moduleLower.includes('autenticação') || moduleLower.includes('auth')) return '#3b82f6';
    if (moduleLower.includes('cadastro') || moduleLower.includes('patient')) return '#10b981';
    if (moduleLower.includes('amostra') || moduleLower.includes('sample')) return '#8b5cf6';
    if (moduleLower.includes('importação') || moduleLower.includes('import')) return '#f59e0b';
    if (moduleLower.includes('configuração') || moduleLower.includes('config')) return '#6366f1';
    if (moduleLower.includes('segurança') || moduleLower.includes('security')) return '#ef4444';
    if (moduleLower.includes('assistente') || moduleLower.includes('ia')) return '#ec4899';
    return 'var(--text-light)';
  };

  const handleCopy = async (value: string) => {
    try {
      if (navigator?.clipboard?.writeText) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
      } else {
        const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
        textarea.value = value;
        textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
        textarea.style.opacity = '0';
        document.body.appendChild(textarea);
        textarea.focus();
        textarea.select();
        document.execCommand('copy');
        document.body.removeChild(textarea);
      }
      setCopied(true);
      setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Erro ao copiar hash:', e);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="logs-page">
        <Card>
          <div style={{ padding: '2rem', textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <p>{t('logs.detailPage.loading')}</p>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !log) {
    return (
      <div className="logs-page">
        <Card>
          <div style={{ padding: '2rem', textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{error || t('logs.detailPage.notFound')}</p>
            <Button onClick={() => navigate('/logs')} style={{ marginTop: '1rem' }}>
              <ArrowLeft size={18} />
              {t('logs.detailPage.back')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="logs-page">
      <Card>
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '1.5rem' }}>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => navigate('/logs')}
            variant="secondary"
            style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}
          >
            <ArrowLeft size={18} />
            {t('logs.detailPage.back')}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <h1 style={{ marginBottom: '1.5rem', fontSize: '1.5rem', fontWeight: 600 }}>
          {t('logs.detailPage.title')}
        </h1>

        <div className="log-details">
          <div className="detail-section">
            <h3>{t('logs.detailPage.sections.basic')}</h3>
            <div className="detail-grid">
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.id')}</label>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                  {(() => {
                    const id = log._id || log.logID;
                    if (!id) return 'N/A';
                    // Se for objeto serializado (ObjectId), extrai o valor
                    if (typeof id === 'object' && id._type === 'ObjectId') {
                      return id._value || String(id);
                    }
                    // Se for objeto com toString
                    if (typeof id === 'object' && id.toString) {
                      return id.toString();
                    }
                    return String(id);
                  })()}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.dateTime')}</label>
                <span>{formatTimestamp(log)}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.timestampISO')}</label>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                  {(() => {
                    try {
                      if (log.timestampISO) return log.timestampISO;
                      if (log.timestamp) {
                        let date: Date;
                        if (typeof log.timestamp === 'string') {
                          date = new Date(log.timestamp);
                        } else if (log.timestamp instanceof Date) {
                          date = log.timestamp;
                        } else if (typeof log.timestamp === 'object' && (log.timestamp as any)?._type === 'Date') {
                          date = new Date((log.timestamp as any)._value);
                        } else {
                          date = new Date(log.timestamp);
                        }
                        if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
                          return date.toISOString();
                        }
                      }
                      return 'N/A';
                    } catch (e) {
                      return 'N/A';
                    }
                  })()}
                </span>
              </div>
              {log.auditHash && (
                <div className="detail-item">
                  <label>{t('logs.details.auditHash')}</label>
                  <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.8125rem', wordBreak: 'break-all', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                    {log.auditHash}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="view-log-button"
                      onClick={() => handleCopy(log.auditHash as string)}
                      title={t('logs.details.copyHash')}
                    >
                      {t('logs.details.copyHash')}
                    </button>
                    {copied && (
                      <span style={{ color: 'var(--success)', fontSize: '0.75rem' }}>{t('logs.details.copied')}</span>
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>
              )}
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.message')}</label>
                <span style={{ wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>
                  {log.message || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.user')}</label>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.9375rem' }}>
                  {log.userName || log.userID || 'USR-SYSTEM'}
                </span>
                <small style={{ display: 'block', color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.25rem', fontSize: '0.75rem', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                  {t('logs.details.userHint')}
                </small>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.action')}</label>
                <span 
                  className="action-badge"
                  style={{
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-color)',
                    fontFamily: 'monospace',
                    fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                    fontWeight: 500
                  }}
                >
                  {log.action || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.entity')}</label>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>
                  {log.entity || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.details.entityID')}</label>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', fontSize: '0.8125rem' }}>
                  {formatEntityID(log.entityID)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.severity')}</label>
                <span
                  className="severity-badge"
                  style={{ 
                    color: getSeverityColor(log.severity || 'info'),
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '0.25rem'
                  }}
                >
                  {getSeverityIcon(log.severity || 'INFO')}
                  <span>{log.severity || 'INFO'}</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.result')}</label>
                <span
                  className="result-badge"
                  style={{ 
                    color: getResultColor(log.result || ''),
                    borderColor: getResultColor(log.result || ''),
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '0.25rem'
                  }}
                >
                  {log.result === 'success' ? <CheckCircle size={14} /> : 
                   log.result === 'error' || log.result === 'failure' ? <XCircle size={14} /> :
                   <AlertCircle size={14} />}
                  <span>{log.result || 'N/A'}</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.details.module')}</label>
                <span
                  className="module-badge"
                  style={{ 
                    color: getModuleColor(log.module || ''),
                    borderColor: getModuleColor(log.module || ''),
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    border: '1px solid',
                    fontSize: '0.8125rem',
                    fontWeight: 500
                  }}
                >
                  {log.module || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="detail-section">
            <h3>{t('logs.detailPage.sections.tracking')}</h3>
            <div className="detail-grid">
              <div className="detail-item">
                <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.ipSource')}</label>
                <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                  {log.ipSource || log.sourceIP || log.metadata?.tracking?.ip || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
              {log.metadata && typeof log.metadata === 'object' && log.metadata.tracking && (
                <>
                  <div className="detail-item">
                    <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.ipOriginal')}</label>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                      {(log.metadata.tracking as any)?.ipOriginal || 'N/A'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="detail-item">
                    <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.forwardedFor')}</label>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                      {(log.metadata.tracking as any)?.forwardedFor || 'N/A'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="detail-item">
                    <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.userAgent')}</label>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', wordBreak: 'break-word' }}>
                      {(log.metadata.tracking as any)?.userAgent || 'N/A'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="detail-item">
                    <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.referer')}</label>
                    <span>{(log.metadata.tracking as any)?.referer || 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="detail-item">
                    <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.host')}</label>
                    <span>{(log.metadata.tracking as any)?.host || 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="detail-item">
                    <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.protocol')}</label>
                    <span>{(log.metadata.tracking as any)?.protocol || 'N/A'}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="detail-item">
                    <label>{t('logs.detailPage.labels.secure')}</label>
                    <span>{(log.metadata.tracking as any)?.secure ? t('logs.detailPage.labels.secureYes') : t('logs.detailPage.labels.secureNo')}</span>
                  </div>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {log.payload && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h3>{t('logs.detailPage.sections.payload')}</h3>
              <pre className="payload-content" style={{ 
                whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', 
                wordBreak: 'break-word',
                overflowWrap: 'anywhere'
              }}>
                {(() => {
                  try {
                    return formatPayload(log.payload);
                  } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Erro ao formatar payload:', error);
                    return JSON.stringify(log.payload, null, 2) || t('logs.detailPage.errors.payloadFormat');
                  }
                })()}
              </pre>
            </div>
          )}

          {log.errorStack && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h3>{t('logs.detailPage.sections.stack')}</h3>
              <pre className="error-stack-content" style={{ 
                whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', 
                wordBreak: 'break-word',
                overflowWrap: 'anywhere'
              }}>
                {log.errorStack}
              </pre>
            </div>
          )}

          {log.metadata && (
            <div className="detail-section">
              <h3>{t('logs.detailPage.sections.metadata')}</h3>
              <pre className="metadata-content" style={{ 
                whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', 
                wordBreak: 'break-word',
                overflowWrap: 'anywhere'
              }}>
                {(() => {
                  try {
                    return formatMetadata(log.metadata);
                  } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Erro ao formatar metadata:', error);
                    return JSON.stringify(log.metadata, null, 2) || t('logs.detailPage.errors.metadataFormat');
                  }
                })()}
              </pre>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: C:\Projeto\BioAvanceD\frontend\src\pages\LoginPage.tsx
================================================================================
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import LanguageSelector from '../components/LanguageSelector';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { authService } from '../services/api';
import { Mail, CheckCircle, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import './LoginPage.css';

export default function LoginPage() {
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [twoFactorCode, setTwoFactorCode] = useState('');
  const [requiresTwoFactor, setRequiresTwoFactor] = useState(false);
  const [attemptsRemaining, setAttemptsRemaining] = useState<number | undefined>();
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showForgotPassword, setShowForgotPassword] = useState(false);
  const [forgotPasswordEmail, setForgotPasswordEmail] = useState('');
  const [forgotPasswordLoading, setForgotPasswordLoading] = useState(false);
  const [forgotPasswordSuccess, setForgotPasswordSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [forgotPasswordError, setForgotPasswordError] = useState('');
  const [resetLink, setResetLink] = useState('');
  const { login, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Se já estiver autenticado, redireciona
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAuthenticated) {
      navigate('/dashboard');
    }
  }, [isAuthenticated, navigate]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      console.log('handleSubmit chamado', { 
        username, 
        requiresTwoFactor, 
        twoFactorCode: twoFactorCode?.length 
      });

      const result = await login(username, password, requiresTwoFactor ? twoFactorCode : undefined);
      
      console.log('Resultado do login:', result);
      
      if (result && result.requiresTwoFactorSetup) {
        // Redireciona para página de configuração de MFA
        navigate('/mfa-setup', { 
          state: { 
            isFirstLogin: true,
            username: username,
            password: password
          } 
        });
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      
      if (result && result.requiresTwoFactor) {
        setRequiresTwoFactor(true);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      
      // Login bem-sucedido - redireciona
      console.log('Login bem-sucedido, redirecionando...');
      navigate('/dashboard', { replace: true });
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro no login:', err);
      
      if (err.requiresTwoFactor) {
        setRequiresTwoFactor(true);
        setAttemptsRemaining(err.attemptsRemaining);
        setError(err.message || t('auth.mfaRequired'));
      } else {
        const errorMessage = err.response?.data?.error || 
                           err.response?.data?.message || 
                           err.message || 
                           t('auth.loginError');
        setError(errorMessage);
        setRequiresTwoFactor(false);
        setTwoFactorCode('');
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="login-page">
      <div className="login-container">
        <Card className="login-card">
          <div className="login-header">
            <h1 className="login-title">{t('app.title')}</h1>
            <p className="login-subtitle">{t('app.subtitle')}</p>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="login-form">
            {error && (
              <div className="error-message">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            <Input
              label={t('auth.username')}
              type="text"
              value={username}
              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              required
              autoFocus
              placeholder={t('auth.username')}
            />

            <Input
              label={t('auth.password')}
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              placeholder={t('auth.password')}
              disabled={requiresTwoFactor}
            />

            {requiresTwoFactor && (
              <div className="two-factor-section">
                <Input
                  label={t('auth.twoFactorCode')}
                  type="text"
                  value={twoFactorCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setTwoFactorCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6))}
                  required
                  placeholder={t('mfa.enterCode')}
                  autoFocus
                  maxLength={6}
                />
                {attemptsRemaining !== undefined && attemptsRemaining > 0 && (
                  <p className="attempts-warning">
                    {t('auth.attemptsRemaining')}: {attemptsRemaining}
                  </p>
                )}
                <p className="two-factor-info">
                  {t('auth.twoFactorInfo')}
                </p>
              </div>
            )}

            <Button 
              type="submit" 
              className="login-button"
              disabled={loading}
            >
              {loading ? t('common.loading') : requiresTwoFactor ? t('mfa.verify') : t('auth.login')}
            </Button>

            <div className="forgot-password-link">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowForgotPassword(true)}
                className="link-button"
              >
                {t('auth.forgotPassword')}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>

          <div className="login-language-selector">
            <LanguageSelector />
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>


      {/* Modal de recuperação de senha */}
      <Modal
        isOpen={showForgotPassword}
        onClose={() => {
          setShowForgotPassword(false);
          setForgotPasswordEmail('');
          setForgotPasswordSuccess(false);
          setForgotPasswordError('');
          setResetLink('');
        }}
        title={t('auth.resetPassword')}
      >
        <div className="forgot-password-modal">
          {forgotPasswordError && (
            <div className="error-message" style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
              <AlertCircle size={16} />
              {forgotPasswordError}
            </div>
          )}
          {!forgotPasswordSuccess ? (
            <>
              <p style={{ marginBottom: '1.5rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                Digite seu email cadastrado. Enviaremos um link para redefinir sua senha.
              </p>
              <Input
                label="Email"
                type="email"
                value={forgotPasswordEmail}
                onChange={(e) => setForgotPasswordEmail(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="seu@email.com"
                required
                autoFocus
              />
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', marginTop: '1.5rem' }}>
                <Button
                  onClick={async () => {
                    if (!forgotPasswordEmail) {
                      setForgotPasswordError('Digite seu email');
                      return;
                    }
                    setForgotPasswordLoading(true);
                    setForgotPasswordError('');
                    try {
                      const response = await authService.requestPasswordReset(forgotPasswordEmail);
                      setForgotPasswordSuccess(true);
                      if (response.data.resetLink) {
                        setResetLink(response.data.resetLink);
                      }
                      if (response.data.token) {
                        // Em desenvolvimento, mostra o token
                        setResetLink(`${window.location.origin}/reset-password?token=${response.data.token}`);
                      }
                    } catch (err: any) {
                      setForgotPasswordError(err.response?.data?.error || 'Erro ao solicitar recuperação de senha');
                    } finally {
                      setForgotPasswordLoading(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  disabled={forgotPasswordLoading || !forgotPasswordEmail}
                >
                  <Mail size={18} />
                  {t('auth.sendResetLink')}
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowForgotPassword(false);
                    setForgotPasswordEmail('');
                  }}
                >
                  {t('common.cancel')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </>
          ) : (
            <div className="forgot-password-success">
              <CheckCircle size={48} style={{ color: '#28a745', marginBottom: '1rem' }} />
              <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 1rem 0' }}>Link de Recuperação Enviado!</h3>
              <p style={{ marginBottom: '1rem', color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                {resetLink ? (
                  <>
                    Em desenvolvimento, o link de recuperação é:
                    <div style={{ marginTop: '1rem', padding: '1rem', backgroundColor: '#f8f9fa', borderRadius: '6px' }}>
                      <Link to={resetLink.replace(window.location.origin, '')} style={{ wordBreak: 'break-all', color: 'var(--primary)' }}>
                        {resetLink}
                      </Link>
                    </div>
                    <p style={{ marginTop: '1rem', fontSize: '0.9rem', color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>
                      Em produção, este link seria enviado por email.
                    </p>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  'Se o email existir em nosso sistema, um link de recuperação foi enviado. Verifique sua caixa de entrada.'
                )}
              </p>
              <Button
                onClick={() => {
                  setShowForgotPassword(false);
                  setForgotPasswordEmail('');
                  setForgotPasswordSuccess(false);
                  setResetLink('');
                }}
              >
                Fechar
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}
