import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import { ArrowLeft, Download, FileText, Calendar, Printer, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Reports } from '../types/models';
import { reportsService } from '../services/api';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { getPatientDisplayName } from '../utils/patientAnonymization';
import './ReportViewPage.css';

export default function ReportViewPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [report, setReport] = useState<Reports | null>(null);
  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadReport();
  }, [id]);

  const loadReport = async () => {
    if (!id) {
      setError('ID do relatório não fornecido');
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const response = await reportsService.getById(parseInt(id));
      const reportData = response.data;
      setReport(reportData);

      // Parse dos dados do relatório
      if (reportData.reportData) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(reportData.reportData);
          setReportData(parsed);
        } catch (e) {
          console.error('Erro ao parsear dados do relatório:', e);
          setReportData({});
        }
      } else {
        setReportData({});
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || 'Erro ao carregar relatório');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!reportData) return;

    const dataStr = JSON.stringify(reportData, null, 2);
    const dataBlob = new Blob([dataStr], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(dataBlob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${report?.reportType?.replace(/\s+/g, '_') || 'relatorio'}_${Date.now()}.json`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!report) return;

    if (!window.confirm(`Tem certeza que deseja excluir o relatório "${report.reportType}"?\n\nEsta ação não pode ser desfeita.`)) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await reportsService.delete(report.reportID);
      // Redireciona para a lista de relatórios após exclusão
      navigate('/reports');
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(`Erro ao excluir relatório: ${err.message}`);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (date: Date | string | undefined) => {
    if (!date) return 'Não disponível';
    return new Date(date).toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
      day: '2-digit',
      month: '2-digit',
      year: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  const renderReportContent = () => {
    if (!reportData) return null;

    return (
      <div className="report-content">
        {/* Estatísticas Gerais */}
        {(reportData.total !== undefined || reportData.statistics) && (
          <div className="report-stats-grid">
            {reportData.total !== undefined && (
              <Card className="stat-card">
                <div className="stat-label">Total</div>
                <div className="stat-value">{reportData.total}</div>
              </Card>
            )}
            {reportData.statistics && (
              <>
                {reportData.statistics.average !== undefined && (
                  <Card className="stat-card">
                    <div className="stat-label">Média</div>
                    <div className="stat-value">{reportData.statistics.average.toFixed(2)}</div>
                  </Card>
                )}
                {reportData.statistics.min !== undefined && (
                  <Card className="stat-card">
                    <div className="stat-label">Mínimo</div>
                    <div className="stat-value">{reportData.statistics.min}</div>
                  </Card>
                )}
                {reportData.statistics.max !== undefined && (
                  <Card className="stat-card">
                    <div className="stat-label">Máximo</div>
                    <div className="stat-value">{reportData.statistics.max}</div>
                  </Card>
                )}
                {reportData.statistics.alerts !== undefined && (
                  <Card className="stat-card alert">
                    <div className="stat-label">Alertas</div>
                    <div className="stat-value">{reportData.statistics.alerts}</div>
                  </Card>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Distribuições */}
        {(reportData.byUnit || reportData.byType || reportData.byStatus || reportData.byAction || reportData.bySeverity) && (
          <div className="report-distributions">
            {reportData.byUnit && (
              <Card className="distribution-card">
                <h3 className="distribution-title">Por Unidade Clínica</h3>
                <div className="distribution-list">
                  {Object.entries(reportData.byUnit).map(([unit, count]) => (
                    <div key={unit} className="distribution-item">
                      <span className="distribution-label">{unit}</span>
                      <span className="distribution-value">{count as number}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.byType && (
              <Card className="distribution-card">
                <h3 className="distribution-title">Por Tipo</h3>
                <div className="distribution-list">
                  {Object.entries(reportData.byType).map(([type, count]) => (
                    <div key={type} className="distribution-item">
                      <span className="distribution-label">{type}</span>
                      <span className="distribution-value">{count as number}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.byStatus && (
              <Card className="distribution-card">
                <h3 className="distribution-title">Por Status</h3>
                <div className="distribution-list">
                  {Object.entries(reportData.byStatus).map(([status, count]) => (
                    <div key={status} className="distribution-item">
                      <span className="distribution-label">{status}</span>
                      <span className="distribution-value">{count as number}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.byAction && (
              <Card className="distribution-card">
                <h3 className="distribution-title">Por Ação</h3>
                <div className="distribution-list">
                  {Object.entries(reportData.byAction).map(([action, count]) => (
                    <div key={action} className="distribution-item">
                      <span className="distribution-label">{action}</span>
                      <span className="distribution-value">{count as number}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.bySeverity && (
              <Card className="distribution-card">
                <h3 className="distribution-title">Por Severidade</h3>
                <div className="distribution-list">
                  {Object.entries(reportData.bySeverity).map(([severity, count]) => (
                    <div key={severity} className="distribution-item">
                      <span className="distribution-label">{severity}</span>
                      <span className="distribution-value">{count as number}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Listas Detalhadas */}
        {(reportData.patients || reportData.samples || reportData.equipment || reportData.results || reportData.sensors || reportData.recentReadings || reportData.recentLogs) && (
          <div className="report-details">
            {reportData.patients && reportData.patients.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="details-card">
                <h3 className="details-title">Pacientes ({reportData.patients.length})</h3>
                <div className="details-table">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>ID</th>
                        <th>Nome</th>
                        <th>Unidade Clínica</th>
                        <th>Prontuário</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {reportData.patients.slice(0, 50).map((p: any) => (
                        <tr key={p.patientID}>
                          <td>{p.patientID}</td>
                          <td>{getPatientDisplayName(p, user)}</td>
                          <td>N/A</td>
                          <td>N/A</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                  {reportData.patients.length > 50 && (
                    <p className="details-more">... e mais {reportData.patients.length - 50} pacientes</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.samples && reportData.samples.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="details-card">
                <h3 className="details-title">Amostras ({reportData.samples.length})</h3>
                <div className="details-table">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>ID</th>
                        <th>Tipo</th>
                        <th>Status</th>
                        <th>Data de Registro</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {reportData.samples.slice(0, 50).map((s: any) => (
                        <tr key={s.sampleID}>
                          <td>{s.sampleID}</td>
                          <td>{s.sampleType}</td>
                          <td>{s.currentStatus}</td>
                          <td>{formatDate(s.registrationDate)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                  {reportData.samples.length > 50 && (
                    <p className="details-more">... e mais {reportData.samples.length - 50} amostras</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.equipment && reportData.equipment.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="details-card">
                <h3 className="details-title">Equipamentos ({reportData.equipment.length})</h3>
                <div className="details-table">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>ID</th>
                        <th>Descrição</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {reportData.equipment.map((e: any) => (
                        <tr key={e.equipmentID}>
                          <td>{e.equipmentID}</td>
                          <td>{e.equipmentDescription}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.results && reportData.results.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="details-card">
                <h3 className="details-title">Resultados ({reportData.results.length})</h3>
                <div className="details-table">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>ID</th>
                        <th>Tipo de Arquivo</th>
                        <th>Descrição</th>
                        <th>Método</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {reportData.results.slice(0, 50).map((r: any) => (
                        <tr key={r.resultID}>
                          <td>{r.resultID}</td>
                          <td>{r.fileType}</td>
                          <td>{r.description}</td>
                          <td>{r.method || 'N/A'}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                  {reportData.results.length > 50 && (
                    <p className="details-more">... e mais {reportData.results.length - 50} resultados</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.sensors && reportData.sensors.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="details-card">
                <h3 className="details-title">Sensores ({reportData.sensors.length})</h3>
                <div className="details-table">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>ID</th>
                        <th>Tipo</th>
                        <th>Status</th>
                        <th>Última Calibração</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {reportData.sensors.map((s: any) => (
                        <tr key={s.sensorID}>
                          <td>{s.sensorID}</td>
                          <td>{s.sensorType}</td>
                          <td>{s.maintenanceStatus}</td>
                          <td>{formatDate(s.lastCalibration)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.recentReadings && reportData.recentReadings.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="details-card">
                <h3 className="details-title">Leituras Recentes de Temperatura ({reportData.recentReadings.length})</h3>
                <div className="details-table">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>Data/Hora</th>
                        <th>Temperatura</th>
                        <th>Status</th>
                        <th>Sensor</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {reportData.recentReadings.map((r: any) => (
                        <tr key={r.logID}>
                          <td>{formatDate(r.timestamp)}</td>
                          <td>{r.temperatureValue} {r.temperatureUnit}</td>
                          <td>{r.readingStatus}</td>
                          <td>{r.sensorID}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}

            {reportData.recentLogs && reportData.recentLogs.length > 0 && (
              <Card className="details-card">
                <h3 className="details-title">Logs Recentes ({reportData.recentLogs.length})</h3>
                <div className="details-table">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th>Data/Hora</th>
                        <th>Usuário</th>
                        <th>Ação</th>
                        <th>Entidade</th>
                        <th>Resultado</th>
                        <th>Severidade</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {reportData.recentLogs.map((l: any) => (
                        <tr key={l.logID}>
                          <td>{formatDate(l.timestamp)}</td>
                          <td>{l.userName}</td>
                          <td>{l.action}</td>
                          <td>{l.entity}</td>
                          <td>{l.result}</td>
                          <td>{l.severity}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </Card>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div className="page-header">
          <h1 className="page-title">Carregando relatório...</h1>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div className="page-header">
          <h1 className="page-title">Erro</h1>
        </div>
        <Card>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{error}</p>
          <Button onClick={() => navigate('/reports')} style={{ marginTop: '1rem' }}>
            <ArrowLeft size={18} />
            Voltar para Relatórios
          </Button>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!report) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div className="page-header">
          <h1 className="page-title">Relatório não encontrado</h1>
        </div>
        <Card>
          <p>O relatório solicitado não foi encontrado.</p>
          <Button onClick={() => navigate('/reports')} style={{ marginTop: '1rem' }}>
            <ArrowLeft size={18} />
            Voltar para Relatórios
          </Button>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="page report-view-page">
      <div className="page-header report-view-header">
        <div className="page-header-content">
          <Button onClick={() => navigate('/reports')} variant="secondary" className="back-button">
            <ArrowLeft size={18} />
            Voltar
          </Button>
          <div className="page-title-section">
            <FileText size={32} className="report-icon-header" />
            <div>
              <h1 className="page-title">{report.reportType}</h1>
              <p className="page-subtitle">
                <Calendar size={16} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem', verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
                Gerado em: {formatDate(report.generatedAt || report.createdAt)}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="page-actions report-view-actions">
          <Button onClick={handlePrint} variant="secondary">
            <Printer size={18} />
            Imprimir
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleDownload}>
            <Download size={18} />
            Download JSON
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleDelete} variant="danger">
            <Trash2 size={18} />
            Excluir
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {renderReportContent()}
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: C:\Projeto\BioAvanceD\frontend\src\pages\ResetPasswordPage.tsx
================================================================================
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import { authService } from '../services/api';
import { CheckCircle, AlertCircle, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { validatePasswordAndGetError } from '../utils/passwordValidator';
import { getPasswordIssues } from '../utils/passwordRules';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import './ResetPasswordPage.css';

export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const token = searchParams.get('token');
  
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  
  const passwordIssues = getPasswordIssues(newPassword);
  const confirmMismatch = newPassword && confirmPassword && newPassword !== confirmPassword;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!token) {
      setError('Token de recuperação não fornecido');
    }
  }, [token]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError('');

    if (!newPassword || !confirmPassword) {
      setError(t('password.error.requiredFields') || 'Preencha todos os campos');
      return;
    }

    // Valida complexidade da senha
    const passwordError = validatePasswordAndGetError(newPassword);
    if (passwordError) {
      setError(passwordError);
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      setError(t('password.mismatch') || 'As senhas não coincidem');
      return;
    }

    if (!token) {
      setError(t('auth.invalidToken') || 'Token inválido');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await authService.resetPassword(token, newPassword);
      setSuccess(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        navigate('/login');
      }, 3000);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.message || t('auth.passwordResetError') || 'Erro ao redefinir senha');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (!token) {
    return (
      <div className="reset-password-page">
        <div className="reset-password-container">
          <Card className="reset-password-card">
            <div className="reset-password-header">
              <AlertCircle size={48} style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', marginBottom: '1rem' }} />
              <h1>Token Inválido</h1>
              <p>O link de recuperação de senha é inválido ou expirou.</p>
              <Button onClick={() => navigate('/login')}>
                Voltar para Login
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (success) {
    return (
      <div className="reset-password-page">
        <div className="reset-password-container">
          <Card className="reset-password-card">
            <div className="reset-password-success">
              <CheckCircle size={64} style={{ color: '#28a745', marginBottom: '1.5rem' }} />
              <h1>Senha Redefinida com Sucesso!</h1>
              <p>Você será redirecionado para a página de login em instantes...</p>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="reset-password-page">
      <div className="reset-password-container">
        <Card className="reset-password-card">
          <div className="reset-password-header">
            <Lock size={48} style={{ color: 'var(--primary)', marginBottom: '1rem' }} />
            <h1>Redefinir Senha</h1>
            <p>Digite sua nova senha abaixo</p>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="error-message" style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
              <AlertCircle size={16} />
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="reset-password-form">
            <Input
              label="Nova Senha"
              type="password"
              value={newPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t('password.requirements.placeholder') || 'Mínimo 8 caracteres com maiúscula, minúscula, número e símbolo'}
              required
              autoFocus
              minLength={8}
            />

            <Input
              label="Confirmar Nova Senha"
              type="password"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Digite a senha novamente"
              required
              minLength={8}
            />

            <div className="password-requirements">
              <p><strong>{t('password.requirements.title')}</strong></p>
              <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', padding: 0, margin: 0, display: 'grid', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
                {[{
                  key: 'minLength',
                  label: t('password.requirements.minLength')
                }, {
                  key: 'upper',
                  label: t('password.requirements.upper')
                }, {
                  key: 'lower',
                  label: t('password.requirements.lower')
                }, {
                  key: 'number',
                  label: t('password.requirements.number')
                }, {
                  key: 'symbol',
                  label: t('password.requirements.symbol')
                }].map((item) => {
                  const ok = !passwordIssues.includes(item.key as any);
                  return (
                    <li key={item.key} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem', color: ok ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--text)' }}>
                      {ok ? '✓' : '•'}
                      <span style={{ color: ok ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--text-light)' }}>{item.label}</span>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
              {confirmMismatch && (
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem', marginTop: '0.5rem', color: 'var(--danger)' }}>
                  <AlertCircle size={16} />
                  <span>{t('password.mismatch')}</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <Button
              type="submit"
              className="reset-password-button"
              disabled={loading}
            >
              {loading ? 'Redefinindo...' : 'Redefinir Senha'}
            </Button>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="secondary"
              onClick={() => navigate('/login')}
              style={{ marginTop: '1rem' }}
            >
              Voltar para Login
            </Button>
          </form>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import { Download, X, Upload, CheckCircle, XCircle, Clock, AlertCircle, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import { ImportDataType, ImportJob, ImportJobStatus } from '../types/models';
import { useResults } from '../hooks/useResults';
import { useEquipment } from '../hooks/useEquipment';
import { resultService, importService } from '../services/api';
import AnalysisUploadModal from '../components/AnalysisUploadModal';
import AnalysisUpload from '../components/AnalysisUpload.jsx';
import './ResultsPage.css';

export default function ResultsPage() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const importJobID = searchParams.get('importJobID') || undefined;
  const sampleIdParam = searchParams.get('sampleId') || searchParams.get('sampleID') || '';
  const { results, loading, error, loadResults } = useResults(importJobID);
  const { equipment } = useEquipment();
  // Estados para importação
  const [importJobs, setImportJobs] = useState<ImportJob[]>([]);
  const [selectedJob, setSelectedJob] = useState<ImportJob | null>(null);
  const [showReportModal, setShowReportModal] = useState(false);
  const [importError, setImportError] = useState('');

  const clearFilter = () => {
    const newParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
    newParams.delete('importJobID');
    setSearchParams(newParams);
  };

  // Funções de importação
  useEffect(() => {
    loadImportJobs();
    // Atualiza jobs a cada 10 segundos - reduzido de 3s para respeitar rate limiting
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      loadImportJobs();
    }, 10000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const loadImportJobs = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await importService.listJobs({ limit: 20 });
      // Backend retorna { success: true, data: [] }
      // Axios já extrai o body, então response.data é { success: true, data: [] }
      let jobs: ImportJob[] = [];
      if (response.data) {
        if (Array.isArray(response.data)) {
          // Se response.data já é um array (caso direto)
          jobs = response.data;
        } else if (response.data.data && Array.isArray(response.data.data)) {
          // Se response.data é { success: true, data: [] }
          jobs = response.data.data;
        } else if (response.data.jobs && Array.isArray(response.data.jobs)) {
          // Se response.data é { jobs: [] }
          jobs = response.data.jobs;
        } else {
          // Se não for array, assume que é um objeto vazio ou estrutura diferente
          jobs = [];
        }
      }
      // Filtra apenas importações de arquivos de analise
      const resultsJobs = jobs.filter(job => job.dataType === ImportDataType.RESULTS);
      setImportJobs(resultsJobs);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Erro ao carregar jobs:', err);
      setImportJobs([]); // Define array vazio em caso de erro
    }
  };


  const handleViewReport = async (job: ImportJob) => {
    try {
      const response = await importService.getImportReport(job.jobID);
      setSelectedJob(response.data);
      setShowReportModal(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setImportError('Erro ao carregar relatório');
    }
  };


  const getStatusIcon = (status: ImportJobStatus) => {
    switch (status) {
      case 'completed':
        return <CheckCircle className="status-icon completed" />;
      case 'failed':
        return <XCircle className="status-icon failed" />;
      case 'processing':
        return <Clock className="status-icon processing" />;
      case 'pending':
        return <Clock className="status-icon pending" />;
      default:
        return <AlertCircle className="status-icon" />;
    }
  };
  const getStatusLabel = (status: ImportJobStatus) => {
    const labels = {
      pending: 'Pendente',
      processing: 'Processando',
      completed: 'Concluído',
      failed: 'Falhou',
      cancelled: 'Cancelado'
    };
    return labels[status] || status;
  };

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">

        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Arquivos de Análise</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">
            {importJobID 
              ? `Arquivos de análise da importação ${importJobID}` 
              : 'Arquivos de análises laboratoriais'}
          </p>
          {importJobID && (
            <div className="results-filter">
              <Button
                variant="secondary"
                onClick={clearFilter}
              >
                <X size={16} /> Limpar Filtro
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="results-header-actions" />
      </div>

      {/* Seção de Importação */}
      <Card className="import-section">
        <h2 className="import-title">Importar Arquivos de Análise</h2>

        <AnalysisUpload sampleId={sampleIdParam} />

        {importError && (
          <div className="error-message import-error">
            <AlertCircle size={16} /> {importError}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="import-history">
          <h3 className="import-history-title">Histórico de Importações</h3>
          {importJobs.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="import-empty">Nenhuma importação realizada ainda</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="jobs-list">
              {importJobs.map((job) => (
                <div key={job.jobID} className="job-item">
                  <div className="job-header">
                    <div className="job-info">
                      {getStatusIcon(job.status)}
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="job-title">{job.fileName}</h4>
                        <p className="job-date">
                          {new Date(job.createdAt || '').toLocaleString('pt-BR')}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="job-status">
                      <span className={`status-badge ${job.status}`}>
                        {getStatusLabel(job.status)}
                      </span>
                      {job.status === 'completed' && (
                        <Button
                          variant="primary"
                          onClick={() => {
                            const newParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams);
                            newParams.set('importJobID', job.jobID);
                            setSearchParams(newParams);
                          }}
                        >
                          <ExternalLink size={16} /> Ver
                        </Button>
                      )}
                      {(job.status === 'completed' || job.status === 'failed') && (
                        <Button
                          variant="secondary"
                          onClick={() => handleViewReport(job)}
                        >
                          <Download size={16} /> Relatório
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {job.metrics && (
                    <div className="job-metrics">
                      <span>Total: {job.metrics.totalRecords}</span>
                      <span className="metric-success">Sucesso: {job.metrics.successfulRecords}</span>
                      {job.metrics.failedRecords > 0 && (
                        <span className="metric-failure">Falhas: {job.metrics.failedRecords}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}

      <Card className="results-table-card">
        <Table
          headers={[
            'ID',
            'Tipo de Arquivo',
            'Descrição',
            'Método',
            'Pesquisador Responsável',
            'Equipamento',
            'Amostra',
            'Ações',
          ]}
        >
          {results.map((result) => {
            return (
              <tr key={result._id || result.resultID}>
                <td>{result.resultID || result._id}</td>
                <td>
                  <span className="file-type-badge">{result.fileType}</span>
                </td>
                <td>{result.description}</td>
                <td>{result.method}</td>
                <td>{result.responsibleResearcher}</td>
                <td>
                  {result.equipmentID
                    ? equipment.find((e) => e.equipmentID === result.equipmentID)
                        ?.equipmentDescription || `Equipamento #${result.equipmentID}`
                    : result.equipmentName || 'Não vinculado'}
                </td>
                <td>
                  <span className="sample-tag">Amostra #{result.sampleID}</span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div className="table-actions">
                    <Button 
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={async () => {
                        try {
                          await resultService.download(result._id || result.resultID);
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          alert(`Erro ao fazer download: ${err.message || 'Erro desconhecido'}`);
                        }
                      }}
                    >
                      <Download size={16} />
                      Download
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </Table>
      </Card>

      {/* Modal de Relatório de Importação */}
      {showReportModal && selectedJob && (
        <Modal
          isOpen={showReportModal}
          onClose={() => setShowReportModal(false)}
          title="Relatório de Importação"
        >
          <div className="import-report">
            <div className="report-header">
              <h3 className="report-title">{selectedJob.fileName}</h3>
              <span className={`status-badge ${selectedJob.status}`}>
                {getStatusLabel(selectedJob.status)}
              </span>
            </div>

            {selectedJob.metrics && (
              <div className="report-metrics">
                <h4 className="report-subtitle">Métricas</h4>
                <div className="metrics-grid">
                  <div className="metric-item">
                    <label className="metric-label">Total de Registros</label>
                    <span className="metric-value">{selectedJob.metrics.totalRecords}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="metric-item">
                    <label className="metric-label">Sucesso</label>
                    <span className="metric-value metric-success">{selectedJob.metrics.successfulRecords}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="metric-item">
                    <label className="metric-label">Falhas</label>
                    <span className="metric-value metric-failure">{selectedJob.metrics.failedRecords}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="metric-item">
                    <label className="metric-label">Duplicados</label>
                    <span className="metric-value">{selectedJob.metrics.duplicatesFound}</span>
                  </div>
                  {selectedJob.metrics.processingTime && (
                    <div className="metric-item">
                      <label className="metric-label">Tempo de Processamento</label>
                      <span className="metric-value">{selectedJob.metrics.processingTime.toFixed(2)}s</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {selectedJob.validationErrors && selectedJob.validationErrors.length > 0 && (
              <div className="report-errors">
                <h4 className="report-subtitle">Erros de Validação</h4>
                <div className="errors-list">
                  {selectedJob.validationErrors.slice(0, 10).map((error, index) => (
                    <div key={index} className="error-item">
                      {error.row && <span>Linha {error.row}: </span>}
                      {error.field && <span>{error.field}: </span>}
                      {error.message}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {selectedJob.validationErrors.length > 10 && (
                    <p className="errors-more">... e mais {selectedJob.validationErrors.length - 10} erros</p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {selectedJob.processingErrors && selectedJob.processingErrors.length > 0 && (
              <div className="report-errors">
                <h4 className="report-subtitle">Erros de Processamento</h4>
                <div className="errors-list">
                  {selectedJob.processingErrors.map((error, index) => (
                    <div key={index} className="error-item">{error}</div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

ARQUIVO: C:\Projeto\BioAvanceD\frontend\src\pages\SampleCustodyReportsPage.tsx
================================================================================
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { useSamples } from '../hooks/useSamples';
import { sampleChainApi } from '../services/sampleChainApi';

export default function SampleCustodyReportsPage() {
  const { samples, loading } = useSamples();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [movements, setMovements] = useState<Record<string, { loading: boolean; error?: string | null; items: any[]; open: boolean }>>({});

  const headers = [
    t('samples.id', 'ID'),
    t('samples.patientId', 'ID do Paciente'),
    t('samples.type', 'Tipo'),
    t('samples.barcode', 'Código de Barras'),
    t('common.actions', 'Ações'),
  ];

  const resolveSampleId = (sample: any) => sample?.sampleID || sample?.id || sample?._id || '—';
  const resolvePatientId = (sample: any) => sample?.patientId || sample?.patientID || sample?.patient?.id || '—';

  const handleToggleMovements = async (sample: any) => {
    const id = String(resolveSampleId(sample));
    const current = movements[id];

    // Toggle off if already open and not loading
    if (current?.open && !current.loading) {
      setMovements(prev => ({ ...prev, [id]: { ...current, open: false } }));
      return;
    }

    setMovements(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [id]: { loading: true, error: null, items: prev[id]?.items || [], open: true },
    }));

    try {
      const res = await sampleChainApi.getMovements(id);
      const data = Array.isArray(res.data?.data) ? res.data.data : (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
      setMovements(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [id]: { loading: false, error: null, items: data, open: true },
      }));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setMovements(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [id]: { loading: false, error: err?.message || 'Erro ao carregar movimentos', items: [], open: true },
      }));
    }
  };

  const renderMovements = (sampleId: string | number) => {
    const entry = movements[sampleId];
    if (!entry || entry.loading) {
      return (
        <tr>
          <td colSpan={5}>{t('common.loading')}</td>
        </tr>
      );
    }
    if (entry.error) {
      return (
        <tr>
          <td colSpan={5} style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>
            {entry.error}
          </td>
        </tr>
      );
    }
    if (!entry.data?.length) {
      return (
        <tr>
          <td colSpan={5}>{t('messages.noData', 'Nenhum dado disponível')}</td>
        </tr>
      );
    }

    const typeLabel = (type?: string) => {
      if (!type) return '—';
      const map: Record<string, string> = {
        withdraw: t('samples.withdraw', 'Retirada'),
        return: t('samples.return', 'Devolução'),
        transfer: t('samples.transfer', 'Transferência'),
      };
      return map[type] || type;
    };

    const formatResp = (m: any) =>
      m?.responsibleName ||
      m?.responsible ||
      m?.operatorName ||
      m?.user ||
      '—';

    const formatDetails = (m: any) =>
      m?.details ||
      m?.description ||
      m?.observations ||
      m?.note ||
      '—';

    return entry.data.map((m: any, idx: number) => (
      <tr key={m.id || idx}>
        <td>{m.date || m.createdAt || '—'}</td>
        <td>{typeLabel(m.type)}</td>
        <td>{formatResp(m)}</td>
        <td>{formatDetails(m)}</td>
      </tr>
    ));
  };

  const rows = useMemo(() => samples || [], [samples]);

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <h1 className="page-title">
          {t('navigation.custodyReports', 'Relatórios de Custódia')}
        </h1>
        <p className="page-subtitle">
          {t('samples.custodyReportsDescription', 'Acesse as movimentações de qualquer amostra.')}
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        {loading && <p>{t('common.loading') || 'Carregando...'}</p>}
        {!loading && (
          <div className="table-responsive">
            <table className="table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {headers.map((h) => (
                    <th key={h}>{h}</th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((sample) => {
                  const rowId = resolveSampleId(sample);
                  const movementState = movements[rowId];
                  return (
                    <React.Fragment key={rowId}>
                      <tr>
                        <td>{rowId}</td>
                        <td>{resolvePatientId(sample)}</td>
                        <td>{sample.sampleType || '—'}</td>
                        <td>{sample.barcode || sample.code || '—'}</td>
                        <td>
                          <Button
                            variant="secondary"
                            onClick={() => handleToggleMovements(sample)}
                          >
                            {movementState?.open ? (t('samples.hideMovements') || 'Ocultar movimentos') : (t('samples.viewSampleMovements', 'Ver movimentos da amostra'))}
                          </Button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                      {movementState?.open && (
                        <tr>
                          <td colSpan={5}>
                            {movementState.loading && (
                              <p style={{ margin: '0.5rem 0' }}>{t('common.loading') || 'Carregando...'}</p>
                            )}
                            {movementState.error && (
                              <p style={{ margin: '0.5rem 0', color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{movementState.error}</p>
                            )}
                            {!movementState.loading && !movementState.error && (
                              <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
                                <table className="table" style={{ marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
                                  <thead>
                                    <tr>
                                      <th>{t('common.date') || 'Data'}</th>
                                      <th>{t('samples.type') || 'Tipo'}</th>
                                      <th>{t('samples.responsible') || 'Responsável'}</th>
                                      <th>{t('common.details') || 'Detalhes'}</th>
                                    </tr>
                                  </thead>
                                  <tbody>
                                    {renderMovements(rowId)}
                                  </tbody>
                                </table>
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      )}
                    </React.Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {rows.length === 0 && <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>{t('samples.noSamples') || 'Nenhuma amostra encontrada'}</p>}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ArrowLeft, Download } from 'lucide-react';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import Select from '../components/UI/Select';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import { useSamples } from '../hooks/useSamples';
import { useLocations } from '../hooks/useLocations';
import { useResults } from '../hooks/useResults';
import { useEquipment } from '../hooks/useEquipment';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import AnalysisUploadModal from '../components/AnalysisUploadModal';
import { Sample } from '../types/models';
import { resultService } from '../services/api';
import './SamplesPage.css';

export default function SampleDetailsPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const { user, hasRole } = useAuth();
  const { samples, loading, error, updateSample } = useSamples();
  const { results, loadResults } = useResults();
  const { equipment } = useEquipment();
  const { locations = [], loadLocations } = useLocations();
  const [sample, setSample] = useState<Sample | null>(null);
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showUploadModal, setShowUploadModal] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    locationID: '',
    linkedProject: '',
    availableQuantity: '',
    currentStatus: '',
    sampleOrigin: '',
    extractionProtocol: '',
    patientID: '',
  });

  const canEdit = hasRole(['Administrador', 'Coordenador']) || user?.roleName === 'Administrador' || user?.roleName === 'Coordenador';

  const computeAvailability = (s: Sample | null | undefined) => {
    const initial = s?.volumeInitial ?? s?.originalQuantity ?? s?.quantity ?? 0;
    const current = s?.volumeCurrent ?? s?.availableQuantity ?? s?.quantity ?? 0;

    if (current <= 0) {
      return {
        label: 'Indisponível',
        className: 'availability-indisponível',
        current,
        initial,
      };
    }

    if (current < initial) {
      return {
        label: 'Parcialmente Disponível',
        className: 'availability-parcialmente-disponível',
        current,
        initial,
      };
    }

    return {
      label: 'Disponível',
      className: 'availability-disponível',
      current,
      initial,
    };
  };

  // Carrega localizações ao montar
  useEffect(() => {
    if (loadLocations) {
      loadLocations().catch(err => {
        console.error('Erro ao carregar localizações:', err);
      });
    }
  }, [loadLocations]);

  // Busca a amostra quando os dados são carregados
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && id && samples !== undefined) {
      // Se não há amostras carregadas (array vazio após carregar)
      if (!samples || samples.length === 0) {
        setSample(null);
        return;
      }

      // Tenta encontrar a amostra por _id ou sampleID
      const searchId = String(id || '').trim();
      const foundSample = samples.find(s => {
        const sampleId = String(s._id || '').trim();
        const sampleIDStr = String(s.sampleID || '').trim();
        
        return sampleId === searchId || 
               sampleIDStr === searchId ||
               sampleId.toLowerCase() === searchId.toLowerCase() ||
               sampleIDStr.toLowerCase() === searchId.toLowerCase();
      });
      
      if (foundSample) {
        setSample(foundSample);
        setForm({
          locationID: foundSample.locationID ? String(foundSample.locationID) : '',
          linkedProject: foundSample.linkedProject || '',
          availableQuantity: (foundSample.volumeCurrent ?? foundSample.availableQuantity ?? foundSample.quantity ?? '').toString(),
          currentStatus: foundSample.currentStatus || 'Available',
          sampleOrigin: foundSample.sampleOrigin || '',
          extractionProtocol: foundSample.extractionProtocol || '',
          patientID: foundSample.patientID ? String(foundSample.patientID) : '',
        });
      } else {
        // Se carregou mas não encontrou, define como null
        console.warn('Amostra não encontrada:', { 
          searchId: id, 
          availableIds: samples.map(s => ({ _id: s._id, sampleID: s.sampleID }))
        });
        setSample(null);
      }
    }
  }, [samples, id, loading]);

  const getLocationInfo = (locationID?: number): { summary: string; details: string } => {
    if (locationID === undefined || locationID === null) {
      return { summary: 'N/A', details: 'Localização não definida' };
    }
    
    if (!locations || !Array.isArray(locations) || locations.length === 0) {
      return { summary: `ID: ${locationID}`, details: 'Informações de localização não disponíveis' };
    }

    const location = locations.find(loc => loc.locationID === locationID);
    if (!location) {
      return { summary: `ID: ${locationID}`, details: 'Localização não encontrada' };
    }

    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (location.block) parts.push(`Bloco: ${location.block}`);
    if (location.rack) parts.push(`Prateleira: ${location.rack}`);
    if (location.drawer) parts.push(`Gaveta: ${location.drawer}`);
    if (location.box) parts.push(`Caixa: ${location.box}`);
    if (location.wellPosition || location.eppendorfWell) {
      parts.push(`Poço: ${location.wellPosition || location.eppendorfWell}`);
    }

    const summary = parts.length > 0 
      ? parts.slice(0, 2).join(' | ') 
      : `ID: ${locationID}`;
    
    const details = parts.length > 0 
      ? parts.join(' • ') 
      : `Localização ID: ${locationID}`;

    return { summary, details };
  };

  const effectiveSample = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isEditing) return sample;
    const parsedAvailable = Number(form.availableQuantity);
    const parsedLocation = form.locationID ? Number(form.locationID) : undefined;
    return {
      ...sample,
      availableQuantity: Number.isFinite(parsedAvailable) ? parsedAvailable : sample?.availableQuantity,
      volumeCurrent: Number.isFinite(parsedAvailable) ? parsedAvailable : sample?.volumeCurrent,
      locationID: parsedLocation ?? sample?.locationID,
      linkedProject: form.linkedProject || sample?.linkedProject,
      currentStatus: (form.currentStatus as Sample['currentStatus']) || sample?.currentStatus,
    } as Sample;
  }, [isEditing, sample, form.availableQuantity, form.locationID, form.linkedProject, form.currentStatus]);

  const availabilityPreview = computeAvailability(effectiveSample);

  const locationOptions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!locations || locations.length === 0) {
      return [{ value: '', label: t('samples.noLocations', 'Sem localizações disponíveis') }];
    }
    return [
      { value: '', label: t('common.select') || 'Selecione' },
      ...locations.map(loc => ({
        value: loc.locationID,
        label: `${loc.locationID} - Bloco ${loc.block} / Prat. ${loc.rack} / Gav. ${loc.drawer} / Caixa ${loc.box}`,
      })),
    ];
  }, [locations, t]);

  const statusOptions = useMemo(() => ([
    { value: 'Available', label: t('samples.status.available', 'Disponível') },
    { value: 'PartiallyWithdrawn', label: t('samples.status.partiallyWithdrawn', 'Parcialmente Retirada') },
    { value: 'TotallyWithdrawn', label: t('samples.status.totallyWithdrawn', 'Totalmente Retirada') },
    { value: 'Withdrawn', label: t('samples.status.withdrawn', 'Retirada') },
    { value: 'Expired', label: t('samples.status.expired', 'Expirada') },
    { value: 'Destroyed', label: t('samples.status.destroyed', 'Destruída') },
    { value: 'Unusable', label: t('samples.status.unusable', 'Inutilizada') },
  ]), [t]);

  const sampleResults = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sample) return [];
    const sampleKeys = new Set([
      String(sample._id || ''),
      String(sample.sampleID || '')
    ]);
    return results.filter(result => sampleKeys.has(String(result.sampleID)));
  }, [results, sample]);

  const getResultEquipmentLabel = (equipmentID?: number, equipmentName?: string) => {
    if (equipmentID) {
      const match = equipment.find((item) => item.equipmentID === equipmentID);
      return match?.equipmentDescription || `Equipamento #${equipmentID}`;
    }
    return equipmentName || 'Não informado';
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div style={{ 
          display: 'flex', 
          justifyContent: 'center', 
          alignItems: 'center', 
          minHeight: '400px',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: '1rem'
        }}>
          <p>{t('common.loading') || 'Carregando...'}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => navigate('/samples')}>
            <ArrowLeft size={18} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
            {t('common.back') || 'Voltar'}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <Card>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>
            {t('common.error') || 'Erro'}: {error}
          </p>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Se terminou de carregar mas não encontrou a amostra
  if (!loading && samples !== undefined && !sample && id) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => navigate('/samples')}>
            <ArrowLeft size={18} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
            {t('common.back') || 'Voltar'}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <Card>
          <p>{t('samples.notFound') || 'Amostra não encontrada'}</p>
          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
            ID buscado: {id}
          </p>
          {samples && samples.length > 0 && (
            <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
              Total de amostras carregadas: {samples.length}
            </p>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Se ainda não tem sample (ainda carregando ou aguardando)
  if (!sample) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div style={{ 
          display: 'flex', 
          justifyContent: 'center', 
          alignItems: 'center', 
          minHeight: '400px',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          gap: '1rem'
        }}>
          <p>{t('common.loading') || 'Carregando...'}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handleChange = (field: keyof typeof form, value: string) => {
    setForm(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    if (sample) {
      setForm({
        locationID: sample.locationID ? String(sample.locationID) : '',
        linkedProject: sample.linkedProject || '',
        availableQuantity: (sample.volumeCurrent ?? sample.availableQuantity ?? sample.quantity ?? '').toString(),
        currentStatus: sample.currentStatus || 'Available',
        sampleOrigin: sample.sampleOrigin || '',
        extractionProtocol: sample.extractionProtocol || '',
        patientID: sample.patientID ? String(sample.patientID) : '',
      });
    }
    setSaveError(null);
    setIsEditing(false);
  };

  const handleUpdate = async () => {
    if (!sample) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError(null);

    const parsedAvailable = form.availableQuantity === '' ? null : Number(form.availableQuantity);
    if (parsedAvailable !== null && (!Number.isFinite(parsedAvailable) || parsedAvailable < 0)) {
      setSaveError('Quantidade disponível inválida');
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const payload: Partial<Sample> = {
      linkedProject: form.linkedProject?.trim() || undefined,
      locationID: form.locationID ? Number(form.locationID) : undefined,
      currentStatus: (form.currentStatus as Sample['currentStatus']) || undefined,
      sampleOrigin: form.sampleOrigin?.trim() || undefined,
      extractionProtocol: form.extractionProtocol?.trim() || undefined,
      patientID: form.patientID?.trim() || undefined,
    };

    if (parsedAvailable !== null) {
      payload.availableQuantity = parsedAvailable;
      payload.volumeCurrent = parsedAvailable;
    }

    try {
      const targetId = sample._id || sample.sampleID || id || '';
      const updated = await updateSample(targetId, payload);
      // Atualiza estado local para refletir a edição imediatamente
      setSample(prev => ({
        ...prev!,
        ...payload,
        availableQuantity: payload.availableQuantity ?? prev?.availableQuantity,
        volumeCurrent: payload.volumeCurrent ?? prev?.volumeCurrent,
      }));
      // Se backend retornou amostra, sincroniza
      if (updated) {
        setSample(updated as Sample);
      }
      setIsEditing(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSaveError(err?.message || 'Erro ao salvar alterações');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUploadSuccess = () => {
    loadResults();
    setShowUploadModal(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">
            Detalhes da Amostra - {sample.barcode || sample.sampleID || 'N/A'}
          </h1>

          <div style={{ marginBottom: '0.5rem', display: 'flex', gap: '0.5rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {!isEditing ? (
              <>
                {canEdit && (
                  <Button
                    variant="primary"
                    onClick={() => setIsEditing(true)}
                    style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                  >
                    {t('common.edit') || 'Editar'}
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => navigate(`/samples/${id}/chain`)} style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                  {t('samples.chain') || 'Cadeia de Custódia'}
                </Button>
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => navigate('/samples')} style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                  <ArrowLeft size={18} style={{ marginRight: '0.5rem' }} />
                  {t('common.back') || 'Voltar'}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Button
                  variant="primary"
                  onClick={handleUpdate}
                  disabled={saving}
                  style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                >
                  {saving ? (t('common.loading') || 'Salvando...') : (t('common.save') || 'Salvar')}
                </Button>
              <Button
                  variant="secondary"
                  onClick={handleCancel}
                  disabled={saving}
                  style={{ padding: '0.25rem 0.5rem', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}
                >
                  {t('common.cancel') || 'Cancelar'}
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
            {saveError && (
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', alignSelf: 'center', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                {saveError}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
        {/* Informações Básicas */}
        <Card>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
            Informações Básicas
          </h3>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>ID da Amostra:</span>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{sample.sampleID || sample._id || 'N/A'}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Código de Barras:</span>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: 'var(--primary)', fontWeight: 600 }}>{sample.barcode || 'N/A'}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Tipo:</span>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{sample.sampleType || 'N/A'}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Origem:</span>
              {isEditing ? (
                <div style={{ width: '280px' }}>
                  <Input
                    value={form.sampleOrigin}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('sampleOrigin', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={t('samples.origin', 'Origem') || 'Origem'}
                  />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{sample.sampleOrigin || 'N/A'}</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Protocolo de Extração:</span>
              {isEditing ? (
                <div style={{ width: '280px' }}>
                  <Input
                    value={form.extractionProtocol}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('extractionProtocol', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={t('samples.protocol', 'Protocolo') || 'Protocolo'}
                  />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>{sample.extractionProtocol || 'N/A'}</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Data de Registro:</span>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                {sample.registrationDate ? new Date(sample.registrationDate).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR') : 'N/A'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* Quantidade e Qualidade */}
        <Card>
          <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text)' }}>
            Quantidade e Qualidade
          </h3>
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Quantidade Total:</span>
              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>
                {availabilityPreview.initial.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { minimumFractionDigits: 1, maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} µL
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '0.5rem', backgroundColor: 'var(--surface)', borderRadius: '4px' }}>
              <span style={{ fontWeight: 500, color: 'var(--text-light)' }}>Quantidade Disponível:</span>
              {isEditing ? (
                <div style={{ width: '180px' }}>
                  <Input
                    type="number"

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import BarcodeLabel from '../components/BarcodeLabel';
import { useSamples } from '../hooks/useSamples';

export default function SampleLabelPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const { samples, loading } = useSamples();
  const [hasPrinted, setHasPrinted] = useState(false);

  const sample = useMemo(() => {
    if (!samples || !id) return null;
    const search = String(id).trim().toLowerCase();
    return samples.find((s) => {
      const keys = [
        s._id,
        s.id,
        s.sampleID,
        s.sampleId,
        s.barcode,
        s.code,
      ].map((v) => String(v ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
      return keys.includes(search);
    }) || null;
  }, [samples, id]);

  const formattedBarcode = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sample) return '';
    const base =
      sample.barcode ||
      sample.code ||
      sample.sampleID ||
      sample.sampleId ||
      sample._id ||
      sample.id ||
      '';
    const value = String(base).trim();
    if (!value) return '';
    return value.startsWith('BR-') ? value : `BR-${value}`;
  }, [sample]);

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (hasPrinted) return;
    window.print();
    setHasPrinted(true);
  };

  if (loading && !sample) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <p>Carregando...</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!sample) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <p>Amostra não encontrada.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header" style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
        <h1 className="page-title">Etiqueta</h1>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={handlePrint} disabled={hasPrinted}>
          {hasPrinted ? 'Impressão realizada' : 'Imprimir Etiqueta'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '2rem' }}>
          <BarcodeLabel
            title={sample.sampleType || 'Amostra'}
            barcode={formattedBarcode}
            code={formattedBarcode}
          />
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { sampleChainApi } from '../services/sampleChainApi';

export default function SampleMovementsPage() {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const [movements, setMovements] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    setLoading(true);
    sampleChainApi.getMovements(id)
      .then(res => setMovements(res.data || []))
      .catch(err => {
        console.error(err);
        setError(err?.message || 'Erro ao carregar movimentos');
      })
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [id]);

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <h1>{t('samples.movements') || 'Movimentações'}</h1>

      {loading && <p>{t('common.loading') || 'Carregando...'}</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{error}</p>}

      {!loading && !error && (
        <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
          <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse' }}>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '0.5rem' }}>{t('common.date') || 'Data'}</th>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '0.5rem' }}>{t('samples.type') || 'Tipo'}</th>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '0.5rem' }}>{t('samples.responsible') || 'Responsável'}</th>
                <th style={{ textAlign: 'left', padding: '0.5rem' }}>{t('common.details') || 'Detalhes'}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {movements.map((m, i) => (
                <tr key={i} style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--surface)' }}>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{m.timestamp || m.createdAt || '-'}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{m.type || '-'}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{m.userAnonId || '-'}</td>
                  <td style={{ padding: '0.5rem' }}>{m.metadata ? JSON.stringify(m.metadata) : '-'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
          {movements.length === 0 && <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>{t('samples.noMovements') || 'Nenhuma movimentação encontrada'}</p>}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================================================================================
