import { useState } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import { Plus, Edit, Trash2, Radio } from 'lucide-react';
import { Sensor } from '../types/models';
import { useSensors } from '../hooks/useSensors';
import { useLocations } from '../hooks/useLocations';
import { usePolicies } from '../hooks/usePolicies';
import './SensorsPage.css';

export default function SensorsPage() {
  const { sensors, loading, error, collectReading, createSensor, updateSensor, deleteSensor } = useSensors();
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingSensor, setEditingSensor] = useState<Sensor | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Sensores</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Gerenciamento de sensores de temperatura</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}>
          <Plus size={18} />
          Novo Sensor
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}

      <Card>
        <Table
          headers={[
            'ID',
            'Tipo',
            'Modelo',
            'Status',
            'Última Calibração',
            'Próxima Calibração',
            'Ações',
          ]}
        >
          {sensors.map((sensor) => (
            <tr key={sensor.sensorID}>
              <td>{sensor.sensorID}</td>
              <td>{sensor.sensorType}</td>
              <td>{sensor.sensorModel}</td>
              <td>
                <span className={`status-badge status-${sensor.maintenanceStatus.toLowerCase()}`}>
                  {sensor.maintenanceStatus}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td>
                {sensor.lastCalibration
                  ? new Date(sensor.lastCalibration).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')
                  : 'N/A'}
              </td>
              <td>
                {sensor.nextCalibration
                  ? new Date(sensor.nextCalibration).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')
                  : 'N/A'}
              </td>
              <td>
                <div className="table-actions">
                  <button
                    className="action-button"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      try {
                        // Implementa Sensor.collectReading(): TemperatureLog
                        const reading = await collectReading(sensor.sensorID);
                        alert(
                          `Leitura coletada: ${reading.temperatureValue}${reading.temperatureUnit}\nStatus: ${reading.readingStatus}\nQualidade: ${(reading.dataQualityScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%`
                        );
                      } catch (err: any) {
                        alert(err.message);
                      }
                    }}
                    title="Coletar Leitura (Desativado - não há sensores cadastrados)"
                    disabled={true}
                    style={{ opacity: 0.5, cursor: 'not-allowed' }}
                  >
                    <Radio size={16} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="action-button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setEditingSensor(sensor);
                      setIsModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                    title="Editar"
                  >
                    <Edit size={16} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="action-button danger"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir este sensor?')) {
                        try {
                          await deleteSensor(sensor.sensorID);
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          alert(err.message);
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    title="Excluir"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsModalOpen(false);
          setEditingSensor(null);
        }}
        title={editingSensor ? 'Editar Sensor' : 'Novo Sensor'}
      >
        <SensorForm
          sensor={editingSensor}
          onSave={async (data) => {
            try {
              if (editingSensor) {
                await updateSensor(editingSensor.sensorID, data);
              } else {
                await createSensor(data);
              }
              setIsModalOpen(false);
              setEditingSensor(null);
            } catch (err: any) {
              alert(err.message);
            }
          }}
          onCancel={() => {
            setIsModalOpen(false);
            setEditingSensor(null);
          }}
        />
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}

function SensorForm({
  sensor,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: {
  sensor: Sensor | null;
  onSave: (data: Partial<Sensor>) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const { locations } = useLocations();
  const { policies } = usePolicies();
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Sensor>>(
    sensor || {
      sensorType: '',
      sensorModel: '',
      maintenanceStatus: 'Operacional',
      lastCalibration: null,
      nextCalibration: null,
      calibrationCertificate: '',
      locationID: undefined,
      policyID: undefined,
    }
  );

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onSave(formData);
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="form">
      <div className="form-grid">
        <Input
          label="Tipo de Sensor"
          value={formData.sensorType || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, sensorType: e.target.value })
          }
          required
        />
        <Input
          label="Modelo"
          value={formData.sensorModel || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({ ...formData, sensorModel: e.target.value })
          }
        />
        <div className="form-grid-full">
          <label className="input-label">Status de Manutenção</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            value={formData.maintenanceStatus || 'Operacional'}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setFormData({ ...formData, maintenanceStatus: e.target.value })
            }
          >
            <option value="Operacional">Operacional</option>
            <option value="Em Manutenção">Em Manutenção</option>
            <option value="Fora de Serviço">Fora de Serviço</option>
            <option value="Calibração Pendente">Calibração Pendente</option>
            <option value="Aguardando Reparo">Aguardando Reparo</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <Input
          label="Última Calibração"
          type="date"
          value={
            formData.lastCalibration
              ? new Date(formData.lastCalibration).toISOString().split('T')[0]
              : ''
          }
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({
              ...formData,
              lastCalibration: e.target.value ? new Date(e.target.value) : null,
            })
          }
        />
        <Input
          label="Próxima Calibração"
          type="date"
          value={
            formData.nextCalibration
              ? new Date(formData.nextCalibration).toISOString().split('T')[0]
              : ''
          }
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({
              ...formData,
              nextCalibration: e.target.value ? new Date(e.target.value) : null,
            })
          }
        />
        <Input
          label="Certificado de Calibração"
          value={formData.calibrationCertificate || ''}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setFormData({
              ...formData,
              calibrationCertificate: e.target.value,
            })
          }
        />
        <div className="form-grid-full">
          <label className="input-label">Localização</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            value={formData.locationID || ''}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setFormData({
                ...formData,
                locationID: e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : undefined,
              })
            }
          >
            <option value="">Selecione uma localização</option>
            {locations.map((location) => {
              const locationId = location.locationID || (location as any)._id;
              return (
                <option key={locationId} value={location.locationID || ''}>
                  Bloco {location.block}, Prateleira {location.rack}, Gaveta {location.drawer}, Caixa {location.box}, Poço {location.eppendorfWell}
                </option>
              );
            })}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="form-grid-full">
          <label className="input-label">Política de Temperatura</label>
          <select
            className="input"
            value={formData.policyID || ''}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setFormData({
                ...formData,
                policyID: e.target.value ? parseInt(e.target.value) : undefined,
              })
            }
          >
            <option value="">Selecione uma política</option>
            {policies.map((policy) => (
              <option key={policy.policyID} value={policy.policyID}>
                Política #{policy.policyID} - {policy.targetTemperature}{policy.temperatureUnit} (Limites: {policy.minThreshold} - {policy.maxThreshold})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="form-actions">
        <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel}>
          Cancelar
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit">Salvar</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import { AnalysisType } from '../types/models';
import { analysisTypeService } from '../services/api';
import { useAnalysisTypes } from '../hooks/useAnalysisTypes';

const slugify = (value: string) => {
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_')
    .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '')
    .replace(/_{2,}/g, '_');
};

export default function SettingsParametersPage() {
  const { types, loading, error } = useAnalysisTypes();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<AnalysisType[]>([]);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setItems(types);
  }, [types]);

  const generatedCode = useMemo(() => (name ? slugify(name) : ''), [name]);

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setSaveError('Informe o nome do tipo');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    setSaveError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const payload = {
        name: name.trim(),
        code: code.trim() || generatedCode
      };

      const response = await analysisTypeService.create(payload);
      const created = response.data?.data || response.data;

      if (created) {
        setItems((prev) => [created, ...prev]);
      }

      setName('');
      setCode('');
      setSuccessMessage('Tipo criado com sucesso');
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSaveError(err?.message || 'Erro ao criar tipo');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Parâmetros</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Gerencie tipos de análise</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '1.5rem' }}>
        <Card>
          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>Adicionar Tipo de Análise</h3>
          {saveError && (
            <div style={{ color: 'var(--danger)', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
              {saveError}
            </div>
          )}
          {successMessage && (
            <div style={{ color: 'var(--success)', marginBottom: '0.75rem' }}>
              {successMessage}
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: '0.75rem', maxWidth: '520px' }}>
            <Input
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nome do tipo (ex: PCR Real Time)"
            />
            <Input
              value={code}
              onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={generatedCode ? `Código sugerido: ${generatedCode}` : 'Código (opcional)'}
            />
            <div>
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleCreate} disabled={saving}>
                {saving ? 'Salvando...' : 'Adicionar'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <h3 style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>Tipos de Análise</h3>
          {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
          {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}
          {!loading && items.length === 0 && <p>Nenhum tipo encontrado.</p>}
          {!loading && items.length > 0 && (
            <Table headers={['Nome', 'Código', 'Ativo']}>
              {items.map((item) => (
                <tr key={item._id || item.code}>
                  <td>{item.name}</td>
                  <td>{item.code}</td>
                  <td>{item.active === false ? 'Não' : 'Sim'}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </Table>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import Input from '../components/UI/Input';
import { Plus, Edit, Trash2, UserCog, Key, Shield, Shield as ShieldIcon, RotateCcw, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Access } from '../types/models';
import { useUsers } from '../hooks/useUsers';
import { useAccess } from '../hooks/useAccess';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { userService } from '../services/api';
import SecurityPage from './SecurityPage';
import './SystemManagementPage.css';

type TabType = 'users' | 'access' | 'security';

export default function SystemManagementPage() {
  const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const tabParam = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;
  const validTabs: TabType[] = ['users', 'access', 'security'];
  const initialTab = (tabParam && validTabs.includes(tabParam)) ? tabParam : 'users';
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabType>(initialTab);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tabParam && validTabs.includes(tabParam)) {
      setActiveTab(tabParam);
    }
  }, [tabParam]);

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'users' as TabType, label: 'Usuários', icon: UserCog },
    { id: 'access' as TabType, label: 'Acessos', icon: Key },
    { id: 'security' as TabType, label: 'Segurança', icon: ShieldIcon },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Gerenciamento do Sistema</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Gerenciamento integrado de usuários, acessos e configurações de segurança</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="system-tabs">
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              className={`system-tab ${activeTab === tab.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveTab(tab.id);
                setSearchParams({ tab: tab.id });
              }}
            >
              <Icon size={18} />
              <span>{tab.label}</span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="system-tab-content">
        {activeTab === 'users' && <UsersSection />}
        {activeTab === 'access' && <AccessSection />}
        {activeTab === 'security' && <SecuritySection />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Seção de Usuários
function UsersSection() {
  const { users, loading, error, validateUserStatus, deleteUser, loadUsers } = useUsers();
  const { user: currentUser } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  
  const isAdmin = currentUser?.roleName === 'Administrador' || currentUser?.accessType === 4;

  const getRoleIcon = (roleName?: string) => {
    switch (roleName) {
      case 'Administrador':
        return <Shield size={14} />;
      case 'Coordenador':
        return <UserCog size={14} />;
      case 'Técnico':
        return null;
      case 'Usuário Externo':
        return null;
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  const getAccessTypeLabel = (accessType?: number) => {
    switch (accessType) {
      case 4:
        return 'Administrador';
      case 3:
        return 'Coordenador';
      case 2:
        return 'Técnico';
      case 1:
        return 'Usuário Externo';
      default:
        return 'Técnico';
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className="section-header">
        <Button onClick={() => navigate('/users/new')}>
          <Plus size={18} />
          {t('users.new')}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading && <p>{t('common.loading')}</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>{t('common.error')}: {error}</p>}

      <Card>
        <Table
          headers={[
            t('users.name'),
            t('users.email'),
            t('users.institution'),
            t('users.username'),
            t('users.role'),
            t('users.status'),
            t('users.mfa'),
            t('common.actions'),
          ]}
        >
          {Array.isArray(users) && users.map((user) => {
            const userIsAdmin = user.roleName === 'Administrador' || user.accessType === 4;
            const userId = (user as any)._id || user.id;
            const showResetButton = !userIsAdmin;
            
            return (
              <tr key={userId || user.id}>
                <td>{user.name}</td>
                <td>{user.email}</td>
                <td>{user.institution || '-'}</td>
                <td>{user.username}</td>
                <td>
                  <div className="role-badge-container">
                    {user.roleName ? (
                      <span className={`role-badge role-${user.roleName.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')}`}>
                        {getRoleIcon(user.roleName)}
                        {user.roleName}
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="role-badge role-tecnico">
                        {getAccessTypeLabel(user.accessType)}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <span className={`status-badge status-${user.status?.toLowerCase() || 'ativo'}`}>
                    {user.status || t('users.statusActive')}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div className="mfa-cell">
                    <span className={`status-badge ${userIsAdmin ? 'status-inativo' : (user.mfaEnabled ? 'status-ativo' : 'status-inativo')}`}>
                      {userIsAdmin ? t('users.mfaNotApplicable') : (user.mfaEnabled ? t('users.mfaEnabled') : t('users.mfaDisabled'))}
                    </span>
                    {showResetButton && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={async (e) => {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          if (!userId) {
                            alert(t('users.userIdNotFound'));
                            return;
                          }
                          const confirmMessage = user.mfaEnabled 
                            ? t('users.mfaResetConfirm').replace('{name}', user.name)
                            : t('users.mfaResetConfirmInactive').replace('{name}', user.name);
                          if (confirm(confirmMessage)) {
                            try {
                              await userService.resetMFA(userId);
                              alert(t('users.mfaResetSuccess'));
                              await loadUsers();
                            } catch (err: any) {
                              alert(err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.message || err.message || t('users.mfaResetError'));
                            }
                          }
                        }}
                        title={user.mfaEnabled ? t('users.mfaResetTitle') : t('users.mfaResetTitleInactive')}
                        className="mfa-reset-button"
                      >
                        <RotateCcw size={14} />
                        <span>{t('users.mfaReset')}</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {isAdmin && userIsAdmin && user.mfaEnabled && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={async (e) => {
                          e.preventDefault();
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          if (!userId) {
                            alert(t('users.userIdNotFound'));
                            return;
                          }
                          const confirmMessage = t('users.mfaDisableConfirm').replace('{name}', user.name);
                          if (confirm(confirmMessage)) {
                            try {
                              await userService.disableMFA(userId);
                              alert(t('users.mfaDisableSuccess'));
                              await loadUsers();
                            } catch (err: any) {
                              alert(err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.message || err.message || t('users.mfaDisableError'));
                            }
                          }
                        }}
                        title={t('users.mfaDisableTitle')}
                        className="mfa-disable-button"
                      >
                        <XCircle size={14} />
                        <span>{t('users.mfaDisable')}</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>
                  <div className="table-actions">
                    <button
                      className="action-button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        navigate('/users/new', { state: { user } });
                      }}
                      title={t('common.edit')}
                    >
                      <Edit size={16} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="action-button danger"
                      onClick={async (e) => {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        if (confirm(t('users.deleteConfirm'))) {
                          try {
                            const userId = (user as any)._id || user.id;
                            await deleteUser(userId);
                            await loadUsers();
                          } catch (err: any) {
                            alert(err.response?.data?.error || err.response?.data?.message || err.message || t('users.deleteError'));
                          }
                        }
                      }}
                      title={t('common.delete')}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={16} />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </Table>
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

// Seção de Acessos
function AccessSection() {
  const { accesses, loading, error, createAccess, updateAccess, deleteAccess } = useAccess();
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingAccess, setEditingAccess] = useState<Access | null>(null);

  return (
    <>
      <div className="section-header">
        <Button onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}>
          <Plus size={18} />
          Novo Tipo de Acesso
        </Button>
      </div>

      {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}

      <Card>
        <Table headers={['ID', 'Tipo de Relatório', 'Ações']}>
          {accesses.map((access) => (
            <tr key={access.reportID}>
              <td>{access.reportID}</td>
              <td>{access.reportType}</td>
              <td>
                <div className="table-actions">
                  <button
                    className="action-button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setEditingAccess(access);
                      setIsModalOpen(true);
                    }}
                    title="Editar"
                  >
                    <Edit size={16} />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="action-button danger"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (confirm('Tem certeza que deseja excluir este tipo de acesso?')) {
                        try {
                          await deleteAccess(access.reportID);
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          alert(err.message);
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    title="Excluir"
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={16} />
                  </button>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </Table>
      </Card>

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsModalOpen(false);
          setEditingAccess(null);
        }}
        title={editingAccess ? 'Editar Acesso' : 'Novo Tipo de Acesso'}
      >
        <AccessForm
          access={editingAccess}
          onSave={async (data) => {
            try {
              if (editingAccess) {
                await updateAccess(editingAccess.reportID, data);
              } else {
                await createAccess(data);
              }
              setIsModalOpen(false);
              setEditingAccess(null);
            } catch (err: any) {
              alert(err.message);
            }
          }}
          onCancel={() => {
            setIsModalOpen(false);
            setEditingAccess(null);
          }}
        />
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

function AccessForm({
  access,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: {
  access: Access | null;
  onSave: (data: Partial<Access>) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const editingAccess = access !== null;
  
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<Partial<Access>>(
    access || {
      reportType: '',
    }
  );

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!formData.reportType || formData.reportType.trim() === '') {
      alert('Por favor, selecione um tipo de relatório');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!validateAccessType(formData.reportType)) {
      alert('Tipo de acesso inválido');
      return;
    }
    
    const dataToSave = editingAccess 
      ? formData 
      : { reportType: formData.reportType.trim() };
    
    onSave(dataToSave);
  };

  const validateAccessType = (description: string): boolean => {
    const validTypes = [
      'Relatório de Pacientes',
      'Relatório de Amostras',
      'Relatório de Temperatura',
      'Relatório de Sensores',
      'Acesso Completo',
    ];
    return validTypes.includes(description) || description.length > 0;
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="form">
      <div className="form-grid">
        <div className="form-grid-full">
          <label className="form-label">Tipo de Relatório *</label>
          <select
            value={formData.reportType || ''}
            onChange={(e) =>
              setFormData({ ...formData, reportType: e.target.value })
            }
            required
            className="form-select"
          >
            <option value="">Selecione um tipo...</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Pacientes">Relatório de Pacientes</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Amostras">Relatório de Amostras</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Temperatura">Relatório de Temperatura</option>
            <option value="Relatório de Sensores">Relatório de Sensores</option>
            <option value="Acesso Completo">Acesso Completo</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        {!editingAccess && (
          <div className="form-grid-full">
            <p className="form-help-text">
              ℹ️ O ID será gerado automaticamente pelo sistema
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="form-actions">
        <Button type="button" variant="secondary" onClick={onCancel}>
          Cancelar
        </Button>
        <Button type="submit">Salvar</Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

// Seção de Segurança (importa o componente completo)
function SecuritySection() {
  return <SecurityPage />;
}

ARQUIVO: C:\Projeto\BioAvanceD\frontend\src\pages\TemperaturePage.tsx
================================================================================
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Table from '../components/UI/Table';
import { Temperature, Policy } from '../types/models';
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useTemperature } from '../hooks/useTemperature';
import { usePolicies } from '../hooks/usePolicies';
import { validateReading, validateTemperatureUnit, generateAlert } from '../utils/validations';
import './TemperaturePage.css';

export default function TemperaturePage() {
  const { temperatures, loading, error, viewControl } = useTemperature();
  const { policies } = usePolicies();
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<any[]>([]);

  // TEMPORARIAMENTE DESATIVADO: Não há sensores cadastrados ainda
  const TEMPERATURE_READING_DISABLED = true;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!TEMPERATURE_READING_DISABLED) {
      // Carrega dados de controle de temperatura
      viewControl().catch(console.error);

      // Valida leituras e gera alertas
      temperatures.forEach((temp) => {
        if (!validateReading(temp)) {
          console.warn(`Leitura inválida: ${temp.logID}`);
        }
        if (!validateTemperatureUnit(temp.temperatureUnit)) {
          console.warn(`Unidade inválida: ${temp.temperatureUnit}`);
        }
        const policy = policies.find((p) => p.policyID.toString() === temp.policyID);
        if (policy) {
          const alert = generateAlert(temp, policy);
          if (alert) {
            setAlerts((prev) => [...prev, alert]);
          }
        }
      });
    }
  }, [temperatures, policies, viewControl]);

  const getStatusIcon = (temp: Temperature) => {
    if (temp.readingStatus === 'valid' && temp.dataQualityScore > 0.9) {
      return <CheckCircle size={18} className="status-icon valid" />;
    }
    return <AlertCircle size={18} className="status-icon alert" />;
  };

  // TEMPORARIAMENTE DESATIVADO: Não há sensores cadastrados ainda
  const TEMPERATURE_READING_DISABLED = true;

  if (TEMPERATURE_READING_DISABLED) {
    return (
      <div className="page">
        <div className="page-header">
          <div>
            <h1 className="page-title">Monitoramento de Temperatura</h1>
            <p className="page-subtitle">Leituras de temperatura em tempo real</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Card>
          <div style={{ 
            padding: '2rem', 
            textAlign: 'center',
            backgroundColor: '#fff3cd',
            border: '1px solid #ffc107',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            margin: '2rem 0'
          }}>
            <AlertCircle size={48} style={{ color: '#856404', marginBottom: '1rem' }} />
            <h2 style={{ color: '#856404', marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>Funcionalidade Temporariamente Desativada</h2>
            <p style={{ color: '#856404', fontSize: '1rem', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
              A leitura de temperatura está desativada temporariamente porque não há sensores cadastrados no sistema.
            </p>
            <p style={{ color: '#856404', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
              Para ativar esta funcionalidade, cadastre sensores em <strong>"Gerenciamento de Instalações" → "Sensores"</strong>.
            </p>
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="page">
      <div className="page-header">
        <div>
          <h1 className="page-title">Monitoramento de Temperatura</h1>
          <p className="page-subtitle">Leituras de temperatura em tempo real</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loading && <p>Carregando...</p>}
      {error && <p style={{ color: 'var(--danger)' }}>Erro: {error}</p>}

      <div className="temperature-grid">
        <Card title="Últimas Leituras">
          <Table
            headers={[
              'Timestamp',
              'Sensor',
              'Temperatura',
              'Status',
              'Qualidade',
            ]}
          >
            {temperatures.map((temp) => {
              // Trata sensorID que pode ser objeto ou string
              const sensorDisplay = typeof temp.sensorID === 'object' && temp.sensorID !== null
                ? temp.sensorID.sensorID || temp.sensorID.sensorType || 'N/A'
                : temp.sensorID || 'N/A';
              
              return (
                <tr key={temp.logID}>
                  <td>{new Date(temp.timestamp || '').toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</td>
                  <td>{sensorDisplay}</td>
                  <td>
                    <span className="temperature-value">
                      {temp.temperatureValue} {temp.temperatureUnit}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className="status-cell">
                      {getStatusIcon(temp)}
                      <span>{temp.readingStatus}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div className="quality-score">
                      {temp.dataQualityScore ? (temp.dataQualityScore * 100).toFixed(0) : 'N/A'}%
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </Table>
        </Card>

        <Card title="Alertas">
          <div className="alerts-list">
            {temperatures.filter((t) => t.readingStatus !== 'valid').length ===
            0 ? (
              <p className="empty-state">Nenhum alerta no momento</p>
            ) : (
              temperatures
                .filter((t) => t.readingStatus !== 'valid')
                .map((temp) => {
                  // Trata sensorID que pode ser objeto ou string
                  const sensorDisplay = typeof temp.sensorID === 'object' && temp.sensorID !== null
                    ? temp.sensorID.sensorID || temp.sensorID.sensorType || 'N/A'
                    : temp.sensorID || 'N/A';
                  
                  return (
                    <div key={temp.logID} className="alert-item">
                      <AlertCircle size={20} className="alert-icon" />
                      <div>
                        <p className="alert-message">
                          {temp.errorMessage || 'Temperatura fora do limite'}
                        </p>
                        <p className="alert-sensor">Sensor: {sensorDisplay}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import Card from '../components/UI/Card';
import Button from '../components/UI/Button';
import Modal from '../components/UI/Modal';
import { useLanguage } from '../contexts/LanguageContext';
import { 
  Shield, 
  Lock, 
  Smartphone, 
  Key, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle, 
  XCircle,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Download,
  Trash2,
  Edit,
  Plus,
  LogOut,
  Smartphone as PhoneIcon,
  Fingerprint,
  FileText,
  ChevronRight,
  Settings
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useUserSecurity } from '../hooks/useUserSecurity';
import { useToast } from '../components/UI/ToastContainer';
import { userSecurityService } from '../services/api';
import { validatePasswordAndGetError } from '../utils/passwordValidator';
import { getPasswordIssues } from '../utils/passwordRules';
import './UserSecurityPage.css';

export default function UserSecurityPage() {
  const { t } = useLanguage();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const {
    securityStatus,
    mfaStatus,
    passwordStatus,
    sessions,
    loading,
    refreshData,
    updateMFA,
    updatePassword,
    updatePhone,
    addPasskey,
    removePasskey,
    generateRecoveryCodes,
    revokeSession,
    revokeAllSessions
  } = useUserSecurity();

  const [showChangePasswordModal, setShowChangePasswordModal] = useState(false);
  const [showAddPhoneModal, setShowAddPhoneModal] = useState(false);
  const [showRecoveryCodesModal, setShowRecoveryCodesModal] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmModal, setShowConfirmModal] = useState(false);
  const [confirmAction, setConfirmAction] = useState<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const [confirmMessage, setConfirmMessage] = useState('');
  const [newPassword, setNewPassword] = useState({ current: '', new: '', confirm: '' });
  const [newPhone, setNewPhone] = useState('');
  const [showPasswords, setShowPasswords] = useState({ current: false, new: false, confirm: false });
  const [passwordError, setPasswordError] = useState('');
  const [phoneError, setPhoneError] = useState('');
  const [addingPasskey, setAddingPasskey] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshData();
  }, [refreshData]);

  const getSecurityLevelColor = (level: number) => {
    if (level >= 80) return 'var(--success)';
    if (level >= 50) return 'var(--warning)';
    return 'var(--danger)';
  };

  const getSecurityLevelLabel = (level: number) => {
    if (level >= 80) return t('userSecurity.securityLevel.strong');
    if (level >= 50) return t('userSecurity.securityLevel.medium');
    return t('userSecurity.securityLevel.weak');
  };

  const handleChangePassword = async () => {
    setPasswordError('');
    
    if (!newPassword.current || !newPassword.new || !newPassword.confirm) {
      setPasswordError(t('userSecurity.password.allFieldsRequired'));
      return;
    }

    // Valida complexidade da senha
    const passwordError = validatePasswordAndGetError(newPassword.new);
    if (passwordError) {
      setPasswordError(passwordError);
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword.new !== newPassword.confirm) {
      setPasswordError(t('userSecurity.password.mismatch'));
      return;
    }

    try {
      await updatePassword(newPassword.current, newPassword.new);
      setShowChangePasswordModal(false);
      setNewPassword({ current: '', new: '', confirm: '' });
      refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setPasswordError(err.message || t('userSecurity.password.changeError'));
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmAction = (action: () => void, message: string) => {
    setConfirmAction(() => action);
    setConfirmMessage(message);
    setShowConfirmModal(true);
  };

  const executeConfirmAction = () => {
    if (confirmAction) {
      confirmAction();
      setShowConfirmModal(false);
      setConfirmAction(null);
    }
  };

  const formatDate = (date: string | Date) => {
    return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', {
      day: '2-digit',
      month: '2-digit',
      year: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
  };

  const getDaysUntilExpiration = (expirationDate: string | Date) => {
    const days = Math.ceil((new Date(expirationDate).getTime() - Date.now()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return days;
  };

  const passwordIssues = getPasswordIssues(newPassword.new);
  const confirmMismatch = newPassword.new && newPassword.confirm && newPassword.new !== newPassword.confirm;

  if (loading && !securityStatus) {
    return (
      <div className="user-security-page">
        <div className="loading-skeleton">
          <div className="skeleton-header"></div>
          <div className="skeleton-card"></div>
          <div className="skeleton-card"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="user-security-page">
      {/* Cabeçalho */}
      <div className="security-header">
        <div className="header-content">
          <div className="header-icon">
            <Shield size={36} />
          </div>
          <div className="header-text">
            <h1>{t('userSecurity.title')}</h1>
            <p>{t('userSecurity.subtitle')}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="breadcrumb">
          <span>{t('userSecurity.breadcrumb.settings')}</span>
          <ChevronRight size={14} />
          <span>{t('userSecurity.breadcrumb.security')}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Status Geral da Conta */}
      <Card className="security-status-card">
        <div className="status-header">
          <h2>{t('userSecurity.status.title')}</h2>
          <div className={`status-badge status-${securityStatus?.overallLevel || 'weak'}`}>
            {getSecurityLevelLabel(securityStatus?.securityScore || 0)}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="security-progress">
          <div className="progress-bar">
            <div 
              className="progress-fill"
              style={{ 
                width: `${securityStatus?.securityScore || 0}%`,
                backgroundColor: getSecurityLevelColor(securityStatus?.securityScore || 0)
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <span className="progress-text">{securityStatus?.securityScore || 0}%</span>
        </div>
        <div className="status-grid">
          <div className="status-item">
            <div className="status-icon">
              {mfaStatus?.primaryEnabled ? (
                <CheckCircle size={20} className="status-success" />
              ) : (
                <XCircle size={20} className="status-danger" />
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="status-info">
              <span className="status-label">{t('userSecurity.status.mfaPrimary')}</span>
              <span className="status-value">
                {mfaStatus?.primaryEnabled ? t('userSecurity.status.active') : t('userSecurity.status.inactive')}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="status-item">
            <div className="status-icon">
              <Lock size={20} />
            </div>
            <div className="status-info">
              <span className="status-label">{t('userSecurity.status.lastPasswordChange')}</span>
              <span className="status-value">
                {passwordStatus?.lastChanged 
                  ? formatDate(passwordStatus.lastChanged)
                  : t('userSecurity.status.never')}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="status-item">
            <div className="status-icon">
              <Key size={20} />
            </div>
            <div className="status-info">
              <span className="status-label">{t('userSecurity.status.alternativeMethods')}</span>
              <span className="status-value">
                {securityStatus?.alternativeMethodsCount || 0} {t('userSecurity.status.configured')}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        {passwordStatus?.expiresAt && getDaysUntilExpiration(passwordStatus.expiresAt) <= 10 && (
          <div className="status-warning">
            <AlertTriangle size={18} />
            <span>
              {t('userSecurity.status.passwordExpiresIn').replace('{days}', String(getDaysUntilExpiration(passwordStatus.expiresAt)))}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Autenticação Multifator */}
      <div className="security-section">
        <h2 className="section-title">
          <Key size={28} />
          {t('userSecurity.mfa.title')}
        </h2>
        
        {/* MFA Primário */}
        <Card className="mfa-card">
          <div className="mfa-header">
            <div className="mfa-info">
              <div className="mfa-icon">
                <Smartphone size={24} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3>{t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.title')}</h3>
                <p className="mfa-description">{t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.description')}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={`mfa-status ${mfaStatus?.primaryEnabled ? 'active' : 'inactive'}`}>
              {mfaStatus?.primaryEnabled ? (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle size={18} />
                  <span>{t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.active')}</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <XCircle size={18} />
                  <span>{t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.inactive')}</span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          {mfaStatus?.primaryEnabled && mfaStatus?.primarySetupDate && (
            <div className="mfa-details">
              <span>{t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.setupDate')}: {formatDate(mfaStatus.primarySetupDate)}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="mfa-actions">
            {mfaStatus?.primaryEnabled ? (
              <>
                <Button 
                  variant="secondary" 
                  onClick={() => navigate('/security/mfa-setup', { state: { from: '/user/security' } })}
                >
                  <Settings size={18} />
                  {t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.reconfigure')}
                </Button>
                <Button 
                  variant="secondary" 
                  onClick={() => navigate('/security/mfa-setup', { state: { from: '/user/security' } })}
                >
                  <Eye size={18} />
                  {t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.viewSettings')}
                </Button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <Button 
                variant="primary" 
                onClick={() => navigate('/security/mfa-setup', { state: { from: '/user/security' } })}
                className="action-primary"
              >
                <Plus size={18} />
                {t('userSecurity.mfa.primary.activateNow')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* Métodos Alternativos */}
        <div className="alternative-methods">
          <h3 className="subsection-title">{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.title')}</h3>

          {/* Telefone/SMS */}
          <Card className="mfa-card">
            <div className="mfa-header">
              <div className="mfa-info">
                <div className="mfa-icon">
                  <PhoneIcon size={24} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3>{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.title')}</h3>
                  <p className="mfa-description">{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.description')}</p>
                  {mfaStatus?.phoneNumber && (
                    <p className="mfa-value" style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text)', marginTop: '0.25rem', fontWeight: 500 }}>
                      {mfaStatus.phoneNumber}
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {mfaStatus?.phoneEnabled && !mfaStatus?.phoneNumber && (
                    <p className="mfa-value" style={{ fontSize: '0.875rem', color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.25rem', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
                      {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.numberNotDisplayed') || 'Telefone cadastrado'}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={`mfa-status ${mfaStatus?.phoneEnabled ? 'active' : 'inactive'}`}>
                {mfaStatus?.phoneEnabled ? (
                  <>
                    <CheckCircle size={18} />
                    <span>{t('userSecurity.status.active')}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <XCircle size={18} />
                    <span>{t('userSecurity.status.notConfigured')}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mfa-actions">
              {mfaStatus?.phoneEnabled ? (
                <>
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowAddPhoneModal(true)}>
                    <Edit size={18} />
                    {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.change')}
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    variant="danger" 
                    onClick={() => handleConfirmAction(
                      async () => {
                        try {
                          await updateMFA('phone', false);
                          showToast(t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.removeSuccess') || 'Telefone removido com sucesso', 'success');
                          refreshData();
                        } catch (err: any) {
                          showToast(err.message || t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.removeError') || 'Erro ao remover telefone', 'error');
                        }
                      },
                      t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.removeConfirm')
                    )}
                  >
                    <Trash2 size={18} />
                    {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.remove')}
                  </Button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setShowAddPhoneModal(true)}>
                  <Plus size={18} />
                  {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.add')}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card>

          {/* Passkey */}
          <Card className="mfa-card">
            <div className="mfa-header">
              <div className="mfa-info">
                <div className="mfa-icon">
                  <Fingerprint size={24} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3>{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.title')}</h3>
                  <p className="mfa-description">{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.description')}</p>
                  {mfaStatus?.passkeys && mfaStatus.passkeys.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="passkey-list">
                      {mfaStatus.passkeys.map((pk: any, idx: number) => (
                        <div key={idx} className="passkey-item">
                          <span>{pk.name || pk.deviceName || `${t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.device')} ${idx + 1}`}</span>
                          <Button 
                            variant="danger" 
                            className="btn-small"
                            onClick={() => handleConfirmAction(
                              async () => {
                                try {
                                  await removePasskey(pk.id);
                                  showToast(t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.removeSuccess') || 'Passkey removida com sucesso', 'success');
                                  refreshData();
                                } catch (err: any) {
                                  showToast(err.message || t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.removeError') || 'Erro ao remover passkey', 'error');
                                }
                              },
                              t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.removeConfirm')
                            )}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={14} />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={`mfa-status ${(mfaStatus?.passkeys?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? 'active' : 'inactive'}`}>
                {(mfaStatus?.passkeys?.length ?? 0) > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    <CheckCircle size={18} />
                    <span>{mfaStatus?.passkeys?.length ?? 0} {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.configured')}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <XCircle size={18} />
                    <span>{t('userSecurity.status.notConfigured')}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mfa-actions">
              <Button 
                variant="primary" 
                disabled={addingPasskey}
                onClick={async () => {
                  setAddingPasskey(true);
                  try {
                    await addPasskey();
                    showToast(t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.addSuccess') || 'Passkey adicionada com sucesso', 'success');
                  } catch (err: any) {
                    console.error('Erro ao adicionar passkey:', err);
                    const errorMessage = err.message || t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.addError') || 'Erro ao adicionar passkey';
                    showToast(errorMessage, 'error');
                  } finally {
                    setAddingPasskey(false);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <Plus size={18} />
                {addingPasskey ? t('common.loading') || 'Adicionando...' : t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.passkey.add')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </Card>

          {/* Recovery Codes */}
          <Card className="mfa-card">
            <div className="mfa-header">
              <div className="mfa-info">
                <div className="mfa-icon">
                  <FileText size={24} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3>{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.title')}</h3>
                  <p className="mfa-description">{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.description')}</p>
                  {mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes && (
                    <p className="mfa-value">
                      {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.remaining').replace('{count}', String(mfaStatus.recoveryCodes.remaining ?? 0))}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={`mfa-status ${
                (mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes?.remaining ?? 0) >= 5 ? 'active' : 
                (mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes?.remaining ?? 0) > 0 ? 'warning' : 'danger'
              }`}>
                {(mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes?.remaining ?? 0) >= 5 ? (
                  <>
                    <CheckCircle size={18} />
                    <span>{t('userSecurity.status.secure')}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes?.remaining ?? 0) > 0 ? (
                  <>
                    <AlertTriangle size={18} />
                    <span>{t('userSecurity.status.needsRenewal')}</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <XCircle size={18} />
                    <span>{t('userSecurity.status.none')}</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mfa-actions">
              <Button 
                variant="primary" 
                onClick={async () => {
                  try {
                    const codes = await generateRecoveryCodes();
                    // Garante que os códigos estão no estado antes de abrir o modal
                    if (codes && codes.length > 0) {
                      setShowRecoveryCodesModal(true);
                    } else {
                      showToast(t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.generateError') || 'Erro ao gerar códigos', 'error');
                    }
                  } catch (err: any) {
                    showToast(err.message || t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.generateError') || 'Erro ao gerar códigos', 'error');
                  }
                }}
              >
                <Plus size={18} />
                {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.generate')}
              </Button>
              {mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes?.codes && mfaStatus.recoveryCodes.codes.length > 0 && (
                <Button 
                  variant="secondary" 
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes?.codes) {
                      const blob = new Blob([mfaStatus.recoveryCodes.codes.join('\n')], { type: 'text/plain' });
                      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                      const a = document.createElement('a');
                      a.href = url;
                      a.download = 'recovery-codes.txt';
                      a.click();
                      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  <Download size={18} />
                  {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.download')}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Senha e Credenciais */}
      <Card className="security-section-card">
        <div className="section-header">
          <h2>
            <Lock size={24} />
            {t('userSecurity.password.title')}
          </h2>
        </div>
        <div className="password-status">
          <div className="password-info">
            <div className="info-item">
              <span className="info-label">{t('userSecurity.password.lastChange')}</span>
              <span className="info-value">
                {passwordStatus?.lastChanged 
                  ? formatDate(passwordStatus.lastChanged)
                  : t('userSecurity.status.never')}
              </span>
            </div>
            {passwordStatus?.expiresAt && (
              <div className="info-item">
                <span className="info-label">{t('userSecurity.password.expiresIn')}</span>
                <span className={`info-value ${getDaysUntilExpiration(passwordStatus.expiresAt) <= 10 ? 'warning' : ''}`}>
                  {getDaysUntilExpiration(passwordStatus.expiresAt)} {t('userSecurity.password.days')}
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="info-item">
              <span className="info-label">{t('userSecurity.password.strength')}</span>
              <div className="strength-indicator">
                <div 
                  className={`strength-bar strength-${passwordStatus?.strength || 'weak'}`}
                  style={{ width: `${(passwordStatus?.strengthScore || 0) * 20}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <span className="strength-label">
                {passwordStatus?.strength || t('userSecurity.password.strengthWeak')}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          {passwordStatus?.expiresAt && getDaysUntilExpiration(passwordStatus.expiresAt) <= 10 && (
            <div className="password-warning">
              <AlertTriangle size={18} />
              <span>{t('userSecurity.password.expirationWarning')}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="password-actions">
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setShowChangePasswordModal(true)}>
              <Lock size={18} />
              {t('userSecurity.password.change')}
            </Button>
            <Button 
              variant="secondary" 
              onClick={() => handleConfirmAction(
                async () => {
                  try {
                    await userSecurityService.requestPasswordReset();
                    showToast(t('userSecurity.password.resetRequestSuccess'), 'success');
                  } catch (err: any) {
                    showToast(err.message || t('userSecurity.password.resetRequestError'), 'error');
                  }
                },
                t('userSecurity.password.resetRequestConfirm')
              )}
            >
              <Key size={18} />
              {t('userSecurity.password.requestReset')}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <div className="password-policy">
            <p>{t('userSecurity.password.policy')}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* Sessões e Dispositivos */}
      <Card className="security-section-card">
        <div className="section-header">
          <h2>
            <Smartphone size={24} />
            {t('userSecurity.sessions.title')}
          </h2>
          {sessions && sessions.length > 1 && (
            <Button 
              variant="danger" 
              onClick={() => handleConfirmAction(
                () => revokeAllSessions(),
                t('userSecurity.sessions.revokeAllConfirm')
              )}
            >
              <LogOut size={18} />
              {t('userSecurity.sessions.revokeAll')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="sessions-list">
          {sessions && sessions.length > 0 ? (
            sessions.map((session: any, idx: number) => (
              <div key={idx} className="session-item">
                <div className="session-info">
                  <div className="session-device">
                    <Smartphone size={20} />
                    <div>
                      <span className="session-name">{session.deviceName || t('userSecurity.sessions.unknownDevice')}</span>
                      <span className="session-details">
                        {session.browser} • {session.os} • {session.location || t('userSecurity.sessions.unknownLocation')}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="session-meta">
                    <span className="session-time">{formatDate(session.lastAccess)}</span>
                    {session.isCurrent && (
                      <span className="session-badge current">{t('userSecurity.sessions.current')}</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
                {!session.isCurrent && (
                  <Button 
                    variant="danger" 
                    className="btn-small"
                    onClick={() => handleConfirmAction(
                      () => revokeSession(session.id),
                      t('userSecurity.sessions.revokeConfirm')
                    )}
                  >
                    <LogOut size={16} />
                    {t('userSecurity.sessions.revoke')}
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="empty-state">
              <Smartphone size={48} />
              <p>{t('userSecurity.sessions.empty')}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* Modals */}
      {/* Change Password Modal */}
      <Modal 
        isOpen={showChangePasswordModal} 
        onClose={() => {
          setShowChangePasswordModal(false);
          setNewPassword({ current: '', new: '', confirm: '' });
          setPasswordError('');
        }}
        title={t('userSecurity.password.change')}
      >
        <div className="modal-content">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label>{t('userSecurity.password.current')}</label>
            <div className="input-with-icon">
              <input
                type={showPasswords.current ? 'text' : 'password'}
                value={newPassword.current}
                onChange={(e) => setNewPassword({ ...newPassword, current: e.target.value })}
                placeholder={t('userSecurity.password.currentPlaceholder')}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="password-toggle"
                onClick={() => setShowPasswords({ ...showPasswords, current: !showPasswords.current })}
              >
                {showPasswords.current ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label>{t('userSecurity.password.new')}</label>
            <div className="input-with-icon">
              <input
                type={showPasswords.new ? 'text' : 'password'}
                value={newPassword.new}
                onChange={(e) => setNewPassword({ ...newPassword, new: e.target.value })}
                placeholder={t('userSecurity.password.newPlaceholder')}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="password-toggle"
                onClick={() => setShowPasswords({ ...showPasswords, new: !showPasswords.new })}
              >
                {showPasswords.new ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="form-group">
            <label>{t('userSecurity.password.confirm')}</label>
            <div className="input-with-icon">
              <input
                type={showPasswords.confirm ? 'text' : 'password'}
                value={newPassword.confirm}
                onChange={(e) => setNewPassword({ ...newPassword, confirm: e.target.value })}
                placeholder={t('userSecurity.password.confirmPlaceholder')}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="password-toggle"
                onClick={() => setShowPasswords({ ...showPasswords, confirm: !showPasswords.confirm })}
              >
                {showPasswords.confirm ? <EyeOff size={18} /> : <Eye size={18} />}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="password-requirements" style={{ margin: '0.75rem 0' }}>
            <p style={{ fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>{t('password.requirements.title')}</p>
            <ul style={{ listStyle: 'none', padding: 0, margin: 0, display: 'grid', gap: '0.35rem' }}>
              {[{
                key: 'minLength',
                label: t('password.requirements.minLength')
              }, {
                key: 'upper',
                label: t('password.requirements.upper')
              }, {
                key: 'lower',
                label: t('password.requirements.lower')
              }, {
                key: 'number',
                label: t('password.requirements.number')
              }, {
                key: 'symbol',
                label: t('password.requirements.symbol')
              }].map((item) => {
                const ok = !passwordIssues.includes(item.key as any);
                return (
                  <li key={item.key} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem', color: ok ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--text)' }}>
                    {ok ? <CheckCircle size={16} /> : <XCircle size={16} color="var(--danger)" />}
                    <span style={{ color: ok ? 'var(--success)' : 'var(--text)' }}>{item.label}</span>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
            {confirmMismatch && (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.35rem', marginTop: '0.5rem', color: 'var(--danger)' }}>
                <AlertTriangle size={16} />
                <span>{t('password.mismatch')}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {passwordError && (
            <div className="form-error">
              <AlertTriangle size={18} />
              <span>{passwordError}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="modal-actions">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => {
              setShowChangePasswordModal(false);
              setNewPassword({ current: '', new: '', confirm: '' });
              setPasswordError('');
            }}>
              {t('common.cancel')}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleChangePassword}>
              {t('userSecurity.password.change')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Add Phone Modal */}
      <Modal 
        isOpen={showAddPhoneModal} 
        onClose={() => {
          setShowAddPhoneModal(false);
          setNewPhone('');
          setPhoneError('');
        }}
        title={mfaStatus?.phoneEnabled ? t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.change') : t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.add')}
      >
        <div className="modal-content">
          <div className="form-group">
            <label>{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.number')}</label>
            <input
              type="tel"
              value={newPhone}
              onChange={(e) => {
                // Aplica máscara de telefone brasileiro
                let value = e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
                if (value.length <= 11) {
                  if (value.length <= 2) {
                    value = value;
                  } else if (value.length <= 7) {
                    value = `(${value.slice(0, 2)}) ${value.slice(2)}`;
                  } else if (value.length <= 10) {
                    value = `(${value.slice(0, 2)}) ${value.slice(2, 6)}-${value.slice(6)}`;
                  } else {
                    value = `(${value.slice(0, 2)}) ${value.slice(2, 7)}-${value.slice(7, 11)}`;
                  }
                  setNewPhone(value);
                }
              }}
              placeholder="(11) 99999-9999"
              maxLength={15}
            />
            <p style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', color: 'var(--text-light)', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
              Formato: (XX) XXXXX-XXXX ou (XX) XXXX-XXXX
            </p>
          </div>
          {phoneError && (
            <div className="form-error" style={{ marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
              <AlertTriangle size={18} />
              <span>{phoneError}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="modal-actions">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => {
              setShowAddPhoneModal(false);
              setNewPhone('');
              setPhoneError('');
            }}>
              {t('common.cancel')}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={async () => {
              setPhoneError('');
              
              // Valida telefone
              const cleaned = newPhone.replace(/\D/g, '');
              if (cleaned.length < 10 || cleaned.length > 11) {
                setPhoneError('Telefone inválido. Use o formato: (XX) XXXXX-XXXX ou (XX) XXXX-XXXX');
                return;
              }
              
              try {
                await updatePhone(newPhone);
                showToast(t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.updateSuccess') || 'Telefone atualizado com sucesso', 'success');
                setShowAddPhoneModal(false);
                setNewPhone('');
                setPhoneError('');
                // Aguarda um pouco antes de atualizar para garantir que o backend processou
                setTimeout(() => {
                  refreshData();
                }, 500);
              } catch (err: any) {
                console.error('Erro ao atualizar telefone:', err);
                const errorMsg = err.message || t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.updateError') || 'Erro ao atualizar telefone';
                setPhoneError(errorMsg);
                showToast(errorMsg, 'error');
              }
            }}>
              {mfaStatus?.phoneEnabled ? t('common.save') : t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.phone.add')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Recovery Codes Modal */}
      <Modal 
        isOpen={showRecoveryCodesModal} 
        onClose={() => {
          setShowRecoveryCodesModal(false);
          // Remove os códigos do estado após fechar o modal (por segurança)
          // Faz refresh para atualizar o remaining, mas remove os códigos
          refreshData();
        }}
        title={t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.codes')}
      >
        <div className="modal-content" style={{ padding: '1rem' }}>
          <div className="recovery-codes-warning">
            <AlertTriangle size={16} />
            <p>{t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.warning')}</p>
          </div>
          {mfaStatus?.recoveryCodes?.codes && mfaStatus.recoveryCodes.codes.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="recovery-codes-list">
              {mfaStatus.recoveryCodes.codes.map((code: string, idx: number) => (
                <div key={idx} className="recovery-code-item">
                  <code>{code}</code>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="empty-state" style={{ padding: '1rem', textAlign: 'center' }}>
              <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-light)', fontSize: '0.875rem', margin: 0 }}>
                {t('userSecurity.mfa.alternatives.recovery.noCodes') || 'Nenhum código disponível. Gere novos códigos.'}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="modal-actions">
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setShowRecoveryCodesModal(false)}>
              {t('common.close')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>

      {/* Confirm Action Modal */}
      <Modal 
        isOpen={showConfirmModal} 
        onClose={() => setShowConfirmModal(false)}
        title={t('userSecurity.confirm.title')}
      >
        <div className="modal-content">
          <p>{confirmMessage}</p>
          <div className="modal-actions">
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowConfirmModal(false)}>
              {t('common.cancel')}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={executeConfirmAction}>
              {t('userSecurity.confirm.proceed')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </div>
  );
}
